publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Hidden patterns of Euclidean data such as videos, texts, images are best captured by deep learning models. Various DL algorithms, particularly CNN have shown promising results in object detection and image classification. But they lack in cases where the data is not sufficiently large and unrepresentative leading to high misclassification rates. CNN fails to incorporate the relationships and similarities between classes. In case of non-Euclidean data in the form of graphs, such Neural Network techniques cease to give best results due to random and dynamic size of the graph, and the complex topology. In our work, we introduce Node Embeddings as a way of encoding high-dimensional non-Euclidean data as low-dimensional structured data; and leverage the class noise issue in the form of Mis-classification graph. This paper is concerned with an extended approach to the traditional CNN approach for multiclass image classification in the development of the Plant Disease Recognition model, by the use of Convolution Neural Networks (CNN) and Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN). As the similarity between the leaves of the plants can be expressed in terms of a graph, we find GCNs to be an intuitive solution to the above problem.

articleTitle: Enhanced Biogeography Based Optimization (EBBO) for longevity and optimized energy consumption of Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The major challenges of the remotely deployed wireless sensor network are selecting optimal cluster heads and energy-efficient routing. To deal with these challenges researchers often used an approach of hierarchal cluster-based routing where cluster heads are given additional jobs like data aggregation transferring aggregated data to a base station which leads to high power consumption. High power consumption leads to the short life of a network hence to extend the network’s life, care should be taken while selecting cluster heads in the wireless sensor network. Biogeography-based optimization (BBO) is a well-known optimization algorithm that has a broad scope to reveal its full potential in dealing with combinatorial optimization problems such as clustering. Therefore, this paper proposed an Enhanced Biogeography Based Optimization (EBBO) based cluster-head selection method. The proposed method is used to optimize the energy consumption in the network. In general, the sensor nodes are un-attendant and have limited energy backup. The energy optimization of such nodes can lead to the longevity and stability of the network. To evaluate the performance of the algorithm Enhanced Biogeography Based Optimization (EBBO), it is compared with some existing clustering methods. The simulation results show an effective increase in the lifetime of the sensor network as compared to other methods.

articleTitle: AR In Fashion Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Augmented reality is an on point or off point perspective of the real-world elements which are augmented over a computational program. It mostly increments the program information and improves the customer’s perspective towards the real world. The main aim of this project is to create a virtual trial room program that helps the user simulate cloth movement in Augmented reality. The early applications were implemented over static images of the user and added static clothes over them. This is the common goal for each AR application. This application can require OpenCV and a webcam. Once there is a video captured, the application runs a series of codes to identify the background and the subject over which the cloth will be simulated. It is a well-versed platform that has been created for getting efficient computational functions. OpenCV holds multiple functions that are bonded with each other in identifying textures in different objects in a frame. After analyzing the color palettes, the image is turned into grayscale and thresholding is put on it to increase the intensity of the subject and decrease the ones of the background to a much darker intensity. Many works of the same threshold can be implemented on the picture on further requirement. Thresholding support is differentiating objects by compiling with their background functions and work on the pixels as required. On receiving the hierarchy, the objects are extracted and the detection on the required object starts kicking in with the application focusing onto it. Following the aforementioned task, the application can compute the required areas where the cloth is to be put and simulated on to the real world. The selection of the texture, color, patter, material is based on the users’ preferences. The key difference between this technology and previous existing virtual halls is scarce hardware support on this virtual base.

articleTitle: A Review: Performance Analysis of PV Array Working Under Partial Shaded Conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this review paper, one of the main problems pertaining to the successful and efficient performance of PV (photovoltaic) systems has been identified as the shading phenomenon on a global scale. The generation of PV systems can be reduced by shading from nearby construction, passing mists, the droppings of birds or other winged creatures, etc. By carefully choosing PV array configuration and reconfiguration strategies, the generation of PV under partial shadowing can be improved. An in-depth analysis of several Photovoltaic array layouts and reconfigurations that operate in presence of partial shade conditions is provided in this article. For various shading studies, the effectiveness of the PV array configurations such as SP (Series-Parallel), TCT (Total Cross Tied), HC (Honeycomb), BL (Bridge-linked), and OE (Odd-Even) are assessed and studied to maximize output power, minimize losses due to shading, improving fill factor, and taking care of mismatch losses. For the same shade conditions, the outcomes are contrasted with a 7x7 PV array design. The experiment is broadened to determine the effects on power output of including a bypass diode in each module. The results of the experiments also show that shading event dictates PV array's maximum instantaneous power production. The findings show that, for all taken-in shading experiments, OE reconfiguration improves performance in terms of maximum power generation.

articleTitle: Determining Statistically Significant Road Accident Spatial Hotspots using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Spatial Clustering is a subclass of Unsupervised Machine Learning algorithms that utilizes a specified criteria to group a set of geographically dispersed data points together. Effective clustering algorithms are required in societal applications such as road safety to uncover useful patterns linked with the data. Many applications employ Spatial Scan Statistics to identify spatial clusters, however it needs users to first determine the shape of the cluster, which is ambiguous in the context of road safety and could result in unfavourable outcomes. The paper outlines a method for discovering statistically significant shape-invariant spatial clusters in order to identify high-risk road accident zones. The proposed approach incorporates the OPTICS and HDBSCAN clustering algorithms, as well as Cluster density and the Log Likelihood Ratio methods for evaluating the significance of spatial clusters. OPTICS and HDBSCAN are optimal for finding clusters of arbitrary shape and only require a single input parameter, making hyper-parameter tuning relatively easier. The paper incorporates the statistical significance of clusters to eliminate spurious patterns. To illustrate the obtained results, the proposed approach is applied to the UK Road-Accidents data. The paper also presented a comprehensive analysis of the seasonal and temporal variations of the significant spatial hotspots discovered.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Recommendation Systems based on Medical Data Sets
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In today’s world, a number of most common diseases such as DM (Diabetes Mellitus) for which not assured medicine has searched yet, the capable method for these types of patients for the survival is to take care and proper diet. Fasting Blood Sugar is one of the vital parameters of diabetes mellitus. In the health care system, numerous data of the patients have analyzed that help to obtain insights and assist the estimate of the diseases. Hence, there is a need for an intelligent scheme for estimation of the health situation by analyzing the standard of living, health check reports, and communal activities. However, the recommendation system is becoming the main framework for health care applications. Moreover, fitness intelligent schemes have become a necessary tool in the decision-making approach in health areas. Conversely, people use an online system for understanding the physical condition. Therefore, health recommendation schemes have estimated better results in diagnosis, medical insurance, medical-based management techniques, and other medicine based on the health profile of the patient. This paper provides comparative analysis of various recommendation methods such as MLP, RNN, LSTM, SVM, LR, and NB. These recommendation methods are used for the recommended diseases with Medical Data Sets.

articleTitle: Customer Segmentation and Future Purchase Prediction using RFM measures
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Winning in the E-Commerce business race at a competitive age like this requires proper usage of Customer data. Using that database and grouping it in similar segments in terms of spending expenditure, observation time, sex, and location so that every customer falls in a segment of characteristics. This mechanism is called Customer Segmentation. In the modern era of highly compatible technological advancements, Machine Learning Algorithms are being vastly used to bring solutions to these difficult yet essential services. In the field of research methods like simple clustering based on purchase behaviour, buyer targeting or automated customer promotion mechanism by dividing into two major categories, have been worked on. However, ensemble algorithms have come handy where different clustering algorithms are combined to deliver best segmentation. Lately combination techniques like clustering and classification mechanism have also delivered good results where, not only segmentation is done but also classification of existing and new customers are possible into the clusters. Depending on that an effective customer relationship management can really benefit the company to a huge extent. Unlike other studies where clustering was performed directly on RFM table, a different approach was taken in this study where, one dimensional clustering was done individually on Recency, Frequency, Monetary columns, then an overall score was calculated and customers were classified into three segments. However, for a new customer depending on his purchase behaviour he/she also can be classified into any of the categories.

articleTitle: Hate Speech Detection:A Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Social media has been continuously acting as a medium for people to share and convey their emotions and information. At the same time, it has been observed that people utilize social media platforms like Facebook, Twitter, etc. to post offensive and hateful content. This happens on a large scale which makes it extremely challenging to monitor them manually, paving way for automation in hate speech. This survey paper explores, summarises, and compares various methods that target hate speech detection, how they are being utilized at solving past challenges, and dive into the current and future prospects for hate speech detection.

articleTitle: Change Prediction using Selective Cross Project Validation with Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The goal of predicting the change-proneness of a software is to recognize parts of a software that are prone to change and require managers' and other stakeholders' attention. This leads to a reduction of the overall cost which would be spent in the software’s development and maintenance. Previous versions of a project may be used to predict such classes. However, this may not be possible for a project in its infancy where previous classes do not exist. Cross-project change-proneness prediction provides an alternative means of achieving the same goal by using a different project for the classification process.In this paper, we utilize selective cross project algorithms to choose an appropriate project from the source project candidate pool. To choose a source project, three algorithms were used. The first algorithm relied on the change-proneness rate of the source and target project. The remaining two algorithms relied on the Euclidean distance between the characteristic vectors of the source and the target project. The classification process was executed by using two ensemble methods – Bagging and Random Forests – to determine the feasibility of the ensemble techniques for cross project prediction. The performance is evaluated using the AUC, F-Measure, and MCC performance metrics. Results show that the algorithm utilizing the change-proneness rate performed better than all remaining algorithms used in this study.

articleTitle: A Smart System for Sign Language Recognition using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: When people exchange information, thoughts, or sentiments via the medium of communication, it is called communication. Both parties must be conversant in the same language in order for communication to occur. On the other hand, those who are deaf or dumb must use various communication methods. If you can't hear, you have deafness; if you can't speak, you have dumbness. As a group, they use sign language to communicate, but most people don't see it as a valuable skill. To communicate with someone who is deaf or mute is difficult since not everyone is familiar with or understands sign language. You may develop a model using machine learning to get around this roadblock. It is possible to teach a model to recognize different gestures used in sign language and to translate those gestures into English. Many people will get the ability to converse with the deaf and dumb as a result of this. By using a camera to capture Sign Language data, we may then use machine learning techniques like Convolutional Neural Networks to the datasets. Some other well-known models have been compared to a new strategy that has been presented for the same problem. Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Histogram of Gradients (HOG), and Local Binary Patterns (LBP) are some of the pre-processing approaches employed. ORB, Canny edge detection, and the state of word approach are all used to create the new model. This preprocessed data is then sent through a variety of classifiers in order to provide useful findings (including Random Forests and Support Vector Machines, as well as Nave Bayes and Logistic Regression). The new models are substantially more accurate than the previous ones. The method achieves good accuracy even with a little dataset.

articleTitle: Automatic Image Segmentation and Feature Extraction of Potato Leaf Disease Using GLCM and HoG Features
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Agricultural production has a significant role in India's economic growth. Agriculture is responsible for over seventy percent of Economic development. As a result, land degradation may result in a significant loss of output, affecting the economy. Plant leaves which are the most vulnerable, display illness indications first. From the beginning of the lifespan until they are ready for harvesting, the commodities must be examined for illnesses. In the proposed work, The pre-processing module is used to process the image at the initial stage and provide clear objects and normalized image content. It helps to enhance the quality of the image. After this, the Second module processes image samples for feature extraction using GLCM and HoG methods and segmentation using Kmeans clustering. This module provides the reduced matrix of the potato leave diseased and non-diseased samples in an optimized manner. Reducing the extracted data module provides less error rate while training and testing the classifier for any category or image sample.

articleTitle: Implementation of Decision Tree with Pruning for Predicting the Outcomes of Myocardial Infarction
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Over the last decade, the fast growing area of artificial intelligence and machine learning has made its vast impact in various fields such as healthcare sector, security, market, image processing, etc. Deep learning has also evolved these days for prediction and forecasting as the performance of the machine learning algorithms does not show good results with large amounts of data. Whereas, Deep learning shows better results and performance with large amounts of data but it requires large computational power. Nowadays, computational power is not the limitation, hence deep learning is at its boost. The healthcare sector is using deep learning techniques for human disease classification, detection, or even predictions related to disease. Our research is also based upon the technique which is known as Decision Trees. The objective of our research is to predict the various outcomes of Myocardial Infarction (commonly known as a heart attack) using the Decision Trees but also using one more technique to improve the accuracy of prediction and this technique is known as Pruning. This is a type of Cardiovascular disease which affects the blood vessels as well as the heart. Cardiovascular diseases cause deaths in large numbers globally. Due to Cardiovascular diseases, nearly 17.9 million people died in 2019 in which heart attack and stroke were the main reasons for 85% of deaths. A heart attack which is also known as Myocardial Infarction causes damage to the heart muscles because of the decrease in the flow of blood or when the flow of blood completely stops to the coronary artery of the heart.

articleTitle: A Study on Solar Forecasting using Artificial Neural Networks Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In last few years, Renewable energy plays a vital role in domestic and industrial sector. It helps to meet electrical requirements in all sectors. In this, solar forecasting plays an important role for its balancing and smooth operation. It is done by use of PV plants. Lot of models have been developed and methods have been described related to solar forecast and its benefits. This work also provides study on these techniques provided by various researchers in this area. These renewable sources forecasting plays an important role in power system operations. The literature is presented in detail with its performance parameters. This helps to identify key findings related to these fields and some improvement scope for further work. This work also helps to provide study related to ANN effectiveness for solar forecasting and how much it is useful for generating better results. Studies also show that proper selection of model will help to improve accuracy of system.

articleTitle: A Survey on IOT Botnets and their Detection Approaches
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The Internet consists of multiple interconnected systems/networks, one of which being the Internet of Things (IoT). Despite their flexibility, numerous IoT devices are technically weak in terms of security, making them a prime target for a variety of security breaches, including botnet assaults. IoT applications in the smart city are currently being targeted by advanced persistent threats (APT). Botnets are a piece of malware that permits hackers to take control of several systems and carry out destructive operations. IoT-based botnet assaults have become increasingly common as a result of the development of IoT gadgets, which are more readily hacked than desktop PCs. To combat this new danger, new methods for identifying attacks initiated from infected IoT devices and distinguishing between day and milliseconds duration IoT-based assaults must be developed. The goal of this study was to find, evaluate, and present a comprehensive overview of experimental works on IoT botnet detection research. The detection methods used to detect IoT botnets, the botnet stages, and the botnet stealth strategies were all investigated in this study. The writers examined the nominated study as well as the major approaches used in it. The authors analysed the botnet stages when detection is done and categorised the detection methods depending on the strategies utilized. In this study approach was utilised to provide a core understanding of IoT botnet malware detection techniques The authors examined current research gaps and proposed future research topics as a consequence of this investigation.

articleTitle: General Purpose Computing on Graphics Processing Units: From Fixed-Function Pipelines to Programmable Cores
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Nowadays, there is a huge demand for high-performance applications that require massive parallel operations that far exceed the capabilities of traditional CPUs. On the other hand, the rapid increase in performance and programmability of Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) has evolved these hardware units into the general-purpose computing field, placing the GPU at the heart of many high-performance applications. Despite the fact that programmers have access to thousands of general-purpose graphical processors, choosing the right device with specific features will play a significant role in the final decisions regarding the results obtained. Because NVIDIA has been a pioneer in changing the architecture of its GPUs to perform general-purpose tasks, we present all GPU architectures developed by NVIDIA Corporation over the last two decades in this paper. We will also look at the major hardware differences along with all the software platforms and solutions that have been introduced in these architectures. This survey should be of particular interest to researchers who are interested in using NVIDIA’s GPUs for developing their high-performance applications.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Image Deblurring: A Comparative Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this paper a comprehensive survey of all deblurring techniques has been presented. Basically, we have presented the classified techniques as: Non- Blind Deblurring and Blind Deblurring. We have started with MLP under Non-Blind Category, and surveyed several techniques with increasing order of complexity. Thereafter several Deep-Learning based techniques for Blind-Deblurring have been discussed including GAN. In our comparison we have presented a comparison of recent deblurring techniques across various parameters. This survey is aimed at providing the drawbacks and benefits of various techniques for deblurring and hope to serve as reference for the practitioners of this field.

articleTitle: Phishing URL Detection Using Machine Learning: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Phishing is a kind of social engineering attack with the intention to lure the victim to give up their personal data such as financial information to the attackers through malicious websites which appear as a legitimate source. Attackers are coming up with new techniques hence detection of such links has become a crucial concern. Since most of the internet users are not able to differentiate between a legitimate website and a malicious one. There are several ways to identify a phishing website but they are extremely time consuming. Machine learning can be used to detect phishing web links. Thus, to mitigate phishing threats, researchers are working on improving the accuracy of phishing detection through a variety of list-based and machine learning-based methods that leverage host information, handcrafted capabilities of URLs and website contents. This work is a survey of latest trends in Phishing URL detection, with a special focus on Machine Learning based approaches.

articleTitle: Assistant Robot With Emotion Detection And Display Abilities Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In recent years, the field of robotics has expanded from the home to the industrial sector, experimenting with a wide range of applications such as entertainment robots, pet sitters, floor and pool cleaners, lawnmowers, and healthcare assistants, to name a few. Robotics advancements lead to improved robot-human interaction, which is still a work in progress. Existing robots still have mechanical voices and most of their responses are preprogrammed. As a result, this becomes a robotics development zone. For a long time, researchers have been working on developing robots with more human-like characteristics, such as voice modulation and emotion display. As a result, it is critical to develop approaches that improve robot friendliness. The survey works on analyzing various virtual assistant models based on artificial intelligence, robotics, convolutional neural network, natural language processing and voice recognition. Furthermore, the work provides a comparative study between the recent researches done in this field, specifically emotion detection, versatile movement, and voice modulation of robot.

articleTitle: A Systematic Study on methods of Spatiotemporal Hotspot Detection and Evaluation metrics
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A Spatial hotspot is a confined region/space inside a geographical area which has a higher concentration of activity points than outside the hotspot region within the study area. With technological breakthroughs in spatial data collection and increased computation capabilities, several research publications presented novel methods for Spatial Hotspot detection. The relationship between Spatial Hotspots and time (temporal effect) has also been investigated by various researchers, expanding the horizon of the spatial hotspot to spatiotemporal hotspot. The idea of Spatiotemporal hotspot detection gained considerable interest among researchers because of its practical utility in public health, public safety, traffic volume analysis, crime zone analysis, and other essential applications. However, it is also vital to analyze the research literature. Our research aims to organize the existing comprehensive literature into a well-organized hierarchical framework to comprehend better the various methodologies widely adopted around the world. We propose a framework that suitably categorizes the research effort of various scholars into several appropriate categories based on their differences in primary algorithmic approaches. Furthermore, we also present an extensive analysis of the widely utilized evaluation measures adopted in this research domain.

articleTitle: Approaching Solutions to Blockchain Security Trilemma and Consensus Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Blockchains have been referred to as revolutions that will enable the processing of data and transactions to move from a centralized party to a high-trust decentralized network of different verifying nodes. This paper represents multiple security factors involved in a successful blockchain and reviews blockchain scalability trilemma of decentralization, security, and speed in consideration with multiple consensus mechanisms with emphasis on performance and security. Further, the paper attempts to introduce Proof of Parity as a better way to run blockchain networks in multiple real-time scenarios. This also sheds light on security concerns in Hyperledger fabric or permissioned blockchains.

articleTitle: The Dynamics of 2S2E-IR Rumor Propagation Model for E-commerce
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this paper, we have proposed a 2S2E-IR rumor propagation model to show how rumor affects the e-commerce by dividing its cyber consumers into two types: steady and radical consumers. Factors like individuals’ connections in social networks, education level, credibility of rumor, fuzziness of rumor and individual’s personality may play vital roles in rumor propagation. Role of these dynamics in rumor spreading process among cyber consumers are described in our model using ordinary differential equations. Epidemic threshold or basic reproduction number of the model is obtained through Next-generation matrix. We obtained the stability of our model using Jacobean matrix. Numerical simulations through MATLAB are performed to validate the vitality of the model developed.

articleTitle: Betterment of Classroom and Examination Performance Using Historical Data - A Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In higher education, understanding, modelling, and forecasting student performance presents considerable hurdles in terms of developing accurate and effective diagnostic models. Several researchers have attempted to construct intelligent classifiers for predicting student accomplishment, but they failed to recognise the necessity of identifying the main components that contribute to the obtained performance. Such recognition is vital for programme directors to evaluate the strengths and limitations of their academic programmes and, as a result, make the required corrections to improve student accomplishment. Consequently, there is room to present a model that improves the accuracy of predicting student academic performance, as measured by future grades in various courses, and, also an optimized multi-label classifier that predicts qualitative values for the influence of various factors on the obtained student performance, primarily using a feed-forward neural network. The goal of the experimental findings are to demonstrate significant gains over single baseline models (e.g., linear regression, matrix factorization), indicating the applicability of the suggested technique in identifying several factors influencing student performance. This study underlines the need of predicting student achievement of learning outcomes in future studies. Along with this, another model that proved to be precise and accurate in predicting the outcome in a similar but not identical scenario, was the KNN classifier, which used data to classify the graduation chances of students. Using the classifiers in the data sets, there are several analyses that can be covered in terms of question pattern, format, and more. This study aims to push a new service that can be established in several organizations and locations to benefit educational professionals and students. The datasets are naturally created in the course of the university’s classes. This allows for a lot of flexibility in terms of output variables and classifiers. Along with this, using PyCharm or another Python based IDE and Python’s built in packages and libraries to perform the analyses and build the neural models. This allows for widespread application and use.

articleTitle: A Survey on Advanced Text Recognition and Projection in Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Augmented Reality (AR) is a technology that overlays a computer-generated image on a user’s view of the real world, thus providing a combined view. Artificial Intelligence (AI) has been used in various sectors such as gaming, manufacturing, military, and law enforcement systems. With the rapid growth of augmented reality development tools and the expansion of their functionality over the years, developers have started believing that with the application of augmented reality for AI developers can create an artificial intelligence-based app that can perform all basic tasks such as adapting to different environments. The survey focuses on studying and comparing different methods and approaches of Augmented Reality and text/image identification and mapping techniques to further combine both the approaches to achieve the end goal of obtaining AR Projections from the recognized text. The process will involve the following steps which are Handwritten text Recognition and extraction using multi model CTC. Emotion and Sentiment Analysis for text mapping and recognition using BiLSTM and SENN, Image Generation using XMC-GAN and then finally converting 2D images to 3D using COLF making it ready for the final Augmented Reality projection.

articleTitle: Improving Medical Predictions with Label Noise Tolerant Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Supervised machine learning algorithms depend crucially on availability of a large pool of correctly labelled instances. However many real world datasets may contain noisy features and label values. This is even more problematic for medical datasets since noise can be asymmetric (class dependent) due to imprecise class definitions or subjective human biases during data collection. There is easy availability of a large pool of unlabelled instances which can’t be directly used for training, for example raw data from medical devices like fitness trackers, data from health surveys etc. Labelling them (with respect to certain task) with the help of human experts might be a time consuming and a costly process. Besides, learning algorithms trained on noisy datasets can reduce the quality of future inferences making them unsuitable for business use-cases. In this paper we propose a semi-supervised learning based approach where we combine information embedded in unlabelled and incorrectly labelled instances with a very small set of correctly labelled instances. To the best of our knowledge this is the first work based on semi-supervised learning for reducing the noise in generated predictions using imperfect datasets. It is demonstrated through extensive experimentation using a medical diagnostic diabetes dataset, that by using only a fraction of correctly labelled instances, we are able to generate high quality predictions on unseen data.

articleTitle: Delay Threshold Mechanism for Detection of Malicious Nodes in Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: IoT based Smart grid technologies have transformed the way of producing and distributing energy. These technologies allow utility operators to evaluate usage accurately and to obtain energy in the cheapest rates. Energy users with the help of IoT smart grid applications can monitor energy consumption more effectually and manage their energy usage by reducing usage and the requirement for more set-up. The Internet of Things is the network having self-configuration. The malicious nodes can trigger several attacks in this network. In the denial-of-service attack, malevolent node floods unlimited number of packets on the victim node. To detect this type of attacker motes in the network threshold-based mechanism is introduced. The proposed mechanism will check the delay of the path and if the network is increased then the threshold value then the node in the path which is increasing delay, detected as the attacker mote. NS2 is applied to deploy the introduced mechanism. Different parameters such as delay, packet-loss and throughput are considered to analyze the outcomes.

articleTitle: Intelligent Digital Ledger Voting System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The proposed methodology concentrates on the development of an approach which allows the voters to vote to their constituency from any booth participating in that particular election. It uses concepts of blockchain to realize a remote voting experience for the voters which will prove to be a relief for migrants and a less exorbitant system in terms of manpower. User Interface is provided using web application and Aadhar biometric authentication has been used to furnish the voter authentication machinery.The proposed approach is not only able to handle network attacks by intruders, data hampering attacks, client- side attacks, server-side data breach etc. But also ensures that the electoral procedures strictly follow the set of rules led down by the constitution of India.

articleTitle: Mobile terminal and Inspection Station Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Time and Money are the two things which are ruling the world. But there are many other things that have been focused on saving, such as deforestation, which is caused by the killing billions of trees, we are proposing an application that can save a lot of time, money, and paper. It is an online discovery platform where customers can find the menu of a restaurant or the list of products of the shop which they visit, place orders and pay online directly and collect the items by showing the bill generated on our mobile. Internet and mobile application are the main channels utilized for the entire cycle for clients to put in a request and furthermore to choose the appropriate shop. This can save tons of paper by generating bills online. Once the application is launched the complete data will be updated when the stock arrives, later it keeps a calculation and notifies the seller when the item is going to finish. The buyer can check the items available in the shop from his home itself, place an order, and a bill will be automatically generated. So, until he arrives at the shop the item will be perfectly packed hence the person can show the bill which is generated in his mobile and get his item from the counter. This purposed work facilitates both buyers and sellers. The buyer can check the menu and also the special deals provided by the sellers to get a maximum discount. But in the case of the seller, the application does the entire work like Billing, making a List of Items Left and Sold, and maintain the complete database. In restaurants, it directly gets an order from Costumer sitting at the table and generates the bill in the application. So, the seller can have limited staff working which can save a lot of money. Due to the technology, the major crowd issue which our country is facing can be reduced in just a few months of awareness. Hence this single application can save a lot of Time, Money, Paper, and also resolve the major crowd issue.

articleTitle: Predicting Loan Grant using Feed Forward Neural Nets and SGD optimizer
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In our day to day life, as we can witness there are innumerable amount of people who are seeking for loan from some or the other banking organizations/institutions to achieve or fulfill their demands for some or the other things. Hence with the scope with increasingly good amount of giving loan to individuals/groups it becomes a tedious job for all the institutions to lend their precious assests to them, so this study/research is based on to curb these issues/efforts from the banking Ins or Org. This would help them to pick who should be the best candidate to pick for loan worthiness. How this could be achieved is by assessing the candidates past records based on what all could be the factors which would affect them to predict the most accurate result. This research would be beneficial for the BIns. So that they would know already whether the candidate would be able to repay the said amount on a proper schedule and also not forgetting to mention which would also preserve the dignity and reputation. The most important, tremendously crucial and critical aspect for these banking Ins, largely depends on the profit and the net revenue. There already exists a significant amount of under performing anomalies which are responsible for keeping across the reputation of Bins. At stake. For this research we have described a full fledged way to forecast and predict the mortgage loan risk, appropriate model has been devised using the NN model. How the data is being assessed largely depends on what all personal and financial information that the candidate has provided, nothing as far as the important factors based on to analyse the loan defaulters are taken into consideration and other personal information is discarded and unasked. The data set has been used to train and analyse the NN model which would be used in the research. Depending upon the outcomes, it is evident that this model outdoes most of the other models which are widely used by the financial institutions for the same usecases.

articleTitle: Managing Events: The IoT Way
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The concept of IoT in the current world where speed, accuracy and efficiency are of a high importance, can do wonders if implemented in a structured manner, into a machine, project, hardware, idea which can improve technology. So, IoT has its application in the Events. Events can be of many types and there is a need of man power to handle the events efficiently. People gather in huge numbers if there is a political event, whereas there is limited audience in a cultural show or less people in a marriage function. Any of such events, if handled smartly, can ease the tasks of humans, as well as provide speed and accuracy and ensure proper event management and organization. This project demonstrates a hardware for the entry-exit of people for any event, through the technology of Radio Frequency Identification (RFID), Wireless Fidelity (Wi-Fi), and main heart as ESP 8266 Controller. The software simulation in Cisco Packet Tracer shows a general event organization related to a hotel or government-based area, where different sections are integrated to control and handle the event in a smart way. The use of RFID indicates the contactless operation for monitoring the attendee entry-exit, due to the current COVID-19 protocols. So, such systems are safe and smart to execute.

articleTitle: An Efficient CL-Signature scheme over NTRU Lattices
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The advantages of key escrow and certificate management features over a public key, and identity-based infrastructure has led to extensive use of the CL-Signature in ebusiness, e-government, and programming security to address these underlying issues. Numerous CL-Signature techniques have been proposed based on the elliptic curve, RSA, and chaos. However, the majority of them are vulnerable to attacks using quantum computing. But in quantum time, the lattice-based CL-Signature technique is safe. Therefore, the CL-Signature Scheme, suggested in this study and shown to be secure in post-quantum environments, is implemented on the NTRU lattice. Additionally, the novel approach is more efficient than earlier lattice-based CL-Signature schemes.

articleTitle: Coverage Hole Detection with Image Analysis and Heuristic for healing
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Coverage holes in WAN are of significant issue. They reduces impact overall performance of WAN. Early detection of coverage holes in a ROI thus has great significant as it helps to plan a healing strategy. Various detection approaches has been proposed in earlier papers however they are all computationally intensive or require prior knowledge of the sensor location. In this paper we propose a image analysis based hole detection approach. The method has the advantage that it require minimum prior knowedge of the ROI and can be used in non homogenous ROI. The information extracted from the detection is used as heuristic to heal larger holes in ROI quickly. The algorithm has similar performance to existing algorithms as the no of sensors reaches 50 however has a better performance as the sensor count increase beyond 50.

articleTitle: An approach to improve analysis of product reviews using sentiment analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Customer’s opinion holds a lot of importance for the business to succeed. The reviews and the ratings obtained are helpful to analyse the products and improve the marketing strategy for the products and gain profits. The conventional methods used for the product reviews include the star ratings system and textual feedback of the product. The latter is more descriptive and reliable and better in terms of providing genuine feedback of the product. This paper discusses and implements the sentiment analysis using Naïve Bayes model to obtain the sentiment rating of the product, later, sarcasm detection using Sequential model is integrated to obtain and improve the overall sentiment rating of the product. An aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) is also integrated to analyse the product on various aspects. This methodology will help sellers and customers to save time and understand how a particular product is performing in the market. The results obtained will help them gain a clear understanding that if the product is a success or not.

articleTitle: Hotel Recommendation System Based on Customer’s Reviews Content Based Filtering Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Recommendation systems are fantastic tools for remembering people's ideas in order to gain knowledge more efficiently and selectively. Recently, booking and searching for hotels online has become more common. As it takes more time, online hotel research is growing more quickly. In addition, the amount of knowledge accessible online is continuously expanding. User preferences have a big impact on hotel recommendations. The most effective recommendations may be made by recommendation systems by utilising historical user preference data. To solve this problem, recommender systems have suggested content-based filtering methods. Product recommendations, recommendations for websites, news articles, restaurants, and TV series are all examples of applications for content-based recommender systems. The dataset for this project includes client evaluations of the offered Kaggle profile. Word embedding, word2vec, and TF-IDF natural language processing methods were used for feature extraction. The algorithm shows the user the top 10 suggested hotels based on the user's past knowledge of the hotel's location.

articleTitle: Predicting Person’s Pay using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The research paper is able to forecast a person's pay after a given year or even for the Fresher. Our model aims to provide a better opportunity to both college students and working professional in terms of the pay they will receive after graduation. This model could couple with the organization's pay database or Universities Placement Database (UPD) and then use it for further training and enhancements. Then, it makes a prediction of whether he would make 50K a month or not.People can also use this model to predict if they are working on the correct wage as per the Industry’s Current Demand, and also the fresher or undergraduates could see what skills to work upon to be able to get maximum package & Growth from the company. Our Dataset currently consists of 49000 rows and 8 features. This model uses Random Forest Classification for prediction.

articleTitle: Visualization of Traffic Density on Graph using Trajectory Data
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Several applications collect users’ trajectory data to provide better location-based services. Since the data reveals the mobility of the users as a group and as an individual, publishing this trajectory data may pose a threat to one’s privacy. The current trajectory data mining procedures take all the raw information from the trajectory data without considering the users’ privacy. This type of data mining can be prone to linkage attacks. This research proposes a novel mechanism that uses OpenStreetMap and its geo-entities recognition feature to extract and cluster the traffic signals to form vertices of a graph. From the trajectory data, vehicle type and the edge in the graph is determined. The vehicle count for each vehicle type on the edge of a graph is iteratively updated and it is visually represented on the respective road edge between two junction vertices. The visualization of the weighted road network graph enables analysts to infer useful information as the road graph itself preserves the statistical information of the road density but hides the individual users’ trajectory.

articleTitle: Web Scraping & Automation Bot Using Python : Using Python to automate all the tasks
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This research Paper is the work of our Automation Framework using Python which aims to provide a completely automated solution by automating each and every functionality and how the concept of automation has changed the traditional software working and processing. As technology usage is increasing, web applications can be automated to provide efficient services to more customers that saves time. Automation will provide two types of services, public and private where in public service data or information is available to each and every user but private information is only for the user inside the organization.

articleTitle: Detection Of Ships in Satellite Imagery Using Deep Neural Networks with Transfer Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With increasing trade and globalization of businesses, there is also an increasing need for an efficient, reliable and robust system for Naval Security, especially for a peninsular country like India. The developing technology and publicly available remote sensing data can be a great solution to this. The focus of this paper is to implement a Deep Neural Network model using transfer learning approach.

articleTitle: Review On Image based Coffee Bean Quality Classification: Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Specialty coffee’s demand is growing worldwide as coffee drinkers continue to look for the freshest and highest-quality flavors. Depending upon the quality, there are two categories in the coffee industry, that is specialty coffee and commodity/commercial coffee. Coffee beans are graded via visual inspection and cupping. A 300g sample of green coffee beans is used for visual assessment, and faulty beans are counted. As per the ‘Specialty Coffee Association of America’ (SCAA), defect can be either primary or secondary. For a coffee to be a specialty, it should have less than 5 secondary defects and zero primary defects. In this survey we have presented the coffee bean quality-related research which includes various machine learning approaches in classifying the coffee beans. The study has achieved quite promising prediction accuracies and was evaluated with test data. We have done a study on coffee bean quality classification and are willing to contribute an arabica coffee bean dataset and detection of coffee bean quality using transfer learning with higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Dynamic And Transient Voltage Stability Analysis with Integration of Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The importance of renewable energy resources (RES) is rising continuously due to the continuous depletion of fossil fuels. One of the best solutions for creating environmentally friendly electricity generation is RES. The most well-known and often used renewable energy source is wind energy. This study examines how including large-scale wind farms affects dynamic voltage stability and transient stability of power systems. This study examines the loadability improvement of the power system on various buses as well as determines the maximum penetration of wind energy. According to the results of the simulation, adding wind farms to the electricity grid improves the loadability and transient stability of a power system. IEEE 14 bus system is selected for this study. It is one of the standardized systems that accurately represents practical systems, and the results are quite similar to practical systems. Power System Analysis Toolbox (PSAT) is used to simulate the system in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Food Safety Checking Measures by Artificial Intelligent IOT
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Agriculture is a vital commodity for developing countries like India, concerns itself with food safety and food security. Agricultural practices should ensure that food products are healthy for consumption and sustainable to the environment, while maintaining or even increasing the production quantities to provide for the growing population. The smart farming technologies and organic farming allows the improvements of food safety and security at the same time. The food industry is continuously challenged by the occurrences of food borne diseases. This system aims at eliminating the loss of food that is fit for consumption by humans during the storage and passage of the food chain. Food chain typically starts from the farm where it is harvested and then transported to the store houses and then to markets and finally ends up in your table. While there are multiple factors in ensuring food safety, this system aims at monitoring pathogenic presence and controlling the spread of these pathogens to minimise the loss by using Internet of things or (IoT) systems which is a low-cost solution to farmers to monitor the pathogens in the food remotely . This system helps to optimize the cost of food for the user and maximizes the benefit to farmers

articleTitle: Drone Automation: An Overview of Recent Progress and Research
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The recent techno-trend is frequently including drones one way or the other. These have attracted increasing attention due to usage in communications, photography, agriculture, surveillance and numerous public services and many more vast ranges of applications. But still, there had been a minimal effort of including these automated drones in commercial or general usage. These applications range from greater yet simpler applications such as grocery shopping, pet care taking, and babysitting to sophisticated applications such as surveillance and security.This paper is a direct implication to answering these commercial and general requirements with the help of automated drones. We aim to propose a collaboration between a drone and machine learning so that the drones are automated to move on their own. The IoT device in the drone is loaded with a machine learning algorithm that can identify and distinguish between faces and track them and drone mechanics to make drones move accordingly. Built-in with the power of object recognition and automatic navigation, the drone can follow a distinguishable object, either as a part of surveillance or assistance. With photography and video graphy becoming an integral part of everyone’s lives, this drone can help film sports videos and professional cinematography.

articleTitle: A Novel approach for Brain Tumor Segmentation using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The process of segmenting brain tumors is very important for a number of different uses, including clinical practice, medical imaging, and medical research. Because of an MRI scan, we are able to segment the brain tumor and identify any abnormal growth of tissues that may be present in the image. The planning of therapy is an essential component in enhancing the overall quality of life of oncological patients. In this research study, we suggest the use of the Hybrid Fuzzy C Mean (HFCM) and the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for the purpose of segmenting the brain tumor. The area-of-interest in the multimodal MRI scans, and then to extract some seed points from there for use in region growth based on an HFCM. Image pre-processing, HFCM for locating the Region of interest, and CNN for segmenting the tumor make up the three stages that comprise the proposed technique.

articleTitle: Moringa Oleifera As An Alternative to Conventional Coagulants in Big Data and Data Science Analytics
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Ever since the population explosion began postmodern industrialization since 1950 the population has grown more than threefold. With the global population crossing the Benchmark of 8.0 billion in June 2022, while some nations reap the benefits of progress, there are still nations who face the challenges of a pre-industrialized world, even today there is a quarter of world Population that does not have access to safe and clean drinking water. In this paper, conventionally, treatment of water is carried out with the help of Chemical Coagulants (Primarily Alum), several research have linked the usage of Alum with Neurodegenerative Diseases like Alzheimer's. Hence the need arises to develop a suitable alternative, Seeds of Moringa Oleifera also known as miracle tree due to its Phytochemical Properties contain Mo-CBP3-4 a protein that causes adsorption and neutralization of the colloidal charges thereby clarifying the water, For high initial Turbidity waters the optimal Dosage was the same for Moringa Oleifera (50mg/l) and the sludge produced post treatment is not only innocuous but also three to four times less by volume when compared with Alum and specially we use big data for data analysis.

articleTitle: Face Detection and Recognition with improved accuracy using Principal Component Analysis and comparing with Symlet algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to analyse the performance of the principal component analysis (PCA) method and the SYMLET algorithm when it comes to detecting and recognising faces with a high degree of accuracy. G-power is a tool that determines the total number of samples necessary for good face detection utilising the PCA and SYMLET algorithm. When certain parameters, such as minimum power, acceptable error rate, and allocation ratio, are held constant at 0.8, 0.05, and 1 respectively, a total of 256 samples can be produced from the experiment. It has been determined that PCA has an accuracy of 96.97%, and SYMLET has an accuracy of 52.63% correspondingly. There is a significant difference of 0.03 between the two groups (p less than 0.05). It has been determined from the findings of this research that the PCA algorithm detects faces in a substantially more accurate manner than the SYMLET algorithm does.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based E-Voting System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In our research on blockchain, we implemented the e-voting system using blockchain technology. We used this technology in a web application that will be using Django (a python web-based framework). The purpose of the proposed work is to articulate our proposal to resolve digital voting issues through blockchain. Today Voting in a democracy is an important and critical event for any country. The usual way in which a country votes is with a paper system, but conducting elections with such traditional way and that too in 21st century when technology is so advance does not sound great. Thus, there is a strong need to replace the traditional system with a modern and more reliable and secure digital voting systems. Digital voting is the use of electronic devices, such as voting machines or an Internet browser, to vote. This is sometimes referred to as e-voting when voting using a machine at the polling station, and voting via e-web browser. Digital voting security is always a major concern when you are considering using a digital voting system. When implemented such systems there in no requirement to think for data protection like protecting it from potential attacks. One way such security issues are solved using blockchain technology.[10]

articleTitle: Improved Deep Learning Framework for Segmenting and Classifying Skin Lesions using K-nearest neighbor algorithm and Multi-Instance Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The biggest organ that is present in the human body, which generally covers all the major body parts.The functions of skin in the human body are more significant, since even a little alteration in one of these functions could have an impact on other body components. Skin is more susceptible to disease and infection because it is exposed to the outside environment. Therefore, we must pay more attention to skin diseases. Lesion areas refer to the affected area of skin. The initial clinical indications of diseases like chickenpox, melanoma, etc. are skin lesions. Today, computer-aided diagnosis is more prevalent in the medical industry. For the automation of many operations in the medical profession, machine learning is crucial. It has been shown that dermoscopy, in the hands of untrained dermatologists, may actually reduce the diagnostic accuracy. There are other illnesses that are equally important in the medical community. Therefore, in addition to the diseases stated above, we also take into account two other diseases, bullae and shingles. The characteristics utilized to characterize the lesion locations are an additional crucial factor. For this, we take into account aspects of color and texture. The learning algorithms are a further topic that needs to be considered. Although there are many classifiers in use, fusion of the results of different classifiers is rapidly gaining prominence since it helps improve categorization. The final outcome the author wants is to use both the algorithms and find a novel accuracy and comapare both of them.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Vehicle Quality Performance using Logistic Regression in Comparison with RBF SVM to measure the Accuracy, Recall and Precision
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: By contrasting the effectiveness of Logistic regression with that of the RBF SVM algorithm, the purpose of this study is to determine the usefulness of Logistic regression in the identification of vehicle quality. There were a total of 1498 data samples that were downloaded from the UCI repository, with 749 data samples allocated to each of groups 1 and 2, respectively. Data for training (n = 1124, or 75% of the overall sample size) are separated from data for testing (n = 374, or 25% of the total sample size). A clinical application was used to estimate the minimum number of samples needed for the job. The alpha value was set at 0.05, and the power was set at 80%. In this particular model, Logistic Regression achieved accuracy, recall, and precision of 88.23%, 87.43%, and 88.95% respectively, in contrast to the RBF SVM algorithm's results of 74.52%, 76.04%, and 74.68%. The significance of the model is determined to be p = 0.102, which is less than 0.05. In the present investigation, Logistic Regression demonstrated noticeably superior performance than the RBF SVM classifier in the identification of car quality.

articleTitle: Hybrid Classification Approach with Textural Feature Analysis for Plant Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The significant task of image processing in the domain of plant disease is of diagnosing the diseases occurred on plants because much complicated data is employed as input. Different stages are executed to detect the plant diseases using several techniques. The earlier work suggests SVM technique for diagnosing plant infections. This work projects a voting mechanism to improve various parameters like accuracy, precision and recall in comparison with the traditional methods. The projected mechanism was simulated using MATLAB. An analysis is conducted on the results with regard to some metrics. The outcomes exhibited that the projected mechanism is more effective as compared to other method. The proposed model achieves accuracy of 96 percent which approx. 3 percent higher as compared to existing SVM classifier.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation: A Review of Payroll Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Payroll process is a vital method in an organization it involves many tasks to correct and do payments of the workforces' services, and to protect organization's reputation through effective recordkeeping compliance with the government authorities and employment legislations. Despite its main function among the organization methodology is studies on payroll process as compared to other transaction processing systems like sales and purchase. This analysis study aims to produce insights into the characteristics of the matter related with payroll system by using a bibliometric analysis.

articleTitle: Home Automation System Based on Android
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In today's modern era, automation further enhances our ability to work and gives us comfort. As we see in today's era almost all human beings have become accustomed to mobile phones and smart gadgets. We can therefore use a mobile phone to do some household chores with the help of his companion. In this paper, we will explore the increasing demand for home security. We are going to representing Android Based Automation System by which we can maintain our home security. Through which we will be able to control and monitor many appliances of our homes. The proposed system is more flexible, scalable and cost-effective than the commercial home automation systems available in the market.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of queueing assisted Blockchain system
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Researchers, engineers, and institutions have given blockchains a lot of attention in recent years. The implementation of blockchains has begun to revive many applications ranging from e-finance and e-healthcare to smart homes and the Internet of Things, social security, and logistics, among other things. In this article, a queuing-assisted blockchain system is offered as a means of better understanding the functioning and theoretical elements of blockchain technology. It is possible to utilize the suggested system to represent a diverse range of queueing-assisted blockchain-based systems in a variety of applications. This paper replicated the transaction confirmation process of a blockchain system with a miner to better understand how the blockchain system works. Factors such as unfavorable transactions in the mining process are also considered. Here we consider the M/M/1 queueing assisted blockchain system. The analytical model validation was carried out using the software packages MATHEMATICA 9 and MAPLE 18 in order to investigate the findings obtained through queueing model.

articleTitle: Using Prediction Based Approaches to Improve Diagnostic Accuracy for BreastCancer
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Diagnosis BC is a tremendous challenge in the medical domain. In ongoing exploration, the classification of imbalanced dataset certainly stands out enough to be noticed. Imbalanced classification reduces the model's performance by favoring the majority class, although we used a balanced dataset called "Diagnostic Wisconsin BC" in this research. To measure the performance, we compared the different ML algorithms. In order to deploy ML techniques the dataset was divided into train and test data. The hyper tuning settings wereemployed to boost the models' accuracy. Further the ML algorithms compare with the ensemble-based learning techniques like voting classifier, bagging and boosting. Thesecond important part of this article is feature selection for diagnosing BC based on the tumor traits chosen.

articleTitle: A Review on Data Offloading Paradigms in Internet of Things (IoT)
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With the advent of new technologies in modern era, Internet of Things (IoT) is one of the technologies that have gained tremendous popularity by establishing connection with smart devices and bringing them closer to users. But it is not a piece of cake that can be easily accessed by everybody. It has various challenges associated with it like traffic congestion, battery exploitation, loss of bandwidth, delay in latency and many others. Various studies have been conducted to overcome these challenges. One of the most common techniques is Data Offloading. It is the transfer of certain tasks to rich devices to perform execution of tasks with minimum delay. In addition to this, when server reaches the maximum capacity of tasks execution, extra tasks are distributed to sensor devices relatively called as ‘Load Balancing’.The paper provides systematic literature review (SLR) on various data offloading approaches conducted in recent years. Besides this, it also discusses criteria and infrastructure requirements for offloading of data.

articleTitle: Securing Image Information with LSB Steganography Technique Using MATLAB Tool
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Digital media may now be easily transmitted via the internet, thanks to advancements in internet technology. As a result, communications can be conveyed discreetly by digital media utilizing the hidden method and then quickly sent into the internet. By encapsulating data in other data, steganography can hide the fact that communication is going place. The proposed system would save the user's created key, reducing the risk of the user losing the key and, as a result, their work. Providing a fluidic solution to the aforementioned issues is widely regarded as a difficult undertaking, which will be addressed in this project. In this paper the main focus is to achieve greater PSNR value and capacity so that there will be less distortion in the image.

articleTitle: Newborn Identification using footprints: Add another line of security
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: People are getting more interested in biometric identification for a variety of reasons. Identification of new born is still a great problem even in this time. Solving this problem could safeguard children from identity theft and fraud, assist in the reunification of lost children with their parents, improve border control systems in the fight against child trafficking, and help electronic document management systems The research presented in this article focuses on biometric strong authentication systems that leverage foot geometry factors. A footprint has three distinct traits that are adequate to identify a person. Different forms of qualities include shape, smoothness, and detail. We analysed the most often used geometrical features of the foot, comprising length, breadth, area, and circumference, to unique information about a person. The axes, major and minor. The categories of features include spatial, smoothness, and delicacy. To uniquely identify persons, we assessed the most often utilised morphological properties of either the foot utilising height, width, region, main pole, and equivalent diameter. Weights are assigned to each feature, highlighting its importance, and several versions of these traits are computed. We chose the best foot summaries and discovered that the province is by far the most important aspect of determining a person's foot. To improve reliability, foot contour characteristics are coupled with foot descriptions. A Gray scale image founder grids relying on Haralick properties are constructed for texturing using Classifier Model as the discriminator. In situations where people remove their shoes, such as holy sites, security checks, private pools, and leisure facilities, foot biometrics can be employed as an extra covert authentication method.

Author Keywords: Biometric are some of the terms used

articleTitle: Computational Algorithm for Performance Observations of ETC based Renewable Energy System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The significance of solar energy is defined and utilized by various applications. Renewable energy utilization using solar thermal collectors has been presented. This study emphasizes the use of solar energy through the substantial utilization in various fields by absorbing the irradiated solar radiation and respective conversion, i.e., thermal energy through optimum collectors (e.g., evacuated tube collector ETC). The performing capabilities of ETCs are observed under the respective environmental circumstances and shown through a generalized representation of a computational algorithm for the performance analysis of the ETC-based renewable energy systems, which will be utilized by feeding the archetypal data in the form of MATLAB programming code to compute the respective output, specifically in terms of different temperatures at various segments of the elements, heat transfer coefficients and the overall yield of the day. It has been observed that the scale deposited meanwhile the operation required proper testing to opt for the best possible cleaning solutions and respective mechanisms, which must be functional periodically to assure enhanced performance through the ETC augmented renewable energy systems.

articleTitle: Spammer Detection Prediction and Identification by ML
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Social networking platforms are used by millions of individuals all around the world. The effects of user interaction with social networking sites like Twitter and Facebook, which are both influential and unpopular in everyday life, are both influential and unpopular. Spammers have turned to well-known social networking sites to disseminate a significant volume of useless and delete able content. For example, Twitter has grown to become one of the most frequently utilized platforms of all time, allowing for a fictitious spam level. Spam detection and false identity detection on Twitter have recently been frequent study topics on modern online social networks (OSNs). We conduct a strategic evaluation in this study to identify persons who publish spam on Twitter. Furthermore, the group of Twitter spam detection algorithms divides them into categories depending on their capacity to trace false content, spam-based URLs, spam on popular subjects, and phone users. The methodologies are also contrasted in terms of other characteristics, such as user, content, graph, layout, and time characteristics. Unwanted tweets by fraudulent users disrupts authorized customers and impedes resource usages. Additionally, the potential to distribute information about phone identities to users has grown, leading in the distribution of inappropriate content.

articleTitle: A weight factor based secure invisible image watermarking using Discrete Cosine Transform
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The rapid growth of the internet and technology laid the stones for the beginning of the globalization era. The exchange of multimedia data like images, videos, and audio over large networks is increasing more rapidly.
