The challenge faced here is to protect ownership rights against thefts and illegal authorities. In such cases, it is imperative to develop security tools to conceal multimedia to safeguard ownership rights. In this article, we proposed an invisible image watermarking methodology to protect the copyrights. The original image is transformed using discrete cosine transform into a frequency domain and 128-bit AES is applied to the copyright image following which embedding is performed using an embedding factor α which is estimated using multiple linear regression. We compare the PSNR of watermarked images with respect to the original image and normalized correlation is used to compare the similarity of the extracted images with respect to the copyright images after different attacks. The results show that the proposed watermarking scheme possesses great robustness against all different attacks.

articleTitle: Analysis Of Dna Sequence Using Quadrature Mirror Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Abstract—Lately, Deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) sequence plays a very significant role in Genomic Signal Processing. Different types of approach such as Short Time Fourier Transform(STFT), Wavelet Transform could used for sequencing and analysis but we have used Quadrature Mirror Filter (QMF) or we can say Multirate approach for analysis. We have used two channel filter banks analysis and synthesis banks. The value of interpolation and decimation factor, DNA sequence are varied and has been analysed. The introduced filter bank has been analysed for different DNA sequences as their input. The particular approach has improved the accuracy of protein coding regions notably.

articleTitle: Two Phase Methodology for the Detection of Malicious Vehicles from Vehicular Ad hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The vehicular ad hoc network is the decentralized form of network in which malevolent user can join the network which can trigger a variety of active and passive attacks. The denial of service is an active type of intrusion that is triggered by the malicious nodes present in the network. This research work introduces a new two-phase methodology for detecting and isolating the attack. In the first phase of the methodology tentative nodes will be analyzed which can be the malevolent nodes. The second phase confirms the nodes as spiteful nodes through the promiscuous mode. NS2 is applied to stimulate proposed technique and certain metrics are considered to compute the results.

articleTitle: A Review of Cryptography Techniques for Securing Data on Messaging and Cloud Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Within a few years, the Internet has arrived at a level that is starting to affect every aspect of our lives in both good and bad ways. Information security has turned into a primary worry for anybody connected to the web because of repeated attacks and data leaks. Many files/data are getting uploaded/downloaded on the internet. However, securing such data/files has not been given much importance in the past as not many people were using the internet. There was less amount of sensitive data to attack and steal. Message encryption techniques have been used by various messaging service apps, but they also fail to secure files, emoji and stickers shared through these apps. Some people use the cloud to store and share their files but these cloud services have also been victims of data leaks. Therefore providing critical information to these 3rd party clouds is not the best solution. In this paper, we are analyzing the current encryption techniques used for secure files and message transfer with their advantages and disadvantages.The observations from this research signifies that the most common and used cryptography techniques are not sufficient to safeguard the files. Developers need to bring advanced techniques into the mainstream by implementing them in messaging apps and cloud servers. People should have a right to privacy and should be taught how to implement cryptography.

articleTitle: Human Activity Recognition with Video Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR), is a broader place of research area concerned with recognition and motion of someone primarily based totally on information obtained from one-of-a-kind sensors. Movements are the one-of-a-kind activities executed inside or outdoors, which include running, jumping, waving, and reading. There also are different activities which includes cleaning, eating, and riding a car. The goal is to document sensor information and the corresponding actions performed by a particular subject, to form a model primarily based on the provided information, and what's more, to sum up the model to order the activities of a completely new, inconspicuous informational collection in view of the sensor data.

articleTitle: Blood Donation System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The goal of the Blood Donation System project is to build an e-Information system about the donors and organization involved in blood and plasma donation. The recipient can use this application to search online for registered donors for the blood type or plasma that they require. If matched, the registered donors contacts and location would be displayed and the recipient can come directly in contact with the donor. It would be like a bridge between the recipient and donor where the recipient or the close relative of recipient can directly contact the donors. The recipient can also be verified by the donor as he/she is required to upload the prescription and hospital details as well. The basic aim to create this application is to create a hassle-free environment for the recipient in the time of need and save lives lost due to unavailability of blood or plasma.

articleTitle: Enhancing Node Lifetime in Wireless Sensor Networks using ITDMS with APTEEN Protocol
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) applications are expanding every day, and wireless sensor networks are being used to access a variety of applications and resources. Furthermore, while fast adoption of wireless sensor networks enhances network usage, it suffers from power shortages owing to the low active power of wireless sensor nodes. A variety of power management techniques have been tried to enhance lifespan maximization; however they all have flaws in terms of quality and effectiveness. An Improved Time Division Multi attribute Sleep (ITDMS) protocol using the popular APTEEN algorithm has indeed been explored in this study to address this issue. Cluster formation was accomplished using the APTEEN protocol, and the suggested approach exchanges info about the status with its neighbors at every data collecting time slot. The technique selects the condition using approximation based on neighbor information, neighbor's power parameters, as well as its own metrics. The technique determines the condition and shifts its mode among sleep and wake up depending on the approximated level. With a total throughput of 98.4%, the suggested technique extends the life of WSNs and increases data collecting efficiency.

articleTitle: Self Defence and Safety Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In the modern world, the safety of women has been compromised. Domestic violence, sexual assault, and murder against women are more common than they are supposed to be. Women’s safety is a major concern in India and there are many laws and measures in place to stop them, but the number of such incidents is only increasing by the day. This is not just limited to women as men face a lot of harassment too. In response to these problems, we aim to create a smart safety device that provides some security to the user. Many such smart devices are already available in the market but are not proven to be effective and often provide serious damage to the attacker. We aim to create a safety device that is capable of alerting the user or taking actions automatically without or with very little involvement from the user to activate it. This helps when there is a situation where the user doesn’t get enough time to react. Different models available are analysed and the proposed solution is explained in detail. The drawbacks and future works are also included in the article.

articleTitle: Development of Agricultural Productivity through Realtime Weather Prediction over IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Climate is a significant component in day-to-day existence and has a significant influence in numerous exercises like cultivating, industry and so on So in some cases, it could be an outright need to be familiar with quick climate conditions. Notwithstanding, the current ways of getting to climate projection are through TV or utilizing mass frameworks, the two of which are not unequalled accessible or advantageous. This paper is intended to make a model framework that considers distinctive climate factors and make them accessible to client by various strategies. Various elements incorporate temperature, dampness, pressure, light force and precipitation. The IoT (Internet of Things) technology used in this research allows for effective access to weather conditions as the feature which is easy to carry around. Different sensors were used to gather information, which is then communicated to the Microprocessor, that serves as a ground station. It sends data to the cloud server via built-in Wi-Fi, and the data is processed and displayed on the server. By and large, this work is savvy and has low influence utilization to set aside cash just as power use.

articleTitle: Emoji Classification using Random Forest Classifier
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The automatic classification of emotions based on emojis is used in several applications such as social media platforms like Twitter are able to communicate their thoughts on a subject. Emojis are visual symbols that are used to express feelings and emotions on social media. This paper will address the development of an automated learning model that allows the classification of emotions in emojis and small texts in English using Bag of Words (BoW), Ngrams, and VADER sentiment scores. Further emoji images are processed with Gabor wavelet to get the features for training with a Random Forest (RF) classifier. To obtain different emotions, different emoji images are further classified using an RF classifier. The suggested technique achieves 94.59% classification accuracy.

articleTitle: A Novel Prediction Analysing the False Acceptance Rate and False Rejection Rate using CNN Model to Improve the Accuracy for Iris Recognition System for Biometric Security in Clouds Comparing with Traditional Inception Model
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The main motivation of the study is to improve the Novel Prediction of accuracy using the Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) model system for iris recognition biometric security in clouds and comparing with Traditional inception models (TIM). Accuracy to perform two groups CNN model and Traditional Inception Models (N=10) to calculate and find the comparison value of accuracy. G power 80% threshold 0.05%, 95% confidence interval mean and standard deviation The independent sample T-test was used Convolutional Neural Networks and TIM. CNN (92%) performs better than TIM (60%). There is a statistically relevant disparity between the CNN and TIM transform based on comparison ratio data is 0.048 (p<0.05). The result shows the proposed CNN algorithm has the better accuracy compared to TIM algorithm.

articleTitle: IoT Based Coal Mine Safety Monitoring and Alerting System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Coal mine accidents are becoming more common. Many skilled workers and labourers have died. There is no early warning system in place to detect the alarming cause of coal mine accidents and issue an alert. In the mining industry, workplace injuries and illnesses are common. Firedamp and residue blasts, landslips, mine flames, and transport and motorization related specialized disappointments are the most well-known reasons for mishaps in coal mining. As per an investigation of word related mishaps with regards to social and financial variables uncovers the genuine reasons for these mishaps, which are said to happen unavoidably because of specialized blemishes or disappointments. To save and shield the specialists from the risks, a robotized disturbing coal mineshaft mishap discovery framework is utilized. This framework utilizes the consolidated activity of a temperature, tension, and gas sensor, as well as an IOT module, to identify the temperature, strain, and climate in the coal mineshaft, as well as to log all information to the cloud utilizing information logging. Then, at that point, through information obtaining, these information are acknowledged by an administrator controlled server page. The information is handled on a server page, and an alarm is shipped off the gadget, which will streak the alert, as well with respect to the concerned authorities and salvage stations, who will go to safeguard lengths.

articleTitle: An Optimum Approach to Indian Sign Language Recognition using Efficient Convolution Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The most important component of every discussion is language, and sign language is the most formal mode of communication for persons who are deaf or mute. Communication, as we all know, is one of the most important components of modern life. The importance of communication is increasing in tandem with our maturation in life. The purpose of this project is to develop a system capable of recognizing all of these signs and serving as a bridge for signers and non-signers to communicate and interpret sign meanings. Technology is rapidly evolving, and now that we have powerful systems, a wealth of data, and a diverse set of sources, we can design a system to assist people with disabilities. We will develop a user-independent framework for automatically recognizing Indian Sign Language in this project, which will allow for feature extraction, recognition, and interpretation of a variety of one-handed, dynamic isolated signals. The two most important and fundamental aspects of SLR research are isolated sign recognition and continuous sign recognition. Hand form, hand position, and so on are the primary hand traits that can be used in sign language. The extra-clung functionality can be implemented in two ways. Either one is tracking-based or it is not. This essay focuses on one such approach that we devised to overcome significant communication barriers. The technique is divided into three stages: pre-processing, texture extraction, and recognition.

Author Keywords: Sign Language using Computer Vision Techniques
Machine Learning approach for Sign Language Recognition

articleTitle: 5G: The Network and it’s future
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The world is continuously moving at a fast pace and so is the technological advancements in it. It is a rule of the planet that there should be continuous improvements and advancements in all realms for the welfare of the mankind. In the recent times due to the pandemic and the Covid-19 virus, the style of living and completing one’s work has changes drastically. The world has become highly virtual in nature. For each work that needs to be completed there are devices all around us and all of us are connected virtually, be it studies, office work, gaming or loads of other errands. There are various components that are crucial to the efficient operation of the virtual world. One important factor among these components is the network that helps us in connecting with one another. The whole system of the virtual world is highly reliable on the speed, bandwidth, and many other factors of the network that the users are using. The mobile network era started with One-G or just the G and currently is moving towards a 5G network. In this paper we will discuss about the 5G network, the technology it uses, the challenges that it is facing and the huge difference that it will bring about in the virtual and technological world.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm based Energy Optimized Clustering Approach for MANETs
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: MANETS have been used to form local networks without any predefined structure and to handle a large number of nodes they have been grouped to form clusters. Every cluster has a CH to maintain the integrity of the cluster. A wide variety of algorithms have been proposed to choose CH among other nodes and one of them is by using heuristics. Heuristics have been used in solving many problems and it has a huge impact on reducing the processing to find approximate results which go in NP time. Many networking problems have been tried to solve with this approach and they can solve the issues such as routing and optimizing. MANETs having multiple wireless nodes facea similar issue which can be solved by forming clusters to reduce network overhead, as these nodes are battery-powered devices having a constraint on power which gives birth to the requirement of an approach that can prolong battery life and hence improve network lifetime. This paper compares LEACH protocol with GA regarding energy constraint and an algorithm is proposed which is based on a combination of GA and LEACH.

articleTitle: Vision Based Vehicle-Pedestrian Detection and Warning System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Road Sense must be respected and obeyed by both the pedestrian and the driver. Moreover, urbanization has led to a steadfast rise in the fleet of vehicles, their speed, as well as non-compliance with road safety measures, and other such factors have provoked an inescapable increase of accidents in road traffic involving pedestrians. Pedestrian collisions can be predicted and prevented. At the very basic, there has to be vehicle and pedestrian detection along with speed estimation, which can be further applied to Vehicle-Pedestrian Collisions and various emerging fields like Industrial Automation, Transportation, Automotive, Security/Surveillance, or in Dangerous environments. This paper reviews the literature on vehicle and pedestrian detection based on two significant categories: pre-processing phase and detection phase, with a detailed comparative analysis. The papers reviewed cover video-based surveillance systems.

articleTitle: Soil Testing using IOT and Machine Learning Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: As we know that agriculture is one of the most important sector and humans are involved in it since the beginning of human civilization. With time and introduction of different tools and technologies modern day agriculture has changed allot. But still humans are lagging behind in or order to meet the need of crops production. Many factors are responsible for this like (i) in appropriate use of fertilizer due to lack of knowledge of soil or land, sometimes farmers don’t know the fertility level of their land and how much fertilizer is required for agriculture as soil fertility mainly depends on NPK values i.e. (Nitrogen, Phosphorous and Potassium), pH value of soil also play an important role(ii) growing of crops depends on the soil type, we can’t grow any cops on any soil e.g. for growing rice we need soil having good amount of moisture content. So, sometimes farmers don’t have the idea of crops which they are growing and which cops they should grow. (iii) proper environmental conditions are required for growing crops like light intensity, humidity, temperature. So, this method tries to solve the problem by recommending suitable crops on the basis of soil type, fertility, pH value, moisture and temperature. These data are collected by sensors of IOT (Internet of Things) device. The data collected are trained using Machine Learning model and then the predicted result is shown on the web application.

articleTitle: A review for identification of mask using Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In computer field security and protection, the recognition of object is very important to take particular action becomes very necessary for making decisions. Due to increase in scientific development in the information, computer vision and programming techniques, which make an image a very important role in multiple zone such as medicine media, education, design, industry, security etc. This proposed system make use of face identification on the basis of dataset and helps in the scenario for detection mask on face, which helps to prevent the spreading of virus at certain level with specific application.

articleTitle: Secure and High-Performance Iot Model For Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The goal of the IoT is to make people's lives easier and more convenient by connecting all of our everyday objects to the web. Research suggests that patients who are unable to go to a medical centre might benefit from using IoT devices at home. Earlier IoT-based research investigated what variables affect the safety of IoT-based healthcare models. The research suggests a method to enhance the efficiency of the security system used in IoT-based healthcare during IDS detection and categorization. Neural-based cognitive processes are integrated with IoT-based healthcare systems to build prescription systems. Accuracy, precision, and recall are all increasing as a result of current studies' efforts. The study also draws parallels between the proposed mechanism and similar ones that have come before it. Depending on the approach used, the research may be put to a number of different uses. In order to categorise and identify new issues that may be used to help address a problem, researchers and data collectors engage in exploratory research and data collection. Empirical research is required to assess whether a solution is achievable given the available data. Experts in the area of healthcare incursion prediction have employed experimental methods, training, and testing procedures to achieve their goals. Researchers monitored efficiency and precision during training and assessment. MATLAB was used as the simulation tool of choice.

articleTitle: Domain adaptation for Hindi to English neural machine translation
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Machine translation is an area to increase the knowledgeable society of Indians without any language barrier.Machine translation (MT) is the procedure by which a fully automated software is applied to translate a source content from one original language (such as English) into target content of another language (such as Spanish) preserving the sense of the input text, and delivering fluent output text in the target language.Neural machine translation (NMT) is a deep learning-based technique for machine translation that provides state-of-the-art translation performance in scenarios where large-scale parallel corpora are available. A model that has already seen comparable sentences is more likely to produce a better translation when automatically translating a sentence. Neural Machine Translation (NMT) scheme that is tailored to that domain will also be the best at translating a domain of sentences. The emphasis of this paper is on domain adaption methodologies for NMT schemes. In this study, we define domain adaptation as any strategy for improving translations for a specific topic or language genre. Adapting model parameters with phrase translations in the area of interest is one example, as is restricting the model output to only produce vocabulary in the domain of interest.

articleTitle: Determining False Positive Analysis of Software Vulnerabilities with Predefined Scan Rules using Random Forest Classifier and Decision Tree Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The primary objective of this study is to develop a method that can accurately forecast novel software vulnerabilities in websites by favouring the Random Forest Classifier (RFC) technique over the Decision Tree Method (DT). With a pretest power of 80%, a threshold of 0.05%, and a confidence interval of 95%, the sample size is computed using the Gpower software and determined to be 10 per group. When it comes to forecasting software vulnerabilities, RFC has a much better accuracy of 97.80% than the DT method, which only has an accuracy of 85.95%. With a significance value of 0.034 (p0.05), the RFC method performs significantly better than the DT algorithm. The RFC method is superior to the DT algorithm in terms of its ability to predict software vulnerabilities.

articleTitle: Challenges of Digital Transformation in Education in India
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Online learning has been present since the 1960s and has risen in popularity over time. World-class universities have been using online teaching-learning methodologies to fulfill the needs of students who reside far away from academic institutions for more than a decade. Many people predicted that online education would be the way of the future, but with the arrival of COVID-19, online education was imposed upon stakeholders far sooner and more suddenly than expected. When the COVID-19 pandemic broke out, educational institutions began to explore digital ways to keep students studying even when they couldn't be together in person as governments enacted legislation prohibiting large groups of people from gathering for any reason, including education. The future of such a transition looks promising. However, transitioning from one mode of education to another is not easy. Historically, when educators adopt new tools, learning still continues in the conventional manner. Based on the responses of 176 students, this paper studies the challenges of Digital transformation in the Education sector. The research is extremely beneficial in evaluating the scope of societal opposition to change.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Approaches For Epilepsy Seizures Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The most prevalent neurological illness is epilepsy, and a precise seizure forecast could make patients feel less uncertain and helpless. Electroencephalograms can be used to diagnose conditions involving the brain, such as epilepsy (EEG). However, manual analysis of EEG data is a method that is known to have relatively low inter-rater agreement and needs highly skilled doctors (IRA). Additionally, manual interpretation is a time-consuming, resource-intensive, and expensive procedure due to the amount of data and the rate at which new data is being made available. Additionally, every institution struggles to find qualified neurophysiologists with the necessary skills to analyse EEG findings. In contrast, by speeding up diagnosis and lowering human error, automated EEG data processing has the potential to enhance patient care. Utilizing technological advancements like deep learning is crucial and can lead to excellent outcomes. We use the TUH Abnormal EEG Corpus to provide the data that Deep Learning requires. Three models are described and trained on the corpus, with each model building on top of the others. The best one achieves a classification accuracy rate of 83.8%. The model makes use of cutting-edge deep learning techniques such densely connected convolutional neural networks, recurrent units, inception modules, and one-dimensional convolution (for speech technology).

articleTitle: FlawFix:Automated Vulnerability Fixing Tool for Open Source Libraries
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In recent years, software applications use open source software (OSS) libraries extensively to speed up the development. These open source software libraries are prone to increasingly prominent vulnerabilities that are publicly disclosed. It is consequently essential for software developers to identify dependencies on vulnerable libraries regularly, to concretely assess their impact, and to alleviate any potential risk. Vulnerability scan and assessment tools, therefore, are being used to keep track of vulnerable dependencies. Various tools are available in the market that scan, assess and provide remediations for various vulnerabilities caused due to open source library dependencies. Manual efforts are required to fix the vulnerabilities once the remediation is provided. Here, in this paper, we are going to discuss a tool "FlawFix" which scans, assesses and fixes the vulnerabilities caused by open source library dependencies automatically thereby, overcoming the limitation of relying on manual .By using this tool we not only reduce manual errors but also save many man days, which can be used to focus more on business logic. The paper is organized as follows, section 1 gives a brief introduction of the tool’s necessity and definitions of few important terms. Section 2 highlights the work that has been done in this domain, the methodologies and their limitations. The paper then gives the methodology of our proposed tool which highlights the features, steps to be followed etc. Finally we conclude our work by mentioning some of the limitations which lays potential scope for our future work.

articleTitle: Smart Memory Companion for elderly
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Not all age-related problems can be solved using technology. However, it has the potential to relieve a significant amount of stress on elderly and their family. In this paper we present the idea of a virtual companion, which leverages the personalized digital journal curated using historical, daily life experiences of the aged person to uplift their mental wellbeing. The virtual buddy has a dual purpose of reminiscence therapy through memory triggering and to aid in recalling. The implementation proposed in this paper is an application of natural language processing and focuses on using fine-tuned generative transformers for personalized dialog generation, sentence transformers for visual search and zero shot topic classification to build an intelligent conversational agent. The companion can be used to store memorable experiences and activities by the user, their family and caretakers in the form of text and images so as to utilize them when needed and to recollect happy glimpses of life.

articleTitle: Human Violence Detection Using LHOGF Algorithm and Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A minor action of human is performed with some purpose. Understanding the behavior and the way to interact of human with environment in automatic way has attained a lot of attention in research field over past few years due to its potential in diverse domains. Several applications such as intelligent video surveillance and for monitoring the environmental home, for storing and retrieving the video etc. are related to the domain of recognizing the human activity. The human violence is detected in several stages in which the data is pre-processed, features are extracted, and the data is classified. This research introduces a deep learning algorithm for predicting the human violence. Python is executed to simulate the introduced algorithm and diverse metrics such as precision, and recall are considered to analyze the outcomes. The proposed model shows significant high performance as compared to existing model.

articleTitle: Digitization of Traditional Markets using DART based Cross Platform Development
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In the retail industry, E-Commerce has emerged as the most dominant trend. Small-scale shops and shop owners have been eager to make their businesses available online to keep up with technological advances. It makes sense for these retailers to establish their businesses on their platforms, which may include mobile and web-based apps. Customers gain from such a solution since there is no middle-man and they can order directly from their local and trusted sellers while maintaining the convenience of technology. Using traditional development approaches, individual apps for all platforms, including an Android app, an iOS app, and a web app, must be produced. This significantly raises the cost, time, and effort of development. It also necessitates those businesses manage their catalogs across three platforms. The research suggests a better way to digitize marketplaces with minimal development costs. The use of cross-platform development can help with this. DART is a programming language that allows developers to create apps for Android, iOS, and the Web with a single codebase. Applications are coded in the Dart programming language with the use of the Flutter framework. The solution explores variations in service architectures and their effectiveness when implemented using the Dart programming language.

articleTitle: Face Detection And Recognization System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A typical issue in biometry analysis could be face recognition from an images or videos. Since face recognition doesn’t require the cooperation of the object, it plays a crucial role in closed circuit television. The advantages of face-based identification over other biometry are individualism and acceptance as a face can be a dynamic object. Many public spaces regularly have police investigation cameras for video capture. These cameras have their important worth for security. This paper’s objective is to judge the various face detection and recognition techniques and provide a comprehensive solution for image based face detection and recognition with high accuracy and a higher response rate as a first step in video police investigation. The solution is projected supported by tests that were carried out on various face to rich databases in terms of subjects’ ability to evoke emotions and their weight and race.

articleTitle: A brief review on Artificial Intelligence based Drug Target Interaction Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Technological breakthroughs and its accompanying computational methodologies have provided a solid foundation for research in a variety of scientific fields including drug discovery. To meet medical needs, scientists discover new medicines through a multi stage process called drug discovery. As conventional experiments are time and money consuming, advancements in computer based technology have been heavily made to expedite this process and battle time and expense issues. Ligand Protein Interaction (LPI) also known as drug- protein interaction prediction especially useful for discovering new interactions between a known drug and a target can save time and money by screening millions of compounds accelerating drug discovery. This review will go through the underline artificial intelligence based techniques and methods used for LPI prediction. A brief introduction about the various formats of data used is also stated. Some insights for future research is also discussed to help carry out further research in LPI prediction.

articleTitle: Application of machine learning algorithm for prediction of heart disease
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Healthcare is the one the domain in which every organization is working on it globally. It need to make it better and better via different researches and the innovations in this sector. Machine learning is the most used algorithm in every sector and organization. It not merely transforming the field of healthcare but also able to emulate the various human intelligence from the surrounding in order to solve various problems. Machine learning in health care sector has shown its various application in it. Disease prediction is one of the applications of it. This study helps to predict heart diseases with the help of its algorithm to determine the risk and treat the patient in the healthcare system. In this paper we have taken out the data from the kaggle and implemented it using the Jupiter notebook tool. The three algorithm we have implemented (naïve bayes, decision tree and random forest) out of which random forest is giving. Hence, with the help of the following algorithms it is possible for us to predict the heart disease with more accuracy. This research will able to predict various disease over its various symptoms more easily and accurately.

articleTitle: STUDY BUDDY-Making Learning Easy
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Study buddy is an all-in-one package for your studies. We provide an automatically generated timetable as well as pdfs and video links all for Free for our students of class 10th, 12th and, those appearing for JEE. The aim is to increase job opportunities for college students with expertise in a particular subject as well as retired teachers to help school students divide their time and stay motivated. Kids nowadays are always stressed during exam days because they can’t make a schedule to study. So we wanted to bring an end to those days of anxiety and fear. We decided to make a website, "Study Buddy" where a student will have the following 4 options: a) Generate Time table b) Reference Material c) Discussion Forum d) Mentor Help.In our research, we would walk through the above-mentioned points and also compare how our proposed method and software package stands out from the already existing software. This will be followed by our system design, result and future scope. This software is a buddy for the students during their hard times. It will not only help the students but will also provide an employment opportunity to retired teachers and college students. We also plan to implement machine learning in order to understand the basic trend of student psychology during exams.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of fitness management website
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Summarizing today’s hectic lifestyle people must be fit and healthy for tension free life. Fitness are often described as a condition that helps us look, feel and do our greatest. As you know, this coronavirus pandemic has changed the lives of everyone., also it impacted our health badly. because of this there's a really big impact on the fitness. So, taking both major points discussed into consideration we are visiting develop a dynamic end-to-end Single Page Application (SPA) supported FITNESS, for the those who are willing to step-up and choose a healthy lifestyle for them by enrolling on this website. there'll be three entities within the system namely EnerGyM Planet i.e. Admin, Member and Trainer. Admin will do administrative tasks like adding, removing and updating information associated with other entities, Member will have features like aiming to choose their trainer from listed trainers available within the gym and so progressing to watch their videos and obtain fitness tips and various information associated with fitness industry. Also, a member will have various attractive features on website like online music for the workout, online payment, also a noteworthy questionnaire having feature with the assistance of AI. Technologies used are HTML5, JavaScript, CSS3, Animate.css, Bootstrap-4, React, Node.js, Express.js and MySQL

articleTitle: A Steadfast Approach to perform Face Detection using Feed Forward Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Now Presently every day with the monstrous expansion in video and picture data sets there’s a superb requirement for programmed comprehension and assessment of data by canny frameworks as physically it’s becoming far off. Step by step face recognition is turning into a test on account of its expanding use in a few applications. the essential advance for face acknowledgment, face investigation, and location of different elements of the face. Detection of dark-coloured faces and poorly illuminated faces don't seem to be well studied within the literature thanks to several challenges. the foremost critical challenge is that there’s inadequate contrast among facial expressions. The face detection algorithms are supported by either grey-level template matching or the computation of geometric relationships among face expressions. The technology nowadays isn't capable enough to acknowledge the face with or without beards or some general changes to the identical. This research illustrates a strong algorithm for pre-processing the face image with and without the beard. This research is implemented on a secured application where the robustness of the face recognition algorithms is enhanced.

articleTitle: An empirical evaluation of proposed model based on CNN for handwritten digit recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Computer vision is an emerging field of computer science that deals with visual inputs such as images and videos. It enables computers and systems to understand and process information from videos and images as processed by human beings. Computer vision is brought to life by convolutional neural networks (CNN) and deep learning. Deep learning is a subfield of machine learning that teaches computers to learn by example. CNN is an artificial neural network that enables deep learning models to break down images into pixels which are given tags and labels. Handwritten digit recognition is the process of identifying handwritten digits by computer systems. In this paper, a CNN model is used on the MNIST dataset to identify handwritten digits. The aim of this paper is to find the model that gives maximum accuracy based on various hyper parameters such as kernel size, learning rate, batch size, number of hidden layers, epochs.

articleTitle: End-to-End Model for Heavy Rain Image Captioning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The field of image captioning has seen significant progress in the past decade. This verily makes it surprising that the models developed to do so are practically always trained to work on clear images and as a consequence, they fail to provide satisfactory captions on rainy images, especially heavy rain images. Researchers have achieved state-of-the-art results in constructing models capable of single image de-raining. But limited work has been done to perform the task of heavy rain image captioning as a whole. This paper emphasizes the development of an end-to-end architecture capable of constructing suitable captions on the MS COCO dataset containing images with added heavy rain noise. An end-to-end model is proposed for this purpose, with the use of GAN-based architecture for deraining images, Inception V3 architecture for encoding image features, and GRU-based architecture for generating captions. The proposed model can generate high-quality captions even on images with significant degradation due to rain noise.

articleTitle: Handwritten Digit Recognition using Ensemble learning techniques: A Comparative performance Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The detection of some digits written by humans may seem very easy; however, in reality, it is a very challenging and tedious task to extract text from real images because of the wide variety of font sizes, shapes, textures and backgrounds, etc. This study aimed to recognize handwritten digit images by extracting the features from datasets. Then theses learned characteristics are subsequently submitted to the classifier to improve the overall performance. The Bagging and boosting techniques of ensemble learning were performed by integrating different base models. Each single base model corrected the errors of the previous model. Six bagging and boosting ensemble learning algorithms were used to recognize the handwritten digit images. Therefore, with 98% of accuracy, the extreme gradient boosting machine outperformed the other methods in terms of overall performance. A detailed analysis of the allocation of data among the base learners and their overall performance, including the model correctness, computation time, and error rate, was evaluated and projected.

articleTitle: Monitoring of traffic using advanced Digital differential based Neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Traffic analysis true video monitoring is quite a complex job. The reason for the same include different appearances, light changes, and variation in speeds. This paper proposed an efficient traffic monitoring system, which can detect the vehicle flow on the roads in real time. This system has three made components including evaluating vehicle density that is based on background subtraction procedures. the second component evaluate the speed of the traffic flow using optical flow mechanism first up the third component includes evaluating the number of vehicles using improved differential approach. From the fundamental information extracted, our system can predict events such as high traffic zones, vehicles over speeding and many more. The simulation is conducted by using the traffic data set derived from Kaggle.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of SVM kernel for YOUTUBE Comment Filtering
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The impact of Social networking platform is evident in each generation and almost all fields. It made many tasks more convenient that was not possible earlier. YouTube is one such platform. It can be utilized as a source of entertainment, discussion portal, information sharing, knowledge gathering. Various newborn and popularly known organizations display their advertisements over the platform as short video or links in comment section that help content creators of the video through some financial gains. These advertisements can be greatly helpful to visitors and firm. Also the comment section may contain some cogitative discussions. With all such activities found on the platform some spiteful ones are also lurking over it. Spammers used to suffuse malicious links and data over the platform. In this study, we directed towards the comment section of the platform and executed a comparative analysis of different SVM kernels for the classification of Spam or ham comments over the YouTube application. We also studied the impact of feature extraction incorporating two feature extraction techniques Tf-Idf and BOW.

articleTitle: Skin Lesion Classification In Dermoscopic Images With High Accuracy Using K-Nearest Neighbor Algorithm Comparing With Random Forest Method
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to evaluate the efficacy of the K-Nearest Neighbor algorithm in comparison to the Random Forest approach in terms of the accuracy and specificity of skin lesion categorization in dermoscopic pictures. Both the Materials and the Methods: The techniques of K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) and Random Forest were utilised in order to classify forty samples of dermoscopic pictures including skin lesions as either benign or malignant. The technique of identifying skin lesions typically involves four stages: pre-processing, segmentation, feature extraction, and classification. The end result was that the KNN acquired an accuracy of 93.27 percent and a specificity of 89.10 percent, in comparison to the accuracy of 88.56% and the specificity of 85.38% obtained by the Random Forest. Since p is less than 0.05, the differences between the two groups are statistically significant. According to this study's findings, the accuracy achieved in detecting skin lesions using KNN classifiers is superior to that achieved using Random Forest classifiers. [Citation needed] [Citation needed]

articleTitle: Estimation of blood pressure using Heart Rate Variability features with deep learning approach for limited database
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Blood pressure (BP) measurement gains particular relevance in regular fitness activities and is important for the detection of cardiovascular diseases. Cardiovascular disease is a term that encompasses the serious risks of cardiopathy, stroke, renal failure, and other health issues. When blood flow changes the pressure on blood arteries changes which cause hypertension(high blood pressure) or hypotension(low blood pressure). . Hypertension and Hypotension are dangerous illnesses since they can damage multiple organs if left untreated for a long time. Such a life-threatening situation necessitates rapid clinical intervention.Normally, blood pressure is measured using a cuff on the arm, and this method is extensively utilized in practically every hospital. However, for continuous measurement, the standard inflated cuff creates pain and clumsiness in the patient, which might result in a misleading reading of blood pressure. As a result, the researchers favored BP measuring methods that did not require a cuff. Continuous blood pressure monitoring in ICU patients can greatly aid in determining the risk of developing hypotension or hypertension. Many studies have extracted characteristics from numerous physiological signals such as ECG, PPG, Impedance Cardiography(ICG), and IPG to assess BP. However, training extraneous features taken from these physiological signals has an impact on model performance and increases model complexity. Existing cuff-less BP measuring research yields either normal or hypertension readings, resulting in distinct model creation for different BP scenarios. To circumvent these constraints, a novel learning-based methodology for continuous BP monitoring has been presented.

articleTitle: Dual Multi-Scale CNN for Multi-layer Breast Cancer Classification at Multi-Resolution
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The resolution dependent textures & diverse color of histopathological images comprising the hard-to-discern high coherency of cancerous cells which makes it very challenging to categorize breast cancer. As such, generic learning models are proposed in the existing state-of-the-art unable to address the different magnification factor with single learning stage. Additionally, the feature extracted from the existing deep learning based models often unable to extract rotation or scale-invariant features which is a key in addressing the breast cancer from rich zoom intrinsic histopathological images. In this work, we have proposed fully-automated robust Dual Multi-Scale CNN capable of extracting linearly seperable rich scale-invariant features. Dual Multi-Scale CNN has been validated on large scale open source BreakHis dataset in different magnification factor. Additionally, our proposed model can be deployed at tertiary hospital settings as clinical deployment in hand-held smart devices for accurate BC categorization.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis on Amazon Product Review
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Users throughout the world may now access massive amounts of data thanks to the internet and social media platforms. [5] In every facet of human existence, electronic commerce (e-commerce) plays a crucial role. E-commerce is a marketing approach that enables businesses and consumers to buy and sell things via the internet. When buyers look for product information and compare alternatives online, they generally have access to dozens or hundreds of product reviews from alternative shoppers. Machine learning is the most appropriate approach to training a neural network in today’s age of practical artificial intelligence. So implementing a model to polarize those reviews and learn from them would make passing hundreds of comments a lot easier. [24] The interpretation will be a very basic product with positive, neutral, and negative polarization. The product is checked. This study suggests a sentiment evaluation model for shopper reviews based on the object and emotive word mining for emotional level analysis using machine learning approaches.

articleTitle: Comparison of Different Image Enhancement Algorithm for Emotional Face Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The aim of this study is to identify different human facial expressions using image enhancement algorithms in Google COLAB. A dataset of images of different expressions like ‘happy’, ‘disgust’ using novel Blocking Effect Reduction Filter. 100 images were taken for sample preparation groups. 25 images of expression "happy" were taken as training dataset. 25 images of expression "sad" were taken for training dataset. 25 images of "sad" expression were taken as testing dataset and similarly, 25 images of expression "happy" were taken as testing dataset. From SPSS the Gpower was obtained as 80%. The proposed novel Blocking Effect Reduction Filter classifier has an accuracy of 98% with sensitivity of 82% and Histogram Equalization has an accuracy of 88% with sensitivity of 78% in facial expression images detection and classification. The 2-tailed significance of accuracy and sensitivity is 0.002 (p<0.05) and 0.840 (p>0.05) respectively. In Facial Expression Recognition, the proposed novel Support Vector Machine is slightly better than Histogram Equalization. This proves the innovative ability of the novel Blocking Effect Reduction Filter in real-time implementations.

articleTitle: A Brief on Blockchain and cryptocurrency system
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Blockchain is ultra model technique which is making a great impact on the society for its decentralized nature. Cryptocurrency is one of the popular application of blockchain. Blockchain is decentralized in nature and each block is connected with chain using the hashing concept, so that third party will not be able to access it, The blockchain is more secure. Cryptocurrency contain secure distributed ledger and mining concept is important in cryptocurrency. Secure mining algorithm is required for cryptocurrency. This paper describes an overview of an blockchain and cryptocurrency systems.

articleTitle: BER Analysis of Hybrid LPPM-POLSK-SIM Over Double Generalized Gamma Distribution Incorporating Zero Boresight Pointing Error
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Free Space Optical (FSO) communication transmits the information using light propagation in the free space permitting optical connectivity. So, there is no necessity for optical fiber cables. FSO provides the solution for the requirement of large bandwidth and high speed for data transmission. Here, we use hybrid modulation scheme LPPM-POLSK-SIM using Double GG distribution in FSO in presence of a generalized pointing error model consisting of normalized spatial jitter effect as well as zero boresight displacement effect. Afterwards, we look at how it performs in terms of average bit error rate for plane waves under weak, moderate and strong turbulent conditions. For all values of L, simulation findings demonstrate that BER is less with least value of L and under weak turbulence conditions than with a moderate or strong turbulence condition.

articleTitle: Perspectives on the Impact of Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning on Processes & Structures Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In recent years, the sectors of artificial intelligence and machining learning have experienced rapid expansion, and they have become part of nearly every aspect of the technological life of societies. Over the last 5 years or fewer, thousands of publications have reported advances in a particular field. However, materials and structures engineers seem to be reluctant to take advantage of these advances. Despite recent advancements on informatics methods for materials, it is still difficult to distinguish these developments from the long-established methods of materials engineering. This undermines the clear impact of these recent developments in the field of materials, processes, and structures engineering (MPSE). On the other hand, the lack of available relevant material data and the diversity of the data types pose some challenges for the implementation of machine- learning. The snapshot presented in this overview is meant to pull the reader's attention to selected advances that we consider distinct, and to demonstrate that these technologiesare capable of having significant impacts on MPSE in the years to come. Moreover, MPSE fields have the opportunity to contribute to machine-learning tools from a physics perspective to gain an understanding of the emerging methods of machine learning. MPSE needs to make the methods more widely accessible and use them throughout the school system and start the process of transforming engineering education in order to ensure the methods will be used

articleTitle: Machine Learning and 5G Charging Function with Network Analytics Function for Network Slice as a Service
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: 5g system is more customer centric which give very high throughput, low latency, highly scalable, customer industry driven technology. 5G system has charging function which generate session and event based information from Session Management Function (SMF) and Access and mobility management function (AMF). The standard for advance use cases for 5G by incorporating network element/services like Network Data Analytics Function (NWDAF), Network Slice Management Function (NSMF) are defined in Third Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) release 15 and 16. These efforts are to make 5G use cases more customers driven, industry driven and make more analytical Key target of this project to incorporate machine learning techniques on the data available through NWDAF, NSMF and NAMF (Service-based Interface for Access and Mobility Management Function). This makes operator to launch potentially consumed charging use cases specifically to use Network Slice as a Service (N-SaaS). With the use of Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) algorithms, data can be modelled to predict the customer charging model, predictive analysis to avoid future outages, optimal use of resources and traffic forecasting which gives operator potentially high revenue and of course customer satisfaction for better service.

articleTitle: Detail Decomposition for Low Light Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Images captured in a poor environment is a big problem to deal with. The environment contains haze, fog, smog, rain or even the lighting conditions could be poor. One of these issues are images captured in low light as they are not fit for the view ability of human beings as well as pose an issue for various computer vision applications, where the image quality needs to high. This research proposes a low light photo improvement method based upon the Retinex theory. The proposed methodology firstly smoothens the image input and with edge preservation characteristic. Then the image is element wise divided by the smooth version of the image. To obtain the Reflectance component. These are then plugged into the structure and texture aware Retinex based equation. This way the low light photo improvement is achieved along with a good amount of naturalness preservation. However, there are pros and cons to this method, which have been discussed in this report.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection Using MRI
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With the advent of science and technology the field of diagnostics is much easier with the help of various imaging modalities such as MRI or CT scan. These images are becoming increasingly important with increasing demand due to a number of helpful features such as these automatic, accurate, reliable, quick and effective diagnostics in a very short time that can provide a clearer view of the story than human eyes. A brain tumor is considered to be the most serious cancer. The study found that Brain Tumor was the second leading cause of cancer-related deaths in men aged 20 to 39, and the fifth leading cause of cancer in women of the same age group. Brain tissue is painful, and can lead to certain diseases if not treated properly. Diagnosis of a tumor is a very important part of the treatment process as it plays a very important role in its treatment. diagnosis plays an important role in detecting malignant and malignant tissue. The main reason for increasing the number of cancer patients worldwide is ignorance about early detection of the disease.

articleTitle: Detection and Analysis of Emotion Recognition from Speech Signals using K-nearest Neighbours and comparing with Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to evaluate the performance of the K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifiers when it comes to identifying feelings based on speech inputs. Both the Materials and the Methods: A KNN and an SVM classifier are used to analyse speech signals from 20 different samples from each group to determine an individual's emotional state. A novel part of the work is that key characteristics can be extracted from speech signals and identified. The results show that the KNN classifier has an accuracy of 45.13% when it comes to the classification of emotions, while the SVM only has an accuracy of 27.18%. According to the results of the statistical analysis performed with SPSS, there is a substantial gap between the two groups (p 0.05). The findings of this study indicate that the accuracy of the KNN classifier is substantially higher than that of the SVM classifier when it comes to identifying human emotions.

articleTitle: Hybrid Classification Model for Network Traffic Classification using SMOTE and PCA
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Network Traffic classification (NTC) involves identifying diverse kinds of applications or traffic data for which the received data packets are analyzed. It is an important technique in communication networks, in recent times. The process to classify the network traffic classification is executed such as to take the data for input, pre-process the data, extract the attributes, classification, and performance analysis. Classifying the network traffic is a crucial process to manage the network and rapid advances in machine learning have driven the utility of learning methods to categorize traffic across a network. This work introduces a new framework to classify the traffic in network so that the efficacy is enhanced. The proposed model is the combination of SMOTE which solve problem of class unbalancing, PCA for the feature reduction and for the classification three classifiers are merged together which are SVM, KNN and random forest. The performance of proposed model is tested in Python is executed using Anaconda to test the efficacy of the introduced framework.

articleTitle: An Effecient Approach to Detect Fraud Instagram Accounts Using Supervised ML Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Nowadays social media plays a vital role in different fields including business, economic communication and personal. Many person get profit from the different origins of availability of data from these social media, but cyber-crimes are increasing day by day. A person can generate many fake accounts and hence pretenders can easily be made. Instagram, as one of the popular types of online social media site, carries big information and messages through the posts. Most of the person use Instagram as a digital life marketing place because it is a one of the big social media site. The goal of the research paper is to recognize and stop fake IDs and pages. Because through the professional pages of Instagram, many fake cases and things are occurring present days. So the main thing is to recognize fake pages and fake accounts also. In this paper, we work on various IDs of Instagram. We want to observe an ID is real or not using Machine Learning techniques namely Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, Support vector machine, Decision tree, Random Forest.

articleTitle: Novel Model for the Efficient Vehicle Movement in Vehicular Ad hoc Network Based IOT
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Networks that have multiple vehicle nodes that have complete freedom to enter or exit the network are called vehicle ad-hoc networks (VANETs). Establishing a protecting and competent pathway between end-to-end terminals is a complicated job by virtue of to the excessive movement of automobiles in the vehicular network. The selection of a pathway between source and destination relies on two evaluation criteria, namely sequence number and lowest hop count. In this project, this pathway has been formed by adopting a multicasting strategy. This strategy routes the data to select the source nodes from the network. A source node plays an important role in choosing a path between the end-to-end terminals. The methodology designed is implemented in NS2 tool and analytical results are achieved on the basis of some universal performance indices.

articleTitle: Cryptocurrency Price Prediction using Graph Embedding and Deep learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This paper displays the expectation of vacillation in the ensuing cost of the cryptocurrency. Foreseeing the cost of Bitcoin is an extraordinary test since it’s massively complicated and vital in nature. The major challenge for the investor is the volatile nature of cryptocurrency. We have attempted to foresee the coming cost of cryptographic forms of money like Bitcoin utilizing LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory), GRU (Gated Recurrent Unit) and LSTM-GRU-based Hybrid model. Throughout recent years, Blockchain innovation is becoming famous reasons are its different applications in various fields. One of the most widely recognized uses of Blockchain innovation is Cryptocurrency. Financial backers are vigorously putting resources into cryptocurrency. Yet, this cryptocurrency is impacted by an excessive number of variables. Here Price forecasts of digital money assume an essential part. It tends to be finished utilizing a few methods, however, AI and deep learning are the most popular procedures. AI is generally regularly utilized for forecasts however over the most recent couple of years; deep learning is additionally becoming famous due to its different applications in different fields. The cost of Cryptocurrency can anticipate by utilizing deep learning calculations. Our proposed technique is to anticipate the Cryptocurrency price with graph embedding and deep learning models. Neo4j sandbox is used for graph embedding. Different dimensions of graph embedding were taken to predict the price. The performance of the model was measured using RMSE, MSE and MAE.

articleTitle: A study of Autoregressive Model Using Time Series Analysis through Python
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: A Time-series investigation is a simple technique for dividing information from reconsideration perceptions on a solitary unit or individual at ordinary stretches over countless perceptions. Timeseries examination can be considered to be the model of longitudinal plans. The most widely used method is focused on a class of Auto-Regressive Moving Average (ARMA) models. ARMA models could examine various examination questions, including fundamental cycle analysis, intercession analysis, and long-term therapy impact analysis. The model ID process, the meanings of essential concepts, and the factual assessment of boundaries are all depicted as specialized components of ARMA models. To explain the models, Multiunit time-series plans, multivariate time-series analysis, the consideration of variables, and the study of examples of intra-individual contrasts across time are all ongoing improvements to ARMA demonstrating techniques. [1]

articleTitle: Revolution of the Indian Agricultural Landscape using Machine Learning and Big Data Techniques: A Systematic Review
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The world of Big Data has been rapidly expanding into the domains of Engineering and Machine Learning. The biggest challenge in the Big Data landscape is the incompetence of processing vast amounts of data in a time-efficient manner. The agriculture domain has so long only relied on traditional method for yield prediction. This can be bettered by using novel Machine Learning techniques and innovative thinking. The study provides the review of most of the techniques already implemented in the ML, Big Data and Agriculture domain- traditional and modern- while focusing on highlighting the difference in accuracy between the traditional methods and the more advanced methods.

articleTitle: Lung cancer detection using scan images
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Lung cancer is one of the nation’s most horrible diseases. Early recognition and medication, on the other hand, could save lives. Despite the fact that CT scan scanning is the finest way to take pictures in the medical sector It is difficult for physician to discover and identify cancer on T images. As a result, computer-assisted diagnostics may help doctors accurately identify cancer cells. Numerous computer assistants who integrate imaging and machine learning algorithms have been researched and applied. The main idea behind this study was to explore the different-different computer-assisted techniques, analyze the best current method and identify their limitations and their constraints and finally propose a new model that upgrades the best available model. The approach used here is for lung cancer monitoring techniques to be classified as well as ranked as per their quality of diagnosis. Strategies are analyzed at each step and the overall scope, barriers are identified. It has been discovered that some people have low accuracy while others have great accuracy but are not close to 100 percent. As an outcome, our research hopes to enhance reliability to 99 percent.

articleTitle: Avoid Call Rejection in Overloaded Telecom Online Charging System for Priority Subscribers using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Telecom prepaid services implement real-time charging with the help of the Online Charging System (OCS). OCS empowers service providers to charge a subscriber for services in real-time. OCS also authorizes the subscriber and validates if the subscriber has sufficient balance to allow the services. If allowed, it does rating and charges for the services used. In this article, we have discussed and proposed a solution for the problem faced when OCS is overloaded and starts rejecting new calls. This issue generally comes during the festive time or specific occasion when most of the subscribers want to use telecom services at the same time. The conventional charging system starts rejecting some pre-configured percentage of calls to overcome the OCS overload scenario. This may result in the rejection of some important calls, leading to a bad customer experience. The proposed solution given in this article suggests how to predict a priority subscriber, based on their payment history and usage of telecom services using machine learning, and to benefit these subscribers by allowing them to continue services even when OCS is overloaded. The proposed solution suggests using a classification model like XG Boost and Clustering algorithms like Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM) on different subscriber datasets and then combining the results obtained to predict priority subscribers. Such priority subscribers are allowed to continue calls in offline mode and are charged later using network events.

articleTitle: Finding Patterns of Questions based on Cognitive Domain of Bloom’s Taxonomy Using S-BERT
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Everyone would agree that a person’s ability to ask new questions is an important part of the thinking ability of an individual and is especially important during formal education. This paper discusses primary steps towards nurturing the questioning abilities in students. Unsupervised learning is used to find questions that require a similar thinking process while asking and answering that question. The question structure directly related to cognition has been used for finding similar questions. The embeddings of the question structure are made using the SBERT model, a state-of-the-art model. Embeddings of similar structured question are found to be less differentiated from each other; this has made it possible to a large extent to bring questions of the similar thought process into the same group.

articleTitle: Image Denoising using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Image denoising is one of the fundamental aspects for removing noise from an image and enhancing its features containing visual information. Based on this, the Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) along with Autoencoders when applied with image denoising have been a hot topic of study, with a wide range of applications in fields as diverse as diagnostic image denoising and low-light image denoising. As compared to non-CNN image denoising approaches, a CNN based image denoising approach seems to be more noise-free. When applied on the Modified National Institute of Standards and Technology (MNIST) dataset, this work presents a research and practical method to image denoising utilizing deep CNN algorithms.

articleTitle: Design of Biosensor using 1D Photonic Crystal for Dengue Virus Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Biosensors are very much useful for the detection of human diseases. In this work a biosensor design has been proposed for detecting dengue virus using 1 D photonic crystal. The proposed design comprises Si with LiF and MgF materials. Refractive index D of the materials, which is a function of hemoglobin, platelets, and plasma of the infected blood sample. Refractive index variations affect the transmission peak in blood sample. Transfer Matrix Method is being used to evaluate the performance of the proposed structure. Sensitivity, Q-factor and transmittance has been analyzed. In this work, sensitivity have been found to be 300 nm/RIU, which is 50 percent higher than the reported results.

articleTitle: Cloud Network Of a City Using Routers, Switches, IPs etc
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The term "Cloud Computing" has become an in- teresting and a new buzzword in the IT industry. Cloud com- puting offers the services over the internet to its users.
