It also reduces the time required to do heavy resources and creates new servers which helps to construct and maintain application dynamically. There are so many users ho use cloud to store their data and they also need security for their data. So cloud computing help them to store their data and help them to secure their data. This network all about the one network the name is "Chandigarh Cloud Network" which provides network to 4 places of Chandigarh through one source.

articleTitle: Design and Assembling of Mobile Controlled Sanitizing Robot with Camera and Sanitizer Level Detection for Measuring Area and Distance in Comparison with Pesticide Spraying Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The aim of this study is to design and implement the mobile controlled sanitizing robot with a camera by comparing it with a pesticide spraying robot. The components used in the design of a mobile controlled sanitizing robot are Arduino, Bluetooth module, motor shield, camera, and chassis. The Arduino board is programmed from a computer using the Arduino IDE app. For groups 1 and 2, the overall sample size is 20. Sanitizing robot achieved 35% less standard error, moves 23.77% faster than the pesticide spraying robot, and has a significance value of less than 0.0001(p<0.05). In this study, it is found that the sanitizing robot performs better than the pesticide spraying robot in spraying on a plain surface.

articleTitle: Glaucoma detection using image processing
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In Glaucoma the eye’s optic nerve of patient get damaged. As the time getting passed it gets worse. It’s create a pressure inside the eye of people who is suffering from it. it is also genetically diseases. Intraocular pressure is the increased pressure in a patient’s eye that might harm the nerve fibers, which transmits images to the brain. If the impairment progresses, the patient may experience irreversible visual loss or possibly total blindness within a few years. The majority of patients who have glaucoma do not have any early signs or pain. People who suffer from it should see an eye doctor on a regular basis so that glaucoma can be diagnosed and treated before protracted visual loss occurs. It is impossible to restore people’s vision once they have lost it. However, by decreasing pressure in the eye, we can maintain our current vision. To maintain their eye sight, most patients with glaucoma must adhere to their treatment protocol and undergo regular eye checkups. A physical or chemical injury to the eye, various types of eye infection, and clogged blood vessels within the eye are all major causes of glaucoma. It’s extremely unusual, although eye surgery for another eye ailment might sometimes result in it, generally we can see that it affect both the eyes, but it can happen that one is more affected than other. We can see that it generally affects adults over 40, but young adults, children, and even infants can also suffer from it. In this research, we will apply various image processing techniques to aid in the early diagnosis of glaucoma. In our project we are using rential fundus image and CDR technique to detect glaucoma.

articleTitle: Duplicate Address Detection: Significance, Attacks and its Solutions
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: IoT is a platform that allows various things to connect and communicate with one another. IPv6 is used to simplify the addressing process in order to address the IPv4 limitation. Each device needs an IPv6 address, which needs to be distinct and unique, in order to join a network. The DAD procedure is a useful tool for detecting address duplication in a network. It is necessary for each IoT object to create a unique IPv6 address when it joins the network in order to communicate with other nodes. The practice of detecting duplicate addresses is employed in order to ensure the unique address to each object before joining the network. This paper discusses the significance of the DAD process, potential dangers to the DAD process, and several author-provided solutions. This paper also presents different lessons learned from the literature and present future research directions towards the DAD process.

articleTitle: Design of High Speed Ethernet Based Receiver Processor Unit for Radar applications
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Receiver processor of the Radar system is main part for detecting and analyzing the received signal paramters in the presence of clutter. One of the functions of the receiver processor is to accept commands in the form of messages and process for different receiver applications. These commands are initiated by the system controller to receiver processor as per the system requirements. In this paper, the receiver processor is designed for Electronic Warfare application based on high end FPGA.The communication takes place between system controller and receiver processor in the FPGA through high speed Ethernet link.For processing these commands, embedded application software is developed using C language.A Graphical user interface is also developed in LabVIEW for giving command inputs to the receiver processor. The developed firmwareis able to transmit a high amount of data sufficiently to select filter bank, threshold level and quadrature position based on the input commands.The commands have been successfully executed and results are observed on the FPGA output pins.

articleTitle: Smart Fire Detection System with Call Alert and Water Sprinkler Unit Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The Internet of Things(IoT) enables the development of socially benefited applications for most of the safety precautions. Most of the fire accidents that occurs in the industrial areas, and it causes major damage to human as well as natural resources.In this paper, the author has proposed fire detection and smart water sprinkler system using IoT technology and useful for the fire- crackers industry. The root cause for the damage caused by fire accidents is analyzed and discussed about the prevention from them by introducing a fire fighting system. This proposed system performs the functions have additional features such as call feature, SMS alert with GPS co-ordinates meanwhile triggering the water system. From this system several hazardous fire accidents can be avoided, and many lives can be saved.

articleTitle: Image Segmentation Role in Self Driving Car
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With the development of image processing techniques and the growing GPU computing power, these techniques are very common in real-time systems such as self-driving cars. Photo-separation methods, which allow us to locate objects in the image and mark pixels of these objects, are image processing techniques commonly used in self-driving cars. In addition to the study of classical photographs, detailed reading-based techniques are widely available in textbooks. This paper discusses why photo classification methods are important for self-driving cars. We explore ways to classify images into two main groups: semantic classification and example. We see that these methods are used in many different situations in self-driving cars and how important they are in safe travel.

articleTitle: Covid-19 Pandemic Predictive System Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Corona -virus disease commonly known as COVID-19 that outbreak in late December 2019 is continuously spreading worldwide and infecting people due to which it's required to analysis research on the expansion of CODID-19.In this research, a more improved model. HYBRID ARTIFICAL MODEL (AI) is suggested for prediction. In conventional model, it treats similar infection rate for all people, an improvised ISI (improved susceptible–infected) is suggested to gauge the infection rate to calculate the development mode. We have build the hybrid AI model by using natural language processing(NLP) model and long short-term memory(LSTM) network modules inside ISI module .According to the attentive results, it represents more infections from three to eight days .In comparison to both the models , our developed new AI model can remarkably reduces the prediction result's error and prevail the mean percentage errors with different percentage for the six consecutive days in different countries .For example-China , Italy, France, etc.

articleTitle: Clustering Mechanism for Isolation of Black hole Attack in MANET
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Those networks which do not have the central controller among them, however, the access points are involved in them, called infrastructure-less networks. Such networks also termed as ad hoc networks. The malevolent mote can drop packets for their broadcasting along its path. Consequently, the overall performance of network is minimized. A trust-based method is projected to recognize the attack in the network via the black list node. Numerous nodes, which transmit other motes, are useful to quantify the trust value. This network allows malevolent motes to transmit only a little number of packets. The attacker mote focuses on selecting the node with the least trust value at first. A clustering technique is employed to remove such motes. Network Simulator 2 is considered in the simulations for the proposed technique. The analysis of performance is done concerning throughput, packet loss and delay. The simulation outcomes indicate that the projected technique provides superior outcomes in contrast to the existing methods.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Behavioral Artifacts for Malicious Software Detection Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Malicious software intentionally affects your computer system. Malware is analyzed using static or dynamic analysis techniques. These techniques are used to classify and predict unique patterns for correctly identifying malware. Over the last decade, many malware detection techniques have been proposed using a variety of techniques. In most cases, network-based attacks such as DDoS attacks are known network security risks. These causes usually cause network devices to overflow with more requests than they can handle, preventing the server from responding to legitimate requests. The biggest security risk is related to software. Software attacks can exploit the entire system, steal information, modify data, deny services, and endanger or damage devices. In particular, I am interested in dynamic analysis for developing malware detection systems that utilize machine learning techniques. This document proposes behavior-based malware detection techniques. To develop this model, we arrange a dynamic analysis approach and run malware samples using classifiers. To extracted for the malware detection system. To develop this technique, we create a dynamic analysis approach and run malware using classification algorithms. Computer programs connected to Internet are increasingly needed to analyze and prevent malware. The software exploits system vulnerabilities to unknowingly steal sensitive information and secretly send it to an attacker-controlled remote server. This approach uses the ML classifier to detect malware and identify the type of malware attacked in the dataset.

articleTitle: An Automatic Speech Recognition System: A systematic review and Future directions
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The process of recognizing a person through his/her speech signals can be termed Speech recognition and the model used to do this task is known as the speech recognition system. It permits the system to take the speech in an understandable form and identify the speaker based on the feature extracted. These types of systems ease the communication between humans and machines. In this paper, we have discussed the core terminologies like Utterance, Speaker dependence, Vocabulary, Accuracy, and Training which help to understand the speech recognition system in a better way. Further, the paper elaborates on the flowchart which needs to be followed for speech recognition with some research work done by various researchers in this field. Lastly, some future directions are shown which depict the use of the speech recognition system.

articleTitle: Text Emotion Analysis Using Deep Learning For COVID- 19 Dataset
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Managing mental health and psychological well-being is just as critical as managing physical health throughout COVID-19. The difficulty of detecting, classifying, and quantifying emotions in text in any form are addressed in this study. We consider English text collected from social media sites such as Twitter and various Kaggle datasets that can provide information useful in a variety of ways, particularly opinion mining. However, analysing and categorising text based on emotions is a difficult task and might be thought of as a more advanced kind of Sentiment Analysis. This work provides a system for categorising text into three types of emotions: positive, negative, and neutral. This analysis can be utilized by authorities to better understand people's mental health and to make appropriate policy decisions to combat the coronavirus, which is hurting the world's social well-being and economy.

articleTitle: Increasing Availability of Same Email-Id for different Users by Adding Color Attributes
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Email is one of the best methods to start any official conversation by exchanging messages between people using electronic devices. With time, email has turned into an executioner application helping drive the internet energy. This is the most common technology used by everyone these days. Email operates across computer networks, primarily the internet and also local area networks. Sometimes, we fail to remember the whole email id. So, to resolve this problem, we create a new id by adding extra characters in it which makes it even clumsier to remember. Sometimes the server shows the existence of previous email-id and to get rid from this, we as a user adds some special characters in it which makes the email-id more difficult to remember. There is a simple approach to overcome this problem i.e. by using color attributes. By adding colors to the email-ids, we can solve the problem making long-lengthy email addresses and can get rid forgetting the email-id. Colors have their unique identity on the basis of appearance as well as on the basis of color’s code. So it easily differentiates email-ids from one another. In this approach, we are going to save the inputs in the database with color’s column. And this may help the users to overcome this problem.

articleTitle: Tweet Summarization Using Clustering Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Due to the growth of online sites like Twitter, this’s resulted in a rise in the quantity of user-generated content. It is difficult for users to absorb so enormous amounts of data. The outcome is creating automated technologies to summarise massive problematic. Twitter is a well-known platform for microblogging. Users post messages.in form of twitter posts. It serves as a framework for compiling tweet summaries in this article. Occasionally, in times of catastrophes or environmental hazards. Users tweet frequently. Just a few twitter posts will be beneficial. Displaced people find these twitter posts useful. The details can be gleaned out of those twitter posts. Emergency team can execute rescue efforts with an information gleaned from such twitter posts. The categorization of tweets serves as the preliminary step of the suggested strategy dividing twitter posts into relevant/irrelevant categories accompanied by a clustering mechanism. BERT paradigm, also referred to as the "transformers classifier," is utilized for categorization. This system considered clustering mechanism is DB SCAN. An innovative technique relying on neural networks is used to separate and simplify relevant Twitter posts. An unguided approach for categorizing Twitter posts as relevant/irrelevant will be used to build this model.

articleTitle: Foretelling of space-time PM2.5 Air pollutant using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: An airborne particle pollutant known as PM<inf>2.5</inf> whose diameter less than human hair i.e. 2.5 micron penetrate deeper into lungs causes serious respiratory issues. Forecasting PM<inf>2.5</inf> levels will inform people about air quality and support a country's long-term growth. This work improves the accuracy of Pm<inf>2.5</inf> prediction. Our approach to utilize non-Parametric supervised machine learning techniques such asRandom Forest, Linear regression, SVR, Random ferns. Firstly Pm<inf>2.5</inf>datasets acquired expressly for this work from the Pollution Control Board Bangalore show that the system can thoroughly evaluate the data well and accurately forecast the hourly fluctuationtrend of Pm<inf>2.5</inf> using ML algorithms. Later ensemble all the models using boosting technique for better accuracy. If we combine random forest,SVR,linear regression we can see that the training score is 68 %. If we combine all the four algorithms which are the random forest, random fern, linear regression, and SVR we get training score of 82 %.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Water Purification Process Using Smart IoT Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The existence of human life predominantly depends on the availability of pure water. Due to the increase in pollution, various toxic containments would have been dissolved in water which causes harm to the body. Therefore, it is necessary to have proper filtration to remove these toxic containments from water. One of the most cost-effective ways of water filtering is Reverse Osmosis (RO). Total dissolved solids (TDS) are the most common contaminant in water. Many RO purifiers nowadays deliver water with TDS levels ranging from 30 mg/lt to 50 mg/lt. Low TDS value in water deprives the human body of important nutrients and leads to health problems. The proposed system is integrated with a feedback TDS meter to measure the total dissolved solids and peristaltic pumps are used to manually inject the TDS if the output of the TDS value is low, a pH meter is used to measure the pH value of the water, flow meter to manually or automatically set the water flow, it also can debug the errors automatically and also the system has the Bluetooth connection as well as server connection which has been integrated with the android application to monitor the purifier through remotely. This system is user-friendly it can be detached from the purifier when it is not in use and can be attached to the new purifier commonly known as Retrofitting. If there is any damage in the purifier, the system will identify the damage and will automatically identify the damage and raise the ticket to the support with a detailed description.

articleTitle: Credit Card Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Credit card fraud Detection is a Big Crime. people and economic enterprises lose billions of dollars every year as a result of it. The range of theft reviews has doubled inside the preceding years, in line with the Federal trade fee (FTC), a client protection body. It emphasizes the need of economic establishments detecting and stopping fraudulent movements. system gaining knowledge of algorithms offer an correct proactive technique for stopping credit score card robbery. For the identity of fraudulent transactions, machine gaining knowledge of methods together with Logistic Regression, Nave Bayes, Random wooded area, ok-Nearest Neighbor, Gradient Boosting, guide Vector device, and Neural community algorithms are used on this studies. To find the best answer, a comparison of Algorithm is carried out.

articleTitle: Routing Scalability in Named Data Networking
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Named Data network consists of three data structures for forwarding the incoming Interest packets. Whenever the interest packet arrives, it has to search in the pending interest table and the content store. When a large amount of interest packet arrives, the time required to search the matching content in the pending Interest table can be increased. And also, as the size of Content Store is limited, it will be difficult to satisfy the incoming interest packets’ needs. So the interest packets in the content store have to be replaced. In this paper, Optimal Content Store with tree based approach is proposed and is compared with Optimal Content Store without tree based approach. The comparison shows that packet drop rate and delay is comparatively reduced in Optimal Content store with tree based approach.

articleTitle: Identification of Fake News Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In today’s world everyone is using internet and Social media platforms like Instagram, Twitter, Facebook etc. In such scenario fake news spreads very rapidly and reaches to millions of user in a short span of time. Riots during election, riots between different religious groups are consequences of these fake news. Many political parties utilize false information to boost their vote totals. Machine learning is important for classification of data, but it has limitations. On the basis of the kaggle dataset, a model has been suggested to classify fake and authentic news in this project. Our technology will be programmed to discern between fake and legitimate news from various social media platforms. It also aims to distinguish genuine news from a variety of sources. Our research looks into several textual qualities that can be used to tell the difference between phoney and real content. We use machine learning algorithms, such as the Passive Aggressive classifier using TF-IDF, to train our model utilizing those properties.

articleTitle: A Deep Q-Learning-Based Adaptive Traffic Light Control System for Urban Safety
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Traffic congestion is a significant and recurring issues in today’s urbanised world, caused by an increase in the number of vehicles. While vehicle density fluctuates on temporally short and geographically small scales, efficient traffic signaling system helps in avoiding traffic congestion. An inefficacious traffic system can lead to congestion and delays resulting in high pollution, and fuel wastage. The Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) method provides an excellent approach to solve the problem involving complex relations such as traffic flow and congestion. Recent development in Deep Neural Network (DNN) further enhances the learning capabilities of an agent with complex real-time data. The paper presents an intelligent Traffic Light Control System (TLCS) built on a Deep Q-Learning (DQL) model that accurately represents the problem’s components: agents, environment, and actions. The proposed model aims to minimize the traffic queue length and delay in terms of waiting time. The model is implemented using Simulation of Urban MObility (SUMO) for traffic generation in an urban scenario. The performance of the proposed model is compared with a traditional traffic light control system. The simulation results show that the proposed DQL-based model can significantly reduce the delay compared with the traditional model.

articleTitle: A Comparative Statistical Analysis Between ML Algorithms & DNN Techniques Using MNIST Dataset
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Handwritten digit recognition has been around since a very long time and it has always been a topic of attention among the students and researchers. This job of recognizing handwritten content has great importance as it helps in recognizing various type of important information which are filled by hand but are not clearly understood. While solving this problem, the most common challenge is that the digits written by hands are of different size, orientation or thickness. Inspite of all these challenges, various Machine Learning Algorithms & Deep Neural Network Techniques are trying harder to achieve higher accuracy. In this report, we have tried to compare the accuracies of most common and popular ML Algorithms which includes SVM (Support Vector Machine), Random Forest Classifier (RFC) & KNN (K-Nearest Neighbour) with DNN Techniques (Deep Neural Network Technique) also termed as CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) using Keras. We have applied these algorithms and techniques on MNIST dataset. With the help of the results obtained, we have plotted some graphs to show differences between ML (Machine Learning Algorithms) & DNN (Deep Neural Network Techniques). In this research work, we got the accuracy of approx 97.86% using SVM, 97.10% using KNN, 97.05% using RFC while on the other hand, by using CNN, we got 99.98% accuracy on validation image data. Also, we were able to achieve accuracy approx , 96.85% using RFC, 97.73% using SVM, 96.80% using KNN while on the other hand, by using CNN, we got 98.72% accuracy on test image data.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning for Marathi Named Entity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Named entity recognition (NER) is an essential Natural Language Processing (NLP) task to find key entities from sentences. In this paper, NewsCorpus Marathi monolingual data set is created, which contains 900 sentences and 7000 tokens. Dataset is scraped from different Marathi news sources available on the internet. Paper analyzed traditional NER and POS (Part of Speech) tagging approaches for the Marathi Language. Marathi is one of the regional languages in India. Paper proposed a Pre-trained Model Approach of transfer learning for Marathi NER. IndicBERT, mBERT, and XLM-Roberta are BERT-based pretrained models that produce state-of-the-art results on a downstream task such as Named Entity Recognition. BERT model is specifically trained on Wikipedia and Google’s BooksCorpus. Paper comparing the transfer learning approach with traditional machine learning algorithms. Transfer learning-based models perform well than the conventional approach. IndicBERT is performing better among other BERT-based models on our Corpus.

articleTitle: Approach for Predicting Mobile Malware
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Mobile malware is increasing the number of malicious behaviours such as capturing users' information, delivering subscription SMS, and making calls to premium lines without their awareness. Several studies have explored strategies to counter these assaults in order to build an effective detection method. In the world of security, mobile security has been a quickly rising field. The demand for mobile security has risen considerably in recent years as the number of mobile devices and applications has grown. To deal with enormous no. of harmful mobile apps, a variety of malware detection techniques are reported in various studies. In this research, we offer hybrid method for determining most optimal parameters for detecting mobile malware. We developed a system for predicting mobile malware using a hybrid of ANFIS and NIMOA in our hybrid method. In compared to previous optimization methods, evaluations using real-world datasets illustrate the usefulness of our approach.

Author Keywords: Mobile malware prediction and Mobile malware

articleTitle: Control of Rumor Spreading in Online Social Network Through an Epidemic Model
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The present mathematical model developed for reducing the spreading of rumors in online social network, electronic commerce and in online community. On the basis equilibrium points and reproduction number, stability of the projected model has been analyzed. The success or failures of any rumor attack depend on reproduction number that represents epidemic threshold. For the validation of proposed mathematical model, simulated data have compared with the results available in literature.

articleTitle: Realtime Energy Monitoring And Control Using Iot Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In the present work, an IoT-based real-time energy monitoring & controlling system of electric appliances is discussed. It aims to provide a low-cost IoT device capable of monitoring and controlling the energy consumption of a wide range of electric appliances. The proposed design is comprised of an inexpensive current and voltage sensor and ESP-32 mini microcontroller for acquiring data from sensor nodes and uploading it to the server over the internet. The outcome of the experiment showed that the developed IoT-enabled system has the potential to capture the voltage, current, and apparent power and compute the overall energy consumed by the electric appliances..

articleTitle: Cardiovascular Disease Prediction Using KNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Innovation has made considerable progress in the course of the most recent couple of years, individuals presently use web as their base vehicle for recovering and trading data. Abundance isn't the main thing of our life which individuals search for nowadays. Well being was, is and it will be the genuine abundance for individual. Wellbeing shouldn't be stayed away from anytime in our life. Coronary illness is one of the most well-known factor for passing’s in individual. Cardiovascular sickness is those which influences veins and causes heart infections. The past strategy of ascertaining the obscure measure of these illnesses ease in taking terms to bring down the higher gamble of patients.The well being office has colossal measure of information; the ML calculations helps in clearing the path for forecast and to control examination and medicine. In this examination, technique for eliminating missing information and properties characterization is utilized in per-handling for high precision and navigation. A portion of the calculations utilized for this thing like Decision Tree, KNN and Naive Bayes. Our point is to gather information mining techniques in Cardiovascular illness expectation, by utilizing basic boundary with the goal that it very well may be utilized in Machine 2 Machine remote observing.

articleTitle: Detection of forest fire using support vector machine in comparison with k - nearest neighbour to measure the accuracy, precision and recall
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The performance of novel SVMs for the detection of forest fires is going to be evaluated as part of the proposed work's objectives. The KNN algorithm is used as a benchmark for the SVM algorithm that was just proposed. The forest fire dataset that is currently available on kaggle contains a total of 1599 samples that were gathered. These samples are broken up as follows: 70% are used for the training dataset (which has a total of 1230 records), and 30% are used for the testing dataset (which has a total of 369 records). For the purpose of quantifying the performance of the SVM algorithm, accuracy, precision, and recall values are calculated. In comparison, the Novel Linear Support vector machine attained an accuracy of 97.5 percent whereas the KNN algorithm only achieved 89.25 percent. The SVM method achieves a precision of 94.3%, whereas the KNN approach achieves a precision of 88.64%. The SVM algorithm yielded a recall of 94.8%, while the KNN algorithm only managed to achieve 87%. The achieved significant value is less than 0.001 with a probability of less than 0.05. When compared to the KNN algorithm, the SVM's accuracy, precision, and recall were all shown to be significantly higher. According to the findings of this research, the SVM algorithm performed significantly better than the KNN method when it came to the detection of forest fires using the dataset under consideration.

articleTitle: A Novel Double-Threshold Neural Classifier for Non-Linearly Separable Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Classification of data finds applications in various engineering and scientific problems. When real-time operation is desired, hardware solutions tend to be more amenable as compared to algorithmic/heuristic solutions. This paper presents a novel current-mode dual-threshold neuron designed and implemented at 32nm CMOS technology node. Subsequently, a current-mode double-threshold classifier is presented which is capable of classifying input patterns of non-linearly separable problems. Thereafter, application of the current-mode dual-threshold neuron in the realization of the XOR function using only a single neural unit is discussed. The proposed neuron as well as both the applications discussed are capable of operating from sub-1V power supplies. Computer simulations using HSPICE yield promising results with the values of delay and power consumption estimated to be lower than existing circuits.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection in Cloud Architecture Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The research of Intrusion Detection Systems is known to be among the most challenging aspects of Cloud Security. In the context of the cloud, security breaches such as denial of service, scanning, injection of malicious code, viruses, worms, and the breaking of passwords are becoming increasingly commonplace. In the event that these attacks are not stopped in a timely manner, the company's reputation may be put in jeopardy, and it may sustain financial harm. As a consequence of this, it is essential to safeguard the cloud against dangers of this kind. In this research, we provide solutions to defend cloud systems by incorporating some of the most successful methods of intrusion detection. Within IDS, our primary focus has been placed on two critical aspects: the effectiveness of the detection techniques and the pace of detection. In order to overcome these obstacles, we suggest utilising machine learning in conjunction with parallelization. Approaches based on machine learning gain information from the data itself, hence diminishing the significance of the human expert. In order to identify intrusions, statistical models, safe system approaches, neural networks, and a variety of other methods are utilised. The purpose of this study is to improve the accuracy of intrusion detection in cloud computing by presenting a new approach to intrusion detection that is based on existing intrusion detection systems and the various architectures that those systems employ.

articleTitle: A Survey of Machine learning algorithms for Lung cancer detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Cancer has the highest mortality rate and the succeeding most regular found cancer is lung cancer in both men and women. Various tests are carried out to detect lung cancer and some of them are expensive and risky for the human being. In this paper various techniques discovered for the early detection of lung cancer have been presented, in which electrical nose technology is effective giving the 0.8871 accuracy & G-mean is 0.8676. Some researchers had taken 1st stage patients' data while some had considered the 2nd stage. Various hybrid techniques are with Machine Learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Text Classification Using Feature Extraction and Classification Model
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Sentiment analysis represents context-based text mining that classifies and abstracts particular information from the source data, and helps to interpret people's feelings. It adopts the NLP approach to classify people's opinions regarding goods or feedback. Sentiment analysis handles people's opinion and behavior in the context of feelings and attitudes concerning an episode or incidence. There are many domains that use opinion mining widely such as commercial goods review, social media study and film evaluation and so on. Semantic analysis provides major support in building recommendation frameworks. User provides textual feedback such as web-based reviews, remarks or responses on social networking and business sites. Machine learning is a common approach used for classification. This project devises a nascent methodology through the integration of dissimilar frameworks. This work applies Random Forest as a feature extraction method for taking out crucial features of the data suite. The K-mean clustering is enforced which can cluster similar type of features and in the last voting classifier is applied. Voting classifier consists of LR, KNN, SVM models. Python is the tool used in this work for the implementation of the devised methodology and evaluates new methodology with respect to some global performance indices.

articleTitle: Alzheimer’s disease Classification using various machine learning approaches: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a neurodegenerative illness in which brain cells deteriorate and die. It is a chronic illness. It is an incurable condition that causes memory loss as it proceeds. This research focuses on a detailed investigation of Convolution Neural Network-based computer-aided diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease (CNN). An accurate Alzheimer's disease (AD) diagnosis is critical for patient’s treatment, especially in the early stages of the disease. Prior knowledge allows patients to take preventive treatments before irreversible brain damage starts to occur.The main objective of this study is to assess more effective and coherent machine learning strategies for Alzheimer's disease classification. The main machine learning approaches examined in this study are Support Vector Machine (SVM), Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), and Deep Learning (DL). From the different kinds of literature, it is observed that the Convolutional Neural Network surpasses other approaches to diagnosing neurological illnesses.

articleTitle: A Reliable and efficient data transfer on wireless sensor networks by using Optimization algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network technologies that require collecting all node-generated data without any losses like structural monitoring. Since wireless networks and resource constraints present additional challenges, point-to-point transmission, which is employed in the network for sustainable communication, becomes extremely ineffective in Wireless Sensor Networks. We investigate elements that determine reliability and explore effective combinations of possible solutions. You can implement information redundancy techniques like rebroadcasting and destruction of data techniques. Additionally, route maintenance, which explores an alternate hop and several faults, minimizes packet drops. In this paper, we evaluated several machine learning optimization algorithms for efficient and reliable data transfer in wireless networks. Our simulation results prove that each opportunity overcomes different types of flaws that occurred by the existing techniques. The Arithmetic Optimization Algorithm, Particle Swarm Optimization, and Shuffled Complex Evolution Algorithm is efficient in obtaining reliability, achieving very high reliability by enduring packet losses, and it responds very instantly to link failures. That’s the proposed combination of optimization algorithms that can prove more than 90% memory consumption with Time, High Speed, and Accuracy by providing an alternative to point-to-point communication over multiple nodes in the network.

articleTitle: Resource managing system for organizations and institutions
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Tracking the assets and resources of an organization or any institution is very essential for them. In every Organization or Institution, they need to track and manage all the assets of an organization. For this purpose, our project Asset Scanner and Tracker is very useful. An institution can be an educational institution, medical institution, any government institutions etc. In this project, all the assets of an organization or institution will be scanned and pushed into the database by the application using the barcode of the Asset. Asset can be an IT Asset or Non IT Asset. IT Assets can be Workstations, printers, monitors etc. Non IT assets can be projectors, scanners, tables, chairs etc. This Application will have many benefits which are given below. This project has four major modules. They are Scanning Assets, Bulk Scanning Assets, Move Asset and Unable to find Asset. We can scan the asset using the asset barcode. It can either be a single asset scanning or a group asset scanning in case of bulk assets. Move Asset feature will help the admin to move the asset state from one location to another location, if the location of the asset is changing and 'Unable to find asset’ will have the assets which are missed during scan and the respective owner will be notified. This project will be really helpful for the institutions or organizations which are having bulk assets and want to manage them.

articleTitle: Comparison of Deep Learning Networks for Source Camera Identification
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Digital Image Forensics is getting more attention in the research area as the need for confirming the authenticity of images is increasing with the increased use of information sharing through social media. Source Camera Identification (SCI) is an important Digital Image Forensic technique to ensure the identity of the source/camera which has captured a particular image. SCI methods are hot topics in research area for two decades, but with the advancement of Convolutional Neural Networks for Computer Vision applications, so many deep learning based techniques for Source Camera Identification is proposed. This paper aims to review the important deep learning networks for Source Camera Identification. In this paper, we describe the basic structure of the algorithm for Source Camera Identification and present a detailed comparison of various deep learning based techniques on the basis of accuracy, number of cameras and dataset used. Also a source camera device identification technique is implemented using VGG16 model witha an accuracy of 87.16% which is higher than the state of the art methods.

articleTitle: Dual Active Mid-Point DC-DC Converter for Bidirectional Power Transfer
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The fast pace of Electric Vehicles adoption growth has demanded the development of high performance bidirectional DC-DC converters (BDCs). Out of the different power configuration circuits available for such power transfer, the Dual Active Bidirectional (DAB) converter has definite advantage that make it particularly attractive for automotive applications. This paper presents a Dual Active Mid-Point (DAMP) DC-DC converter, derived from DAB and bidirectional push-pull DC-DC topology. The model, performance and design benefits of this converter is discussed for off-board battery charging system.

articleTitle: COVID 19 Prediction Using Chest X-Ray And CNN Hyperparameter Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: According to mid-June 2020, the abrupt escalation of coronavirus reported widespread fear and crossed 16 million confirmed cases. To fight against this growth, clinical imaging is recommended, and for illustration, X-Ray images can be applied for opinion. This paper categorizes chest X-ray images into three classes- COVID-19 positive, normal, and pneumonia affected. We have used a CNN model for analysis, and hyperparameters are used to train and optimize the CNN layers. Swarm-based artificial intelligent algorithm - Grey Wolf Optimizer algorithm has been used for further analysis. We have tested our proposed methodology, and comparative analysis has been done with two openly accessible dataset containing COVID- 19 affected, pneumonia affected, and normal images. The optimized CNN model features delicacy, insight, values of F1 scores of 97.77, 97.74, 96.24 to 92.86, uniqueness, and perfection, which are better than models at the leading edge of technology.

articleTitle: Bandwidth Enhancement of MPA with Parasitic Patch Antenna for WIMAX Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The purpose of the work is to conduct a comparison analysis between a rectangular patch antenna and a novel MPA using a parasitic patch at a range of 2.5 GHz frequency for WIMAX applications. Materials and Methods: Two groups—the Novel Micro strip parasitic patch antenna and the rectangular patch antenna—are taken into consideration for the comparison analysis. Twenty samples in all are used. The samples' pretest power is 80%. Results: The parasitic patch MPA has a 250 MHz bandwidth, which is significantly higher than the 10 rectangular patch antenna 0 MHz bandwidth of the rectangular patch. This is indicated by the statistical significance value of 0.048 (p 0.05). Conclusion: In terms of bandwidth, the microstrip parasitic patch antenna outperforms the RPA greatly.

articleTitle: Customer’s Attitude and Awareness Customer’s Attitude and Awareness Towards Food App System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Services may be of different types. Some are done free of cost, while some are for different purposes like social services, economic etc. Some other examples are accounting services, banking, consultation, education, cleaning etc.Likewise, food app services are one of the rapidly growing and popular digital technological services. It is delivered through different platforms like internet, apps, web pages and social media. With the development of internet it is rapidly growing especially among youth who are away studying, and attending various jobs.Here, we can also study about the change in behavior of people with the development of various technologies and how we can provide the people with the services relates to the technologies and how they are satisfied with the services. For example, with the development of internet many people like enjoying services from home like ordering food at home instead of going to some restaurant.We can also understand the customers and their purchase behavior. The second most important purpose of this paper is to study various popular food app services and their role on restaurant business or industry.

articleTitle: Smart Face Recognition Based Attendance System Using ML Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The system's goal is to make the attendance marking process quick and easy because the teacher's mundane job in class is time consuming in monitoring the students while marking attendance and ensuring that no proxy attendance is marked.To solve the problem efficiently, the system employs a machine approach that makes use of Python's OpenCV library. The Haar cascade algorithm and the LBPH algorithm are used for face detection and recognition. The system is designed to be s ufficiently accurate in comparison to other systems.

articleTitle: Blockchain and Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Cryptography is one of the most intriguing and arising advances these days, with its scope starting from digital currencies to even being beneficial in small industries. This paper discusses various tools and functions which are important to understand the basics of this innovation and the underpinnings of its technology. Different components like digital signatures, Merkel trees and hash functions are assessed in the extent of their use as building blocks of this technology.

articleTitle: Hybrid Approach for Human Emotion Recognition from Speech
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Even though emotions don’t have much to do with the content of the speech, it has a major impact on human communication by providing much more positive feedback. Therefore, Speech emotion recognition (SER) and multimodal emotion recognition systems have been a hot area of research owing to their range of applications in several domains, such as social robots, virtual reality, and human-machine interaction applications. This paper compares two models by choosing multi-dimension CNN models and features for SER on the RAVDESS dataset.

articleTitle: Circularly Polarized Two Port Flexible Antenna for WLAN and Wi-Fi-6 Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this paper, a circular polarized and two-port flexible antenna is designed for Wi-Fi-6 and WLAN applications. Inverted C-shaped radiators with modified L-shaped feed are used to increase the electric length of the antenna. Two vertical stubs are attached to the ground and manipulate the surface current for CP behavior in the higher band. A modified T-shaped stub between antenna elements is used to enhance the isolation and circular polarization. The T-shaped stub enhances the electric length of the ground as well as divert the surface current, increasing the isolation and improving the CP behavior. The impedance bandwidth of flexible antenna ranges from 5.15 GHz to 6.8 GHz and 70% 3 dB axial ratio from 5.65 GHz to 6.8 GHz. The minimum isolation of the two-port antenna is -16.3 dB, and ECC is below 0.001, which validates the satisfactory operation of the MIMO antenna.

articleTitle: Grayness Comparison of UV and Latex Ink on Vinyl Substrate Printed by Large Format Printing (LFP)
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The printing and packaging industries are highly influencing segment in world economy. The LFP is emerging part of printing and packaging industries. In LFP printing various kind of printing inks are used but ultra violetand latex ink is the most widely used on plastic substrate like vinyl. Therefore apart from other factors colorimetric measurement of print quality factor are essential to ensure high print quality. For rapiddigital production in the printing and packaging industries better print quality is still required. The print quality is major factor for any printing and packaging. The grayness factor is most essential part of the colorimetric values. Grayness can be measured by the spectrophotometer. In the research work, the most commonly substrate vinyl is considered for comparative analysis of grayness of UV and latex ink printed by LFP segment.

articleTitle: Detection of road sign through various detection techniques: A review
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The detection of road sign is a very difficult task when they are not visible for human beings and it is also very important for driverless vehicle. To detect signs, various detection techniques followed by recognition algorithm were developed already. This paper reviews the methods developed for detection of traffic sign in previous decade. Detection methods generally, depends on color, shape and machine learning. SSD (Single Shot Detector), SVM (State Vector Machine), CNN (Convolution Neural Network), RCNN, etc. Edge detection techniques i.e., canny detection technique, sobel detection technique, prewitt detection technique are some detection technique used to detect the edges of sign. Traffic signs were acquired from image database and preprocessing techniques used on it.

articleTitle: Detection of Fake Online Recruitment Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: There are a numerous amount of job postings on the internet and sometime these vacancy postings turns out to be fake. Even on the reputed and trusted job advertising platforms, people fall prey to these fake advertisements . After selection in the job, hiring people start demanding for money and details of bank account. Good number of candidates gets duped and lose loads of money and sometimes even their current jobs. So it would be very helpful to identify if the job listed on the website is real or fake. In this paper, we have used machine learning to detect fraud job vacancy postings.In our proposed ML technique, we have applied two data balancing techniques namely "Adaptive Sympathetic" and "Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique" in combination with "Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency" which if a feature extraction method. However, in the literature, some research have used "Bag of Words" for extraction of features which could just count the no. of times of the word appeared whereas the technique used in this research work (i.e TF-IDF) also provides the importance of words. The public "Employment Scam Aegean Dataset" (EMSCAD) was used which contained around 18000 job listings out of which about 800 are fraud listings. We have used two machine-learning models such as Random Forest and k- nearest classifiers to detect the online job is face or real. We have compared the performance of proposed models with existing models and it performs better in terms of recall, precision and f1-scores.

articleTitle: Directivity & VSWR Enhancement of Microstrip Patch antenna at 9.45GHz for Different Substrate Thickness variations in Comparison with Conventional 1.6mm Substrate thickness
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In this manuscript a rectangular-shaped microstrip patch antenna (MPA) at a frequency of 9.45GHz by varying the thickness(1mm, 1.2mm, 1.4mm, 1.8mm)of the substrate to enhance the Directivity and VSWR of the antenna. With a sample size of 20, a MPA with microstrip line feed method and varied substrate thickness is employed. Directivity and VSWR of the Microstrip patch antenna are enhanced and highlighted using HFSS Simulation Software in contrast to a varied substrate thickness of the antenna. The Simulation Results obtained for the designed antenna are Directivity is 6.8420dB for 1mm, 7.4130dB for 1.2mm, 7.6579dB for 1.4mm, 7.9129dB for 1.8mm and 7.9369dB for 1.6mm. VSWR is 3.01 for 1mm, 1.9 for 1.2mm, 1.60 for 1.4mm, 1.106 for 1.8mm and 1.20 for 1.6mm. Based on statistical analysis, the significance value for directivity is 0.094 and for VSWR is 0.078. Microstrip Patch Antenna Performance Parameters Using Microstrip Line Feed Technique for 1.8mm thickness substrate appears to be improved when compared with Conventional 1.6mm substrate thickness antenna. The suggested antenna is suitable for Wireless Network Communications as well as Multi-band applications.

articleTitle: Transforming online class recording into useful information repositories using NLP methods: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Most educational institutions have adapted to the mode of online teaching which has resulted in an increase of online video recordings. Learner community can be benefited with the ability to retrieve required information from the online class recordings. In this paper, we propose a methodology for converting video transcript data into useful information repositories for the purpose of retrieving class transcripts relevant to user's information needs. We focus on the online video recording transcript data. We also discuss challenges in transcribing which are crucial to understand preliminary processing. Our dataset consists of transcripts from diverse subject domains deeper experimental insights. We use interactive transcripts obtained from ASR (automatic speech recognition) services and non-interactive human generated transcripts. State-of-the-art methods for keyword retrieval: Latent Dirichlet Topic Modelling (LDA), Term Frequency (TF.IDF) and Text Rank (graph based) are applied on the video transcript data. Further, cosine similarity metric is applied to obtain the similarity measure between the transcript documents and keywords.

articleTitle: Neural network based breast cancer detection using hybrid artificial bee colony and black hole algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: When there is development of malignant tumor in breast notably in female is known as Breast cancer. Detection in the early stage of this disease is the only feasible solution. In this paper a new approach has been proposed to detect this disease in the early stage by employing neural networks and optimizing them with the help of a hybrid of artificial bee colony algorithm and black hole algorithm. This combination of neural networks with nature inspired algorithm is able to understand the deep patterns inside the dataset and produce great results. Using the proposed approach an accuracy of 98.94% is achieved on the Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic) Data Set and as a result, is a trustworthy alternative to human experts when it comes to the classify the breast cancer tumors.

articleTitle: Evolution From Industry 1.0 to Industry 5.0
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The industrial revolution is characterized by a shift in methods from agricultural, pastoral, and handicraft economies to the one that is dominated by production industries. The Industrial Revolution brought a significant transformation from economies that were initially based on agriculture to the one that is now dominated by large-scale industries. The Industrial Revolution was first used for Britain’s economic development in 1760 by Arnold Toynbee. It broadly applies to economic transformation rather than a period of time. The primary characteristics of an industrial revolution are technological, cultural, and socioeconomic. During the first industrial revolution, a transition to manufacturing processes using steam and water took place. Electrical technology was primarily used in the second industrial revolution to increase production. The third industrial revolution came with IT and electronics, wherein the main focus was on automation in production. The fourth industrial revolution was to provide customization using AI. The fifth industrial revolution focuses on providing personalization and a human touch to manufacturing methods. Industry 5.0 is sometimes seen as anti-industrial because of its personalization involving the human touch. This paper has done a systematic analysis of the five industrial revolutions.

articleTitle: Mango Tree Disease Health Classification Using High Resolution Image Through Deep learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The main difficulty faced in image processing is to detect the disease of Mango plants. This technique includes 4 phases so that the disease occurred on plant is detected such as to pre-process the image, segment an image, extract the attributes and classify an image. In initial phase, the contrast of the input image is de-noised or increased. The points which are not visible are highlighted; the PNSR (peak signal noise ratio) is maximized and the magnitude signal error value of the image is mitigated in this stage. The second stage is the segmentation. There are two kinds of segmentation methods: threshold and region-based segmentation. The various type of feature selection algorithms are used for the feature extraction. The various schemes which are already proposed for the Mango plant disease detection are reviewed in this paper.

articleTitle: Preprocessing Analysis of Medical Image: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The diagnosis process determines the disease of humans based on the symptoms/signs that possessed. Manual decisions are made being observations and recognition of the medical test are considered upon the condition of the diseased. It is observed that manual decisions in Cancer therapy, tumor detection heading the life of the patients at high risk. The medical industry has made significant technological advancements that reduce human error in disease detection. Computer-aided diagnosis systems like magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and CT scan play a significant part in medical diagnosis. In this paper, we are presenting the various approaches that analyze the use cases of the medical images; the major effect is that, images obtained from the computerized diagnosis systems may produce the results with some artifacts like impulse noise, Gaussian noise, Speckle noise etc., so the preprocessing techniques that are proposed by the different researchers to improve the accuracy of diagnosis process by reducing the different noise mentioned earlier.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Clustering and Routing Protocols for Energy-Efficient WSN
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Tiny sensor nodes are used to configure the wireless sensor networks. Such a network has faced the problem of limited resources, mainly energy. Here, energy-efficient clustering and routing (EECR) is an attractive and appealing field for researchers to increase the lifetime of individual nodes and WSNs. Clustering is dividing the sensor nodes into different size clusters, where clusters head are selected, which gathers cluster information. Furthermore, routing defines paths for sending data from sensor nodes to the sink node via different cluster heads. This article consists of the architecture of SN, the development of clustering and routing techniques for making it more energy-efficient, and its challenges. We have presented comparative studies of the various techniques based on network types, clustering topologies, cluster head selection, inter-cluster connectivity, cluster head stabilization, and application of opti-mized algorithms.

articleTitle: Smart Authentication Process for Human and Vehicles Using AI Techniques : An Approach for making better life in 21st Century Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The Entry detection system as the name suggests detects entry attempts. Till date entry to organizations like schools and colleges are provided by the guards that do not map entries and exits to the premises very efficiently which is a serious security concern and also it is not humanly possible to identify each student and stop outsiders who might be disguised from entering. Ours is a face detection and facial recognition system which detects faces from a live video feed recorded from a camera installed at the gates, recognizes the face using the data set of registered staff and students of the college and opens the gates to allow entry.It also maintains a record of entry and exits along with time in a database for security purposes. OpenCV is used for facial and vehicle no. plate detection which forwards to the dlib library that is used for deep metric learning and extracting facial embeddings and finally is face recognition library that displays the real time name of the person. This helps in authorized entry by correct identification along with a record of entry and exit times. The system meets the requirement as it forwards the result from the recognizer to the connected sensors and effectors for providing/restraining entry in required cases.

articleTitle: SGD-DABiLSTM based MRI Segmentation for Alzheimer’s disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a neurodegenerative ailment that causes memory and cognitive skills to deteriorate over time. It is a terrible neurological ailment that causes memory and cognition impairments, as well as behavioural issues, neuropsychiatric disorders and impairment in everyday tasks. AD is diagnosed as a cause of death in elderly people. It is also one of the most difficult diseases to diagnose, especially in the early stages, using standard manual approaches. Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a popular tool for detecting neurodegenerative disorders because of its high spatial resolution. In this work a deep attention bidirectional long short-term memory (DABiLSTM) with stochastic gradient optimisation (SGDO) is utilised for the detection of AD. For pre-processing brain MRI images, the gaussian bilateral filter is used. The anomaly section of the obtained image is segmented using a BiLSTM based on deep attention. The system is optimised using stochastic gradient descent optimization (SGDO), which minimises the neutral network's error rate. This work is implemented using the MATLAB tool and the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative 2 (ADNI2) dataset. When compared with current approaches, the proposed method obtained an accuracy of 94.63 % in the detection of AD.

Author Keywords: Deep Attention Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory

articleTitle: Semantic Knowledge Base Ontology Framework for Discovery Stage of the Design Thinking Using Web Ontology Language
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The design thinking process involves the development of concepts and designs for products, software, buildings, machines, communication systems, and many other areas that can be used to solve practical and creative problems. Research in natural and laboratory contexts has identified numerous vital concepts and aspects of design thinking. Various fields have adopted design thinking methods and processes, including architecture, engineering, and business. However, the methods and techniques are primarily influenced by design thinking. Design thinking can be used in any field; it does not necessarily have to be design-oriented. Innovative products and services are also developed through a design thinking approach in business and society. The core of design thinking is user-centricity. Identifying and meeting people's needs is a critical component of the approach. Empathy depends on communication. In this paper, Ontology Web Language (OWL) is used in the protege editor to implement the discovery phase of Design Thinking. "Through the use of nomenclature and OWL properties, a variety of entities, classes, and objects are identified individually during the discovery phase.

articleTitle: Assertion of Low Bone Mass in Osteoporotic X-ray images using Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Osteoporosis is a disease that causes low bone mass and bone tissue deterioration. The application of medical image segmentation in identifying the anomalies present in the multimodal medical images is utilized in this work to predict and locate the low bone mass section. The X ray dataset is downloaded from the freely available Kaggle repository contains osteoporosis and normal bone images. This paper utilizes Gabor Filter for the extraction of features and the modified U-net algorithm derived from Deep Convolutional Neural Network for segmentation. For improvement over classical U-Net, we had gone for Parametric Relu as an activation function to overcome the disadvantages of Relu while keeping the advantages of Relu intact. The performance metric parameters including Mean Squared Error (MSE), Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR), Tanimoto Co-efficient index (TC), Dice Overlap Index (DOI) and computational time (T) are evaluated andthe outcomes attained are remarkable.Some fuzzy logic dependent rules could be applied to the final outcome of image processing and deep learning techniques for clinical decision making and handling treatmenttherapy of those suffering from any of these orthopedic ailments in the regular clinical practices. The proposed method performs better on many aspects than the existing deep learning algorithms like Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN).

articleTitle: Prediction of Cardiac Arrest using Artificial Intelligence - A Systematic Review
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Now a days Sudden Cardiac Death become a major problem in the healthcare field. Due to sudden cardiac arrest, the probability of survival of a person is very low. An early prediction of cardiac arrest can help to increase the survival rate of a person so that necessary treatment can be started as soon as possible. In recent times traditional methods have been used for the prediction of sudden cardiac arrest. But nowadays artificial intelligence approach has been used for the early prediction of cardiac arrest on a complex dataset which provides a remarkable result than the traditional method. An exploratory review on Sudden cardiac arrest has been carried out through IEEE explorer, Elsevier, Google Scholar, Springer Link and Science Direct database. These reviews have been done between the years 2015 and 2022.

articleTitle: Learning Management System: An Approach towards Virtual Education
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: With India’s rapid educational growth towards virtual education, the education system has intensified. India has gone through critical condition like COVID-19. There is huge increment in the implementation of online learning management system. This helped the educational institutions to manage their education system without being physically present in the institution. This paper is presenting the challenges required by institutions to transform their manual education system into virtual/online education system. The online learning management system has enhanced the way of teaching and learning process of students. This study will tell us about how online LMS has speeding up the quality of education for the On-Campus enrolled students as well as distance learning students also. In general, LMS are built to provide the course material in a static way only. The modern LMS has the ability for the group discussion which is helping the student to achieve the qualities of team-working.

articleTitle: Magnification independent fine-tuned transfer learning adaptation for multi-classification of breast cancer in histopathology images
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Breast cancer is the prominent foremost disease causing death among the various cancers affecting female. Precise and initial diagnosis of diseases can often save lives. Histopathology microscopy imaging as a best practice used by pathologist to diagnose breast cancer. The procedure is labor intensive and time consuming. Hence, investigation of tissue samples in automated manner from histopathology images has constructive clinical implication in early diagnosis and treatment of disease. To capture discriminating traits from images in better way, images are acquired at various optical magnifications (x40, x100, x200 and x400). The disease can be treated well if the type of actual subclass of benign and malignant categories on a sample image is known early. The research gap observed in current literature isthat, limited study done on magnification independent multi- classification. With recent advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI)especially deep learning, the Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) can be effectively utilized for automatic histopathology image analysis. In this work, multi-classification framework across different magnification factor using recent tax- onomy of BreakHis dataset is proposed. The proposed approach explores different transfer learning models with fine tuning adaptation. The experiments have shown impressive results on pre-trained models DenseNet121 as well as on DenseNet201. Promising results are observed towards multi-classification of breast cancer histopathology images as compared to other models.

articleTitle: E-Voting System Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In every nation, democratic elections are a momentous and weighty occurrence, and the voting system that is now in place requires the use of ballots or electronic voting machines (EVM). Transparency, poor turnout, vote manipulation, distrust of electoral organizations, fabrication of unique IDs (voting party IDs), and delays in posting results are some of the issues that arise as a result of these procedures. The matter of safety is of the utmost importance. When considering the installation of a computerized voting system, voter confidentiality has always been one of the most important concerns. There is no question regarding the system's capability to secure itself in contrast to prospective assaults and safeguard data in the face of such big choices. Utilization of blockchain technology is one approach that might be taken to resolve security concerns. The blockchain technology has an endless number of different uses that might be implemented. The technology known as blockchain is a distributed ledger that makes it possible for peer-to-peer networks all over the world to handle digital assets. In this context, distributed ledger technology represents an intriguing development. A grouping of all transactions is referred to as a block. Immutability, decentralisation, security, transparency, and anonymity are some of the outstanding properties offered by blockchain technology. The combination of blockchain technology with smart contracts has shown promise as a viable option for the development of trustworthy and open-source electronic voting systems. In this article, we demonstrate how to use blockchain technology with the help of a wallet and the Solidity programming language to build an electronic voting application. The programme was designed as a smart contract for the Ethereum network. In order to avoid having the same person vote twice, the user's wallet will only hold a certain number of tokens (gas), which will be depleted each time the user casts a vote. This article talks about the pros and cons of using blockchain technology. It also shows a practical solution in the form of a web app for voting and analyses its limits.

articleTitle: Analysis of Optimal Design Model in Vehicle Routing Problem based on Hybrid Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The organizations such as the online product sales and delivery system increases the number of vehicle movement and thus generate the routing problems for vehicle. In that, some of the products like medical equipment, medicinal products are needs to deliver in the proper time to prevent unexpected problems. Due to increase in the vehicle traffic, this needs to focus on better routing system in the vehicle movement with speed of transport and optimal routing area. This paper analyzed different optimization algorithm along with the hybrid optimization algorithm to solve this problem. There are several optimization algorithms are used to identify the optimal routing path for the vehicle movement based on the basic parameters such as the number of customers or users, number of vehicles that are allocated and the distance that the vehicles can travel. This also focused on the cost efficiency and the reduction of time complexities with relevant other parameters.
