The proposed hybridization of optimization algorithm involves the selection of best route and the coverage area with minimum number of vehicles and the best fitness value. The overall work was analyzed and tested with the result comparison of other optimization algorithms to represent the performance of Hybrid ACO-GA combination than the other state-of-art methods.

articleTitle: Stock Prices Forecasting using Time Series Analysis with Arima
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Stock price is an entirely capricious area of money, that includes an enormous number of financial backers, purchasers, and dealers. Consistent varieties in stock and monetary business sectors add vulnerability to the area making forecasting an intricate interaction. On account of these highlights, monetary information should have a fierce design that frequently makes it hard to track down dependable models. The stock expectation has been a peculiarity since AI was presented. Stock costs are not haphazardly produced values rather they can be treated as a discrete-time series model which depends on a bunch of obvious mathematical information things gathered at progressive focuses at ordinary time frames. However, not many methods became valuable for anticipating the stock cost as it changes with time. Since it is fundamental to distinguish a model to examine patterns of stock costs with sufficient data for navigation, it suggests that changing the time series utilizing ARIMA is a preferred algorithmic methodology over determining straightforwardly, as it gives more genuine and solid outcomes. Time Series (TS) examination can be utilized to foresee momentary stock costs.

articleTitle: A Systematic Survey of Happiness from an Analytical Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The paper is a survey paper that talks about studies around happiness. We have surveyed papers about the scales of measuring happiness, in which the scales are proposed, demonstrated and examined. Happiness is affected by various factors, which can be called indicators of happiness. Some of the papers we reviewed validate the significance of such indicators with applications. The indicators include inflation, unemployment, health, loneliness, and sports. Modern technology helps researchers estimate and forecast happiness and effectively find the relation between factors affecting happiness. Researchers use different methodologies to study happiness. The data used in the papers were retrieved from surveys and existing Happiness Report, designed surveys appropriate for the study. Models were proposed for forecasting happiness using Machine Learning and Neural Networks. From the reviews, we identify research gaps in the area for future work. This paper gives an overview of the studies around the area of happiness from an analytical approach.

articleTitle: Detection of diabetic Retinopathy using Retinal Fundus Images
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy is one of the diabetes consequences that affects the eyes. This is caused by damage to the blood vessels in the retina, the light-sensitive tissue in the rear of the eye. It may create no symptoms at first, or it may cause minor eyesight difficulties. When the blood vessels become damaged, they may leak and this leakage can cause dark spots on our vision. The DR can be detected by finding the Hard Exudate present in it. The deep networks are becoming deeper and more complex. So that adding more number of layers to a neural network can make it stronger for image related tasks. But the main disadvantage in adding more layers is that, it may greatly reduces the accuracy of the image and also the data models are complex. In order to overcome this drawback, Recurrent Neural Network can be introduced. The fundamental benefit of using a recurrent neural network is that it can represent a collection of data in such a way that each pattern may be presumed to be reliant on the one before it. It can process inputs of any length. Even if the input size is large, the model size will not change. It makes the training process faster and attains more accuracy while compared to other neural networks. This method greatly reduces the loss of accuracy because each layer knows the information of the top layers while updating the weights. This Recurrent Neural Network has more number of parameters , so it is obvious that it can produce better result as compared to other net.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Genetic Algorithm Operators for the Seat Allocation Problem
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: One of the major aspects of conducting an examination is ensuring proper seating arrangement. Exam seat allocation is a tedious task and is often done manually. Examinations are often weakened by malpractices occurring during the examination process. It is necessary to reduce malpractice to maintain the integrity of examinations. Automatic seat allocation is a simple way to curtail the need for human assistance and save time. It also eliminates the possibility of making mistakes. In this paper, we compare the performances of various genetic algorithm operators in allocating seats to students for examinations. The seat allocation is done in such a way that the student's neighboring seats are occupied by other students who are writing examinations for subjects that are not similar. This helps in minimizing the probability of malpractice taking place in examination halls. We also suggest a crossover operator that can be applied to similar permutation-based problems.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Deepfake Detection Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In recent years, the number of images and videos shared online increased and people have easy ways to access such content. “DeepFake” refers to any multimedia content created using deep learning technology in order to make it appear realistic. The creation of deepfake videos and images using deep learning techniques leads to very realistic “DeepFake” videos and images by changing the digital content of images and videos. Deepfake is widely recognized as one of artificial intelligence’s most dangerous uses. Deepfake makes it possible to place a person in a totally imaginary situation since it is used to imitate an activity that the person did not perform. Deepfakes have been becoming increasingly dangerous to democracy, society’s security and people’s privacy. The distribution of such deepfake content on various platforms urged the international community to revaluate the threat to social security posed by such content. It encouraged the researchers around the world to develop effective deepfake detection methods. In this paper we have discussed such approaches of deepfake detection in videos and images that are available in recent studies and have provided comparative review of research on deepfake detection algorithms. It also compares the different detection techniques and examines their limitations and advantages.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Prognosis using Machine Learning Techniques: A Literature Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Globally, breast cancer (BC) is women's leading cause of death. Primarily breast tissues are involved in the development of breast cancer. The population growth in medical research has made it increasingly necessary to study cancer in its early stages. A growing population has resulted in an exponential increase in breast cancer deaths. Among women, it is the second most common cancer. Cancer prediction is crucial for updating treatment aspects and patient survival standards. Aside from being a research center and a good strategy, machine learning (ML) methods are particularly effective in predicting breast cancer and detecting it early. The Wisconsin Cancer Diagnostic dataset (WBCD) was used to compare five ML algorithms: decision trees (C4.5), support vector machines (SVMs), logistic regression (LR), random forests, and convolutional neural networks (CNNs). Through machine-learning algorithms, this study aims to identify which algorithms are best suited for the early detection of breast cancer and the prediction and diagnosis of the disease using predictive algorithms. As a result of this study, different machine learning algorithms were compared, and it was found that Random Forest had higher accuracy, with a 99.8% accuracy rate.

Author Keywords: Random Forest (RF) and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)

articleTitle: Analysis of Cyber Defense mechanisms using honeypots in Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The demand for IT infrastructure is increasing at an exponential rate as markets migrate to the digital environment. Cloud computing services are becoming more and more enticing to individuals as well as organizations because of its openness and ease of use. Additionally, Cloud Computing provides IT resources at low to no capital costs and the pay-as-you-go model gives the required incentives to startups and new market players. Nevertheless, the sheer enormity of cloud-based services, as well as the enormous volume of data stored there, attracts both attackers and victims. Attack vectors on cloud vary from Insider attacks to Account Hijacking and from Cloud injection to Denial-of- Service attacks. Problems like loss of control and databreaches stem from aforementioned attack vectors that lead to lack of trust among clients. Thus, the security aspect of cloud environments has become paramount.Honeypots are simple mechanisms that are designed to detect and fend off malicious requests away from critical institutional resources. Honeypots predominantly implement virtualization techniques to create virtual systems and environments with apparent vulnerabilities to attract potential attackers. Initial attempts in the area of Cloud security, as well as the approaches utilized to safeguard and protect these systems, are incorporated into this article. Additionally, this article also focuses on Honeypot technologies and compares them to anomaly detection and signature-based intrusion detection.

articleTitle: Unconstrained Face Recognition System using Deep Neural Network: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The human face is one of the easiest bio-metric modality that does not require any special imaging techniques or subject cooperation. This benefits a wide range of applications, from automatic image tagging in social media structures to critical applications such as border control and surveillance forensics. Different other modalities of bio-metrics are also accurate and sophisticated, but they can hardly replace the need for facial bio-metrics. The success of face recognition technology is limited to unconstrained facial image acquisition scenarios. In the unconstrained scenarios acquiring of face images is not well controlled and subjects may be uncooperative, hence, degrading the performance of face recognition systems. Such confounding factors include variations in facial pose and expression, nonuniform illumination, occlusion and low image resolution. This paper details the state-of-the-art facial recognition techniques in uncontrolled environment and compare on the basis of their accuracy.

articleTitle: Power and Performance Issues and Management Approaches in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Cloud computing is a relatively new developing technology that allows users to pay for services on a pay-as-you-go basis. It provides internet-based information and communication technology services, while virtualization enables it to deliver computer resources. Datacenters are the backbone of this technology, consisting of networked computers, cables, power supply units, and other components that host and store corporate data. In cloud datacenters, high performance has always been the most important consideration, but it comes at the expense of power consumption. The key problem is finding a balance between the system's performance and power consumption by lowering power usage without compromising the quality and performance of services. As a result, several attempts are now being done to reduce datacenter energy usage. All concerns relating to energy efficiency are explored and researched in this work. This paper also presents an overview of various power and performance management strategies in cloud computing.

articleTitle: ConvXGDFU - Ensemble Learning Techniques for Diabetic Foot Ulcer Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Medical practitioners have been studying Diabetic Foot Ulcers (DFU) as a critical subject for treatment purposes. The fundamental objective is to achieve a mechanism for early detection and identification of DFU, ensuring effective treatment before progressing to a critical stage. The traditional clinical techniques have drawbacks, such as a high diagnosis cost, high clinical workload, and an extended treatment time. Moreover, the cost of delayed detection and treatment can lead to significant significance. Although this approach yields outstanding results, a remote, cost-effective, and easy DFU diagnostic method is required. In recent times, Machine Eearning and Deep Learning methods have proven to be very effective and efficient in medical diagnosis and disease detection. The fundamental objective of this study is to build an efficient Artificial Intelligence model for detecting DFUs. We have proposed a novel Deep Learning model using CNNs and XGBoost for DFU detection. Our proposed model is called ConvXGDFU, which can efficiently classify DFU vs Normal Skin patches. Results show that our devised model achieved an accuracy and F1 score of 99.90% and 99.60% for both classes.

articleTitle: PET-Droid: Android Malware Detection Using Static Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Android is the most popular mobile operating environment with the highest share in the market. This makes Android vulnerable to attacks from cybercriminals. Cybercriminals develop malware to attack Android applications. Malware detection models rely on anti-virus vendors to acquire signatures of malware. These signatures are used to train models in a supervised machine learning paradigm. However, a significant number of data is mislabeled, which affects the detection of malware as the model is trained with inaccurate data. To address this issue, a malware detection model, PET-Droid is developed in this literature which uses unsupervised machine learning to find commonalities in the features possessed by malware and goodware samples. PET-Droid detects Android malware with an accuracy of 96.8481%.

articleTitle: Investigating Opthalmic images to Diagnose Eye diseases using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In Ophthalmology, several eye image related diagnostic methodologies started offering meaningful insight about eye disease based on huge set of data points and morphological datasets. The common causes of various eye abnormalities are any trauma, aging and diseases, particularly diabetes. Glaucoma, retinal detachment, Cataract, macular degeneration, diabetic retinopathy, hypertensive Retinopathy, and diabetic macular edema are the most common causes of blindness all around the world. All these diseases are manually suspected and diagnosed by ophthalmologists with clinical practice. Lack of eye care centers and scarcity of trained ophthalmologists are very common in rural and remote areas in developing countries like India. Detection at early stage, followed by appropriate and timely clinical treatment for a varieties of eye diseases, can solve problem of blindness to a large extent. Ophthаlmоlоgist adopt a computerized analysis of ophthalmic imaging modalities for faster clinical screening and accurate diagnosis of these diseases. Latest deep learning models, when compared with traditional machine learning algorithms, speed up the diagnosis of disease and improve accuracy with less false positive rate. This paper investigates all latest deep learning methodologies used in automatic retinal disease diagnosis process concerning different image modalities. This paper also lists some of the most common eye diseases, limitations with the latest developments and potential challenges for future enhancements.

articleTitle: Prediction of Drug Events using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Monitoring vital body parameter during surgical intervention is crucial. Sevoflurane (anesthesia) inhalation produces unconsciousness by weakening the signal pathways in the brain. The drug events related to anesthetic infusion are studied using data from 32 patients (body parameters) who underwent surgery. Heart rate, pulse, and other physiological parameters such as SpO2, systolic blood pressure, diastolic blood pressure, mean blood pressure etO2, inO2, etCO2, and imCO2 also studied.The study of drug concentrations in tissue as a result of the time and dosing frequency is evaluated by Pharmacokinetics, and its effect on body parameters was studied by Pharmacody-namics.Since the data was unlabeled, Machine Learning (ML) regression techniques were employed. Six ML models are used to predict the best fit model: Linear Regression, Support Vector Regression, Bayesian Ridge, Decision Tree Regressor, Gaussian Process Regressor, and XGBoost. The RMSE and MAE results achieved for this models are as follows: 12.19 & 5.762, 0.6038 & 0.5401, 1.125 & 0.951, 0.8113 & 0.7216, 0.7232 & 0.6576, and 0.6028 & 0.54. Amongst which, the XGBoost model is the most efficient because it produces the least errors. As its RMSE and MAE values were relatively low, the best fitted model XGBoost predicted that SpO2 is the most important body parameter.

articleTitle: Analysis of SoC Estimation for Master-Slave BMS Configuration
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The ability to precisely estimate the State of Charge (SoC) of a Lithium-ion battery is critical. BMS plays an important role in ensuring a safe and dependable operation. Due to inefficiency or a tempered algorithm, an inefficient BMS may display the incorrect SoC. As a result, a MasterSlave BMS configuration architecture has been proposed for identifying and correcting SoC estimation error. Following a comparative study on SoC estimation, a hybrid model was chosen for accurate SoC estimation in Master BMS. Six estimation methods were used in conjunction with a dynamic vehicle model. For further improvement, the data-driven methods (Neural Network and Nonlinear Auto-Regression Moving Average -2) are combined.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based Electronic Voting System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Creating a vote counting plan that suits legislators’ legal criteria has been a difficult task for a long time. In the era of global statistics, allocated ledger software is a remarkable technological innovation. Blockchain technology may be applied to an almost infinite number of sharing economy-related applications. The purpose of this paper is to assess the value of blockchain as little more than a vendor for establishing authorized e - government applications. The paper examines the requirements for creating digital votes casting frameworks and analyzes the technical and legal constraints of using blockchain to determine these structures. The research begins with a review of the most well blockchain frameworks that make use of the technology.

articleTitle: Precision Farming of Crops by Optimizing the Agricultural Production using Data Science
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In today’s world where lot of technology and development in technologies they solve many problems be using through data science and technology. we are creating a predictive Model in Agriculture to solve many problems to soil related suitable crops to grow in different climatic condition. The weather changes anytime, due to which the crop is affected more or less water in the crop due to which the crop is spoiled. Whenever there is more or less rain, we will give the model of which crop is easy to do in that season. We have the set of data, on which it would be good to do in different conditions on different climate so that maximum production can be obtained. We have different crops in different climates and there are different conditions in it, due to which the crop gets spoiled. Build a predictive Model so as to suggest the most suitable Crops to grow based on the available Climatic and soil conditions. Achieve Precision Framing by Optimizing the Agricultural Production.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey on Parametric and Non-Parametric Machine Learning Approaches for Bus Arrival Time Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Public transportation plays a major role in modern society. Bus transportation is vitally important in public transportation, and it reduces more than 60% of private vehicle usage. It reduces fuel exhaustion and traffic burdens. Hence, promoting the usage of public transit as against private has become very important recently. The prediction of bus travel and arrival time for the passenger and service provider improves the reliability of the service by reducing the waiting time and uncertainty for the passengers. Several research works have focused on predicting the travel and arrival time of public transit buses in the past. A review of the existing works using parametric and non-parametric machine learning models for bus travel arrival time is conducted in this article. Parameters such as data sources, the spatial-temporal scales, and the study location are considered for the study. It is observed from the review that parametric models are widely used; especially network models, most models use data sourced from the GPS, spatially; segmented routes are well studied, and temporally, all-day data are the most studied. The existing works are well spread across the globe irrespective of developed and developing countries. Overall, it is observed from the survey that bus arrival time prediction is a well-studied area, but still, there is scope for innovative solutions in the future.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of COCOMO for Automated CRM: Application of SE for Customer Retention in 21st century Life Style and Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The project ‘Automation of Customer Relationship Management for IT Industries’ is basically a web-based project for automation of the presales cycle that is going on in the organization for finalization of the deals. There are many CRMs available in market that offers a wide range of services such as team management, team collaboration, project management, contact management, leads management etc. In any organization, the first point of interaction is the presales. First of all, the leads interact with the client and prepare a Software Requirement Specification document which contain all the requirements that client want to get implemented in project. Then presales team will prepare a time and cost estimation report and send it to the review team. If the review team approves the report, then it is handed over to the client else it is sent back to the presales team for further revision of time and cost. It helps to increase the customer retention and acquisition for an organization. CRM refers to all the technologies and tools that is used by organizations to develop and organize all the processes and details of the customer. It includes all the essential services to contact with the user such as email service etc.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Artificial Intelligence based Vehicle Classification Algorithms used to Provide Smart Mobility
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Due to the rising number of vehicles on the road and the limited resources supplied by current infrastructures, traffic problems are becoming more prevalent. Signalized junctions are the prime locations of congestions where commuters need to wait for long time in front of the signals to get their turn to move. This leads to several issues including wastage of time, additional fuel consumption, and green gas emissions. Optimization of traffic signals based on traffic behavior is widely explored topic in which vehicle detection and classification is one of the leading areas of research of Intelligent Transportation System (ITS). Among the technologies Artificial Intelligence (AI) has emerged as a giant in which vehicle classification has developed as a prominent subject of study because of its usefulness in several applications such as traffic control and surveillance, security systems, traffic congestion, avoidance, and accident prevention. Numerous algorithms and techniques for classifying vehicles have been proposed and implemented so far globally which mimics human intelligence. The goal of the paper is to familiarize the reader with the existing AI-based vehicle classification algorithms and to give a comparison of various vehicle detection and classification methods. The existing vehicle classification algorithms are summarized under two categories based on input type i.e., image or video. When the technologies such as AI, image processing, data mining and sensors are combined, the ITS can observe the road, initiate autonomous vehicle detection and thereby control traffic on road efficiently.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Distribution Network with PV System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Due to the advancement of technology, environmental awareness and economic viability, the installation of photovoltaic systems at load points in distribution networks can fulfill the power demands among electrical power system utilities and consumers. To benefit the consumers who install the PV systems a two-way billing system called as ‘Net – metering’ is introduced which can surpass the issues of voltage drop, power cutoffs due to overloading. In addition, this system also exports the energy to grid in case of excess power generation from PV systems at consumer end. This paper fulfills the research gaps in identifying who gets maximum benefits and bear major cost among the utility and the consumer. Since distribution companies (DISCOMS) are at the tail end of the electricity supply management, being the important link with the consumer thus having the potential to expedite the growth of solar rooftop sector. For this study, ten month’s real time data for two PV systems installed at Saharanpur, UP, India is collected from Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Limited (UPPCL). This research also discusses the advantages and disadvantages of installation of PV systems in distribution networks in terms of billing benefits to consumers, transmission and distribution losses and harmonic distortion.

articleTitle: Classification of Galaxies using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Deep Learning is changing our world in a way that we never imagined before. In order to solve and reduce the misclassification of galaxy due to lack of abundance of data we focus to classify Galaxies accurately. We studied different deep learning models for classification of galaxy using transfer learning approach. We tried to improve traditional classification algorithms like Convolutional Neural Network and K-Nearest Neighbor for morphology of galaxies with transfer learning approach. A lot of Machine Learning, deep learning traditional models were explored by us to find optimal algorithm which can yield better result for classification scenarios in terms of accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: A systematic analysis: Remote monitoring of heart rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate, and oxygen saturation based on images and without physical touch
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Never before has the demand for non-contact tools for care of health monitoring been more obvious or evident. Digital camera vital sign measurement (RR, HR, SPo2, and BP) utilizes imaging technologies to analyse photos of the human and compute physiological changes. Since the ubiquitous adoption of digital cameras in all fields, innovations in optics, machine learning, and computer vision have been made. The non-contact monitoring of vital signs may be advantageous in a variety of disciplines of application, from clinical and healthcare settings to vocational and sports activities. This study gives a thorough assessment of camera assessment of physiological vital signs (RR, HR, SPo2, and BP). The viability of camera-used devices and systems in the visible range (380-750nm) for numbers are usually retrieved from videos contains few uncovered body areas (involves the face, hands and torso) with appropriate post processing techniques has been the subject of previous research. We gives an analysis of the physiological and development work for the assessment of vital signs like heart rate, blood oxygen saturation, blood pressure, and respiration rate from digital images in this review. We also discussed possible applications for these technologies. The summaries of findings from numerous applications or validation studies were presented, together with the justification for the measurement, a categorization of the various post-processing techniques used for source images. To encourage the progress of technology, more study is required.

articleTitle: Travelling Sales Person Problem Using Soft Computing – Genetic Algorithm Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Genetic Algorithms (GAs) is a predominant heuristic technique used to improve the solution space for Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP) and real-time problems in dynamic environments. In this paper various genetic algorithms for TSP are reviewed and deliberated about the statement of a salesman who tries to find out a shortest path from his initial location. The Salesman uses a concept of Hamiltonian cycle (which starts and ends at the same location). Many algorithms are used to solve TSP, like Ant-System (AS) Algorithm from Ant Colony Optimization (ACO), NP-Hard, and Dynamic Programming (DP). ACO techniques to solve the Salesman problems or difficulties faced during travelling to various cities, were reviewed to solve optimally. AS is atechnique of ACO inspired from the behaviour of ants. The concept of soft computing leads to enhance the ACO using GA. The principle is to observe the movement of ants from their nest to the food location by finding the shortest path. This randomized search opens various routes from their nest to food location. An algorithm is presented for the TSP using GA’s concepts after a deep study.

articleTitle: A Taxonomy for Internet of Things in Security Distributed Denial of Service Attacks
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has emerged as a fundamental breakthrough in the real-world use of wireless media’s immense potential. We may use several innovative programs that operate independently on multiple platforms virtually anywhere to manage our environment. The Internet of Things (IoT) is widely exploited as a platform for expanding malicious organizations due to its ubiquitous use. These organizations acquire access to authorized equipment by exploiting IoT vulnerabilities, which can be caused by a range of circumstances like a lack of resources, inadequate security, and so on, and can be utilized in various ways. Distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks an IoT network that seeks to reduce server availability by overloading the false queries from scattered IoT devices via a communication connection. Because of recent reports of the destruction of numerous notable servers, fighting DDoS in IoT has become a pressing study topic. The notion of malware and botnets operating at the back of ‘Distributed’ DoS in IoT is discussed in this study. The various DDoS defense strategies are given in general terms and contrasted with exposing security issues. We also discuss the ongoing research problems and challenges that must be addressed to develop a more vigorous and more intelligent DDoS defense.

articleTitle: Study on Green Synthesis of Silver Nanoparticles for Dye Degradation and Sensing Applications by Plant Extracts
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: for decades, Silver is a benign, inorganic antibacterial/ antifungal substance. Silver has a lot of potential in biological applications, especially in nanoparticle form (NPs). Green synthesis processes are also cost effective and have a wide supply of raw ingredients. Many attempts have been made in the last few years to develop new greener and less expensive nanoparticle synthesis technologies. In contrast to past synthesis methods, which used damaging reductive organic species that produced hazardous by-products, the goal has been utilize less harmful synthesis methods. This ecologically friendly component and it is vital in combatting pollution by eliminating hazardous materials. Antibacterial, antifungal and antioxidant properties of AgNPs have been exploited in agriculture and medicine. Many bacteria, including Staphylococcus aureus, Bacilluscereus,Pseudomonasaeruginosa,Vibrioparahaemolyticu-s,Escherichiacoli,Citrobacterkoseri, Salmonellatyphii,Klebsiella pneumonia and the fungus Candida albicans, have been shown to be inhibited in their growth and multiplication by Ag NPs. This results in cell death and prevents cell reproduction. Pathogens can damage food goods; hence Ag NPs are also utilized in packaging to avoid this. Ag NPs' toxicity is determined by their size, concentration, medium pH, and time spent in contact with pathogens. Green synthesis aims to limit the usage of toxic chemicals in particular.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on Pairs Trading Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Hedge funds employ the trading of pairs as one of their most lucrative trading strategies. It’s especially intriguing since it eliminates the time-consuming process of evaluating assets by focusing on comparable prices. Upon the convergence of the pair’s price, a profit can be achieved by buying a discounted investment and selling an overvalued investment. However, as the data became more widely available, finding rewarding pairs turned out to be a cumbersome process. Pair Trading is a two-step mechanism. The first step is to identify the pairs of stocks that belong to the same market segment or have similar market capitalization. articleTitle: A Comparative Investigation of Supervised Classification Approaches to Mapping Flooded areal extent in and around Puzhal Lake, Chennai, using image processing
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Flooding is a natural occurrence that can result in detrimental effects on people’s mental health as well as their financial well-being. Flood inundation maps not only assist in the process of urban planning but also assist in the localization of regions that are likely to be flooded in the event of future floods. In the event of a catastrophe, when it is not possible to collect ground data using traditional methods, satellite photos are the method of choice for collecting real-time imagery. The technique and classification methods used for the development of flood maps in and around Puzhal reservoir, which is located close to Chennai, Tamil Nadu, in the Indian subcontinent, are discussed in this study. Puzhal reservoir is in Tamil Nadu. The floods that struck the southern part of the state in November and December 2015 were caused by century-high rainfall records, and the maps that have been generated are based on satellite data that was recovered both before and after the floods. Both the pre-flood and post-flood image data were processed with three supervised classification methods, namely the parallelepiped classifier, the minimum distance classifier, and the maximum likelihood classifier, and the error in the user selection of features was determined with the help of a confusion matrix. These methods were used to analyse the data obtained from the images taken before and after the flood. In addition, the data were checked for accuracy by utilising statistical data that was produced from the values of indices such as the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) and the Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI). The maximum accuracy of the selected region was obtained using the parallelepiped classifier for the data gathered before the flood, while the greatest accuracy was obtained using the maximum likelihood classifier for the data gathered after the flood. It was discovered that there has been a considerable increase in the cover of green vegetation and the extent of water in the post-flood image in compared to the pre-flood complement. This was noticed while looking at the image in terms of areal extent.

By understanding the correlation and variations in the data processing and model training parameters, we have successfully proposed a LSTM neural network model training and optimising method which could successfully help businesses take both long and short term profitable decisions before and after big financial and market crises with a respective accuracy of 98.60 percent and 96.97 percent.

articleTitle: Packet Authentication in Wireless Mesh Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In Today's networking areas, Wireless Mesh Network (WMN) has become one of the most evolving research works due to its challenges in its security and its adaptable applications. Different kinds of attacks are possible in WMNs like DoS (Denial of Services), man-in-the-middle (MitM), replay, impersonation etc., which led to the vulnerability of security attacks in Wireless Mesh network. And many existing schemes were proposed to deliver node authentication, which does only deliver end-to-end authentication between the two communicating nodes with their secret key. Therefore, the intermediate nodes only forward the packet and only the destination node authenticates the packet. Which implies that the success chance of DoS attack and packet drop is very high and these results in the increase of network collision decrease the packet delivery ratio and high consumption of power. Therefore, we propose a hop-by-hop packets authentication with having data confidentiality, which is the most effective ways to obstruct attacks and stop forwarding of corrupted and unauthorized traffic in WMN. In this paper, we present a Packet Authentication with Data Confidentiality (PADC) rely on Elliptic Curves Cryptography in WMN. This enables authentication in the intermediate nodes while the confidentiality and integrity of data is preserved throughout its transmission until it reaches its destination.

This tool assigns a label "malevolent" to the node having least trust. The number of packets, whose transmission is done under this period, is considered to compute the trust. The node responsible for transmitting the maximum packets and consuming few resources is considered as malevolent node in the network. NS2 (network simulator 2) is applied to simulate the introduced framework and diverse metrics are employed to analyse the outcomes.

articleTitle: An Enhanced MIN-MIN algorithm for workflow scheduling in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In Cloud Computing environment, scheduling of Cloudlets and resource allocation of Cloudlets are two major issues that need to be considered. To improve the system performance, it is necessary that the Cloudlets scheduled on the resources available must be efficiently executed. For scientific applications, workflow scheduling is a significant issue. To handle this issue, a new mechanism called Enhanced Min-Min (E-Min-Min) is introduced inspired by the Min-Min algorithm. This scheduling algorithm not only schedules the jobs according to their completion time but considers the data transfer time too with equal priority and makes an aggregated function for scheduling of jobs to the best suitable resources. During the scheduling process, the main focus is on the minimization of Makespan, maximize the resource utilization and load balance level and also minimize the cost of scheduling. Workflow scientific applications such as Montage, Cybershake, InSpiral, SIPHT are considered. In workflow the tasks are represented as nodes and their dependencies represents the relationships among them. WorkflowSim simulator with Net Beans IDE is used to create the simulation environment and the results are validated over it. The proposed algorithm shows the better results as compared with the basic Min-Min and Modified Min-Min algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of NMSE using Hard Decoding Scheme in comparison with Traditional Unquant Decoding Scheme for Massive MIMO OFDM based wireless system

abstract: In OFDM systems, the Normalized Mean Square Error (NMSE) should be in acceptable range suitable for wireless communication. The aim of the work is to analyze NMSE for the massive MIMOOFDM (MIMO OFDM) system using novel Hard Decoding Scheme and comparing it with Unquant decoding scheme. Hence this research is to improve the Normalized Mean Square Error using a novel hard decoding scheme. By using this scheme, the signal will strengthen and to decrease the noise in the channel. Hard decoding scheme is used with 10 samples to estimate the NMSE in massive MIMO in comparison with unquant decoding schemes using 10 samples. Pretest power for the samples is 80%. Matlab simulation tool is utilized to produce simulation results. The performance of Normalized Mean Square Error (NMSE) is analyzed using the unquant decoding scheme and enhanced by Hard decoding scheme parameters. At 12 dB SNR, unquant decoding scheme provides the Normalized mean square error value of about 10<sup>−4.7</sup> where as novel hard decoding scheme provides Normalized mean square error value around 10<sup>−6</sup>. The group statistics comparison for novel hard decoding scheme and unquant decoding scheme with its statistical significance value of 0.022 (p-value < 0.05). According to the experimental results and analysis were done statistically with the help of T-test having independent samples, from the analysis, the hard decoding method significantly performed better than the Unquant decoding scheme.

It can be used in a variety of ways, including for surveillance, security, human-computer interaction, and content-based video retrieval. There have been a number of researchers that have presented vision-based techniques to human activity recognition. Several challenges need to be addressed in the creation of a vision-based human activity recognition system, including illumination variations in human activity recognition, interclass similarity between scenes, the environment and recording setting, and temporal variation. To overcome the above mentioned problem, by capturing or sensing human actions with help of wearable sensors, wearable devices, or IoT devices. Sensor data, particularly one-dimensional time series data, are used in the work of human activity recognition. Using 1D-Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models, this works aims to propose a new approach for identifying human activities. The Wireless Sensor Data Mining (WISDM) dataset is utilised to train and test the 1D-CNN model in this dissertation. The proposed HAR-CNN model has a 95.2%of accuracy, which is far higher than that of conventional methods.

articleTitle: Improved Weather Prediction Mechanism with Mode Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This Weather prediction is a complex application that needs multiple phases of processing. The processing application built through the proposed mechanism using mode based pre-processing along with clustering mechanism. Mode is the highest value from the attribute. By replacing mode value with the missing value, correlation may become negative. This negative correlated attributes have to be eliminated from the dataset. The mechanism used first of all load the dataset. After loading the dataset, pre-processing is applied. The outliers and missing values are tackled with the help of mode based approach. Missing values are represented with "NA" and can be handled by replacing these missing values with the calculated mode. The outliers are extreme values present within the dataset. These extreme values will be replaced with the average values to increase the classification accuracy of overall operation. Labelling information is applied with correlation and clustering mechanism. Labeling information allows to accurately predict the weather. The classification is done using with clustering and multiple classes has been predicted. The result of classification accuracy is in the range of 80% that is improved by 4% using proposed approach. The demonstration of the work is done on the dataset derived from benchmarked website.

articleTitle: A Case Study on Power Factor Improvement Using Capacitor Bank in a Power Generation Station
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: This study has been made for Lalitpur Power Generation Company Ltd. (LPGCL), which operates a thermal generating station of 1980 MW. In line with Government of India policies to promote renewable energy resources, a proposal has been made to set up 250 Generated Power needs to be made compatible to be supplied to the Grid by adhering to certain parameters provided under the Grid Code. One of the most crucial and important is power factor, This study aims at correcting the power factor by installing capacitors parallel to the load.

Author Keywords: voltage profileMW solar PV generating station to supplement the supply to the Grid. The Grid consists of two transmission lines
the first being a 765 kV transmission system to Agra and the second being two nos. 220 kV transmission lines to Lalitpur and Jhansi respectively

articleTitle: Prediction of Packet Delivery Ratio Using Lasso Regression in Comparison with Linear Regression Algorithm for Multi Input Multi Output Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The aim of the study is to predict the accurate Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR) using the dataset provided with the help of the machine learning technique Novel Linear and compared with Lasso regression algorithms. Sklearn machine learning library in python is used to perform Regression with help of 10000 PDR values generated using python in which about 1 - 50 SNR (Signal to Noise Ratio) and its corresponding Packet Delivery Ratio (PDR) are obtained. Sample sizes of the two groups are 10 each. Novel lasso regression is considered as Group 2 with 10 samples and Linear regression is considered as Group 1 with 10 samples and these samples were calculated using g power with a pretest power of 80 and a 0.05 alpha value (Error rate). PDR of lasso regression is 96.56 % and PDR of Linear regression is 95.48 % for corresponding SNR is 4 db. The independent sample T-test was examined and found to have a significance level of P less than 0.05. Prediction of PDR for Novel Lasso Regression algorithm is significantly better than the Linear regression algorithm.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Design and Development of Cardiovascular Disease Prediction System Using Voting Classifier
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Heart disease prediction system is a system which can assert a possibility of a heart disease based on physical features and basic medical records of an individual. This system aims to deliver an easy to use and accessible method which can help in making assertions about the possibility of a heart disease without medical consultation. The system can also be placed as an initial part of diagnoses to check for a heart disease at medical facilities and if required medical consultation can be followed afterwards. This project implements different machine learning algorithms. They are K- nearest neighbor, Random forest, Decision tree and Support vector machine. To attain a higher accuracy the results of all the classifiers are to be passed through a Voting classifier. Performance metrics evaluation is done by different performance evaluators in machine learning such as confusion matrix etc. The dataset used consists of eleven features and a target variable.

articleTitle: Diabetes Prediction Using Knn ML
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Diabetes is one of the major ailments and many people suffer from it. Many complications occur when diabetes remains untreated and undiagnosed. People with Sugar are at greater risk for diseases such as heart problem, kidney problem, stroke, eye vision, nerve damage, and many more. The annoying effects of the diagnostic procedure on visiting the affected person at the diagnostic center and seeing a doctor. The reason for this study is to develop a version that can predict the risk of diabetes in more precise patients. three algorithms for the decision-making gadget class that Tree, SVM, and Naive Bayes are used in this test to diagnose diabetes early. therefore, early diabetes prognosis is very important. In this paper, we use system-controlled control algorithms such as Vector Assistant Machine (SVM), Naive Bayes classifier to educate the actual numbers of 520 diabetic patients and 16- to 90-year-old diabetic patients. with comparative testing of type and accuracy of recognition, the overall performance of the assist vector gadget is impressive.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Compound TCP with Various End-to-End Congestion Control Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Congestion control is a fundamental mechanism offered by the Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) to make sure stable data flow and efficient bandwidth allocations in the network. It mainly focuses on the adjustment of the incoming sending rate with respect to the receiving rate. The reliable TCP helps to manage the transmission rate by avoiding the state of network congestion. In recent years, different variants of TCP congestion control protocols have been proposed to enhance TCP reliability and performance under different network scenarios. Moreover, it is associated with several types of network states such as latency, throughput, and packet loss. In this paper, we have performed a comparative study on the performance analysis of various TCP congestion control protocols on NS2 simulator. The results show that CUBIC gives the highest average throughput, Vegas gives the lowest packet loss ratio, and Veno gives the lowest average end-to-end delay among other TCP congestion control techniques that are considered in this paper.

articleTitle: Prediction of House Price Using Stacked LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: House price is used as an economic indicator. Prediction of house price is important as it can be helpful for those who want to buy or plan to buy a house in the future or near future. It can give them an idea of the future price. It is also be helpful for sellers who are willing to sell their house as they can understand the future trend of the price of their houses. House price prediction is beneficial for the investors who want to invest in real estate. It helps to know the future trends of the real estate of a locality. In this paper, we have used deep learning Long Short-term memory model to predict house price. This model performed quiet well. Here our main motive is to see how data size influences a deep learning model. In a single model we have used different data size (specifically 12 different data sizes) and compared the results. It is evident from the results that data size plays a significant role in our model’s performance.

articleTitle: IOT Based PV Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Solar photovoltaic (PV) systems have become the most popular kind of clean, renewable energy generating. The performance, however, varies depending to many characteristics and ambient circumstances. As a result, a remote and continuous observing framework is expected to assess its exhibition. In this review, a shrewd model for checking PV exhibits through the Internet of Things(IoT). A sensor board for electronic gadgets has been made. To screen the information on the web, a website application was also created. The planned prototype was tested experimentally at Galgotias university. The experimental findings demonstrated the prototype's capacity to monitor data without the need of extra circuits or attempts. The model may be used for defect recognition (FD) in PV clusters by including a FD calculation, for instance.

articleTitle: Food Detection and Recognition Using Deep Learning – A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Studies show poor lifestyle choices and unhealthy eating patterns cause issues like obesity and other ongoing illnesses that raise the risk of heart attacks, such as hypertension, abnormal blood sugar levels, and diabetes. To improve this situation a lot of health apps have been built which use modern dietary monitoring systems that automatically evaluate dietary intake using machine learning and deep learning techniques rather. For these reasons indepth investigations on food detection, classification, and analysis have been conducted. Some of the top methods for automatic food recognition created have been discussed in this paper. We also propose an idea for detection of Indian food items using image classification. According to our findings of the papers we reviewed, convolutional neural networks (CNN) have been extensively been used in food detection as it has been giving better results compared to other models. We also observed that Vision transformers perform better in situations where the dataset is large and a hybrid model would give better accuracy. A review of potential applications for food image analysis, shortfalls in the area, and open issues concludes the paper.

articleTitle: Recognition of suitable Pest for Crops using Image Processing and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In the economy of India, agriculture plays vital role and exports processed food to all over the world. Modern agricultural methodologies and tools become essential to get sustainable crop production. During crop growth, it goes through many stages as well it is influenced by various factors, like natural calamities, different types of diseases, pests’ attacks, weeds management etc. To monitor crop personally required expertise in that field as well it is time consuming process. The research in the field of disease identification and pest management can prevent crop loss at certain extent. In this paper, exhaustive survey on pest management for crops are mentioned. A deep learning model with optimization technique is proposed for better accuracy. Recent advancement in deep learning approaches has been applied to get more accurate detection of pests. Experimental results shown that optimization based deep leaning method is providing better recognition of different types of diseases and pests.

articleTitle: Predict the Game Analysis of Cricket Match Winning Using K-Nearest Neighbor and Compare Prediction Accuracy Over Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The primary goal of this research is to forecast game analysis utilising the Novel Support Vector Machine method, compare its performance to the KNN approach. Classification was carried out using the SVM algorithm (N=10) and the KNN method (N=10), and the outcomes were contrasted depending on the precision of the two methods. The usage of this work to implement Machine Learning for the SVM and KNN algorithms. The findings demonstrated that the Novel Support Vector Machine Algorithm outperformed the KNN Algorithm in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: Using Machine Learning Techniques for Outlier Detection Application
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The aim of designing models that have the ability for adapting to their surroundings and have capability for learning from past data has gained attention from numerous spheres, comprising computing engineering, artificial intelligence, statistics, and mathematics. Numerous machine learning methods have evolved from research in the field. Supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement techniques have been applied for a variety of scientific and industrial applications. This paper introduces a description of a scheme for outlier detection application that is based on Isolation Forest machine learning technique. The scheme is an unsupervised learning method. The scheme also uses Random Forest machine learning technique for the application. This method is a supervised learning method. The learning techniques are tested on a sample system. A comparison of Isolation Forest technique with other unsupervised learning algorithms is presented, along with its comparison to supervised Random Forest Classifier algorithm.

articleTitle: FCM with Optimization Algorithms – PSO, CSO, and GA
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: One of the most used fuzzy clustering algorithms is the fuzzy c-means (FCM). On the other hand, FCM can stuck in local optima due to its sensitivity to initialization. In this paper, two hybrid algorithms of FCM with Cuckoo Search Optimization and Genetic Algorithm are proposed and results are analyzed on real data sets.

articleTitle: An Ingenious Method to Detect COVID in X-Ray Images Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Covid-19 is a fatal disease caused by the Covid-19 virus. It is very big problem for the whole world. The World Health Organization (WHO) has declared a pandemic. In May 2020, more people throughout the world had a favorable experience. The COVID illness is rapidly growing, and we are unable to stop it. We addressed the COVID-19 data science research initiatives employing a number of approaches, including statics, machine learning (ML), modelling, simulation, data visualization, and artificial intelligence (AI). We all suffering from COVID-19. in this case higher value of case comes from negative and lower false positive rate. The global impact of the COVID-19 outbreak was enormous. To tackle the pandemic, many projects have been launched, including those in the field of deep learning. This paper proposes a deep neural network modification based on the Xception model. The model is used to detect COVID-19 using chest X-ray images. Batch normalization and two stacks of two dense layers each are used in the proposed model. The layer addition is intended to avoid overfitting the proposed model. The proposed as a result, we compare the model’s loss, accuracy, and performance speed, and the results show that the quality of the machine learning model has higher prediction accuracy and loss, but it takes longer to execute than traditional machine learning languages. Machine learning algorithms in general, and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in particular, have shown promise in medical picture analysis and categorization. The architecture of this study has been presented for the diagnosis of COVID-19.

articleTitle: Role of Artificial Intelligence in Object Detection: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Over the last 20 years, the field of object detection has seen a remarkable progress been made. In its 20-year history, this literature review not only goes through some landmark detectors (e.g., VJ detector, HOG detector, DPM, Faster-RCNN, YOLO, SSD, and others), key technologies, speed up methods, detection applications, datasets, and metrics, but also the 28 difficulties currently faced by the community are being discussed and further enhancement and continuation of these detectors are also discussed. We had shallow trainable structures and Handcrafted features which are the fundamentals of conventional object identification systems. With the spontaneous advancement of deep learning technology, additional effective tools are now competent of learning semantic, high-level, and deeper characteristics. In this study, deep learning-based object detection system has been reviewed. We also go through a few specific tasks, such as prominent item detection, face identification, and pedestrian detection.

articleTitle: A comprehensive survey of state-of-art techniques in digital watermarking
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Digital image watermarking refers to implanting secret information for copyright protection, content authentication of a given media to avoid future conflicts or illegal possession of data. A number of applications are present today for which suitable watermarking techniques can be used to mitigate this problem. Based on the domain, image watermarking can be categorized into spatial or transformation domains. Transform domain techniques are widely used by researchers because of their robustness and security. There is always a tradeoff between robustness, payload, and imperceptibility as maintained by various researchers that is also reviewed. Also, this paper presents various state-of-art watermarking techniques with their performance metrices such as PSNR, MSE, NC, BER, etc. along with their limitations. This survey help the researcher to develop a new watermarking model based on the application domain.

articleTitle: Effectiveness Analysis Of Blockchain Mechanisms Using Consensus Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Recently, along with the development of information technology, blockchain technology has been developing all over the world. On the basis of blockchain technology, it will be possible to develop the digital economy, ensure information security, and increase reliability in data exchange. Due to the high potential of blockchain technology, it has led to the study of its wide application in various fields. These processes have led to the creation of blockchain-based systems for various purposes. Some blockchain mechanisms can also be used to increase data reliability in information systems that provide services in computer networks. However, at the same time, most of the blockchain-based systems have several disadvantages related to their performance and security. To solve these shortcomings, it is necessary to improve the security of blockchain-based systems. The main component of any blockchain-based system is its important consensus algorithm, which in many ways makes it possible to ensure the authenticity and security of information. Consensus algorithms serve to prove the authenticity of executed transactions. The application of consensus algorithms to the blockchain technology, depending on the functional task, allows to increase the reliability of the data. In this article, the effectiveness of using consensus algorithms based on blockchain mechanisms is studied.

articleTitle: A Survey Paper on an IoT-based Machine Learning Model to Predict Air Pollution Levels
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In today’s quickly developing world, air pollution is a major worry. As pollution rises in the earth’s atmosphere every day, so do its rates. The problem is typically caused by toxic fumes released into the air as a result of a broad range of human activities. It is necessary for the current generation to understand the risks posed by these circumstances and to take effective measures to minimize them before the ecosystem is destroyed. This study examines studies of machine learning approaches (MLAs or MLTs) and Internet of Things in predicting air quality, as well as forecasting air pollution levels so individuals can take action to reduce pollution.

articleTitle: IOT Enabled Enhanced Method for Water Leakage Detection and Localization in Water Distribution Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: In existence, Human beings and other living creatures require water for their survival. Moreover, in numerous other sectors like Agribusiness, Industry, and so on, water is additionally utilized as one of the input keys for their production. Thus, it is very important for a precise administration of this asset preservation for social and financial advancement purposes.In the agriculture sector, water-based artificial systems (crops irrigation systems) are mostly used for maintaining the optimum conditions of the crops in the soil regardless of the environmental climate change. However, when the irrigation system is damaged it is very difficult for individuals to locate the water leakage by relying on the conventional way of water spillage location and observing framework. Sometimes, it would take several days for the concerned specialists to find pipe spills and repair them. It isn’t also simple to know the life condition of the water distribution system found beneath the ground and this delay causes water several amounts of water to be wasted.It is in line with the aforementioned need, the current paper proposes a doable strategy to be utilized in a water distribution system for identifying and finding the pipe spills in a short period of time which leads to a decrease in water wastage due to the breakings, erosion or the unearthing of the channeling frameworks. The system prototype implemented in this work mainly consists of three important subsystems. The first subsystem is the sensing part which uses flow rate sensors, attached to the edges of the pipes for comparing the flow rate of the source and destination pipe. The second is the actuating subsystem that uses the solenoid valve that is used to shut off the water flow in case of a leak is detected, then the communication network that uses of GSM module for allowing the end-users to monitor the life of the water distribution systems remotely for immediate support in case it is needed.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Estimators to the OSELM Model
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: The OSELM model is one of many classifiers for software defect prediction that can detect the specific oversampled input problems (pattern). OSELM was a more suitable model for defect prediction when used with the extremely unbalanced data and noisy like NDP repository datasets. Prior metrics were measured using balanced accuracy and recall. In this study, the estimator metrics for the OSELM model are G-Mean, F1-Score, and Matthews Co-Relation Coefficient

Author Keywords: Online Sequential Extreme Learning Machine (OSELM) model

articleTitle: Experimental Evaluation for Text Classification using Improved Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Language use on online platforms has dramatically expanded over the last ten years. Turkish text natural language processing (NLP) research, however, has not gotten much attention. This article seeks to give a thorough review of the Turkish text classification tools and models that are currently accessible. On Turkish text classification dataset, we assess proposed improved Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model. A customization is made with the default optimizer made. An Artificial Neural Network (ANN) based models is given a comparative analysis. We demonstrate that on the available datasets, simple single layer models to outperform conventional models. Ideally, our research and experimentation with paper is concentrated in the Turkish NLP field.

articleTitle: A Proposed Sentiment Analysis Model for Product Reviews on Social Media
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: E-commerce, social medias, forums, blogs etc. become more popular among general public. Nowadays people use this social media platforms to recognize "general public thinking what" and "what was their experience" before buying any product. Internet contains huge amount of user’s data which is available in various form like comments, opinions and reviews regarding various products, services and events. This trend of reading review data from the internet is constantly growing day by day. People’s reviews or opinions which are available on the internet are unstructured. So it creates difficulty at the time of reviewing huge amount of data for both customers and Business Organization to get cumulative result with high rate of accuracy. So extracting and analyzing the useful things from this reviews content becomes challenging task. As a result, customers and Business Organizations need an automated sentiment analysis system. The proposed sentiment analysis model helps customers to take quick decision about any product or services and the Business Organizations to increase the quality of the product by getting clear idea about their product from the customer point of view.

articleTitle: A Taxonomy on Man-in-the-Middle Attack in IoT Network
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Recent trends in IoT networks suggests that the more the use of IoT devices, the more the threat to the network. There are various threats posed by the attackers on this type of networks. In this work we have identified Man-in-the -Middle attack for study and understand its effect on the networks like IoT, IoMT, VANET etc. Various authors have suggested several ways to mitigate the attack. Some of them have used some Machine learning techniques such as Random Forest, Decision Trees and deep learning techniques. After analyzing the works of various authors, we have tried to identify some topics for further investigation and then we would try to summarize the study in the conclusion.

articleTitle: Argument Mining using BERT and Self-Attention based Embeddings
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Argument mining automatically identifies and extracts the structure of inference and reasoning conveyed in natural language arguments. To the best of our knowledge, most of the state-of-the-art works in this field have focused on using tree-like structures and linguistic modeling. But, these approaches are not able to model more complex structures which are often found in online forums and real world argumentation structures. In this paper, a novel methodology for argument mining is proposed which employs attention-based embeddings for link prediction to model the causational hierarchies in typical argument structures prevalent in online discourse.

articleTitle: Voice based translation in fitness band for tourists
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: People all over the world speak in a variety of languages. Despite the fact that English appears to be the most suited language for most people and is taught all around the globe, many individuals find it difficult to learn, and some think that working or studying one's home language is more pleasurable than learning other languages. As a result, communication is tough while travelling throughout the world. As we see in our every-day lives, accomplishing activities, managing things, and so on, technology has the capacity to affect the world in new ways. It has been proved to make things easier for travellers. There are a variety of technologies that might help travellers who travel a long distance. We have included a new feature in today's fitness watches/bands that will assist travellers or anybody else who travels from one location to another and is having difficulty with language translation. Apart from language translation, it has many other features that other smart watches have, and they don't have to pay more for these services because they are included in their budget and are easy to use for everyone. For this, we employed voice recognition and a variety of other modules.

articleTitle: Health Care Monitoring Application using IoT Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Nowadays, health monitoring is crucial, especially monitoring the temperature and heartbeat of the patient in Covid / non-Covid situations. Continued monitoring of the patient is not a possible and tedious job. IoT plays a critical role in Hospitals where patients are in Intensive Care Units (ICU), and patients are treated at home (isolation points). The devices receive data continuously and monitor by the doctors remotely. This paper presents temperature and heartbeat monitoring using Internet Of Things (IoT) devices with an algorithm to capture data from devices and sends it to computer devices at a reasonable cost. Proof Of Concept has been created with the help of an Arduino board, Pulse Sensor, Temperature Sensor, Breadboard, ESP8266 Wi-Fi module, and Liquid Crystal Display (LCD). The IoT devices capture data from different devices (patient health data) in real time. The Health Care Monitoring (HCM) Application builds using microservices architecture, runs on top of the Thingspeak data, and sends notifications to the doctors if there is an emergency. The doctors can act according to rather than monitor continuously. This model eliminates manual intervention for taking the reading from time to time.

articleTitle: Geospatial Techniques for Quantitative Analysis of Urban Expansion and the Resulting Land Use Change along the Chennai Outer Ring Road (ORR) Corridor
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Advances in Computing, Communication Control and Networking (ICAC3N)
abstract: Urbanization measures how quickly rural regions are becoming urban. The alteration in land use and land cover in the impacted area through time has been represented by the growing scale of urban growth and its related sprawl. The aim of the study is to use remote sensing and GIS to assess the land cover changes brought on by urban growth on route via the Outer Ring Road. The land cover maps are created for the four regions of Nazarathpettai, Meppur, Chikkarayapuram, and Perungalathur for the years2009, 2012, and 2016. The seven groups of land covered by the land cover maps—agriculture, bare ground, houses, businesses, bodies of water, other vegetation, and marshland— are examined for changes (swamp). Additionally, changes in area-based land cover, environmental factors (such as changes in green cover), and economic factors are examined in the four segments' maps of land cover. 2009, 2012, and 2016 are three years when, the urban growth of the Outer Ring Road corridor's Chikkarayapuram, Nazarathpettai, Meppur, and Perungalathur segment was (5.16%, 20.10%,14.31%, 30.62%, 13.9%, and 22.18%; 7.14%; and 12.63%; and 19.67%; and 33.1%; and 23.22%; and 40.27%), respectively. Urban settings have grown by 20, 76,530 sq. m between 2009 and 2016. 12,62,700 square meters have been removed from the agricultural zones between 2009 and 2016. Additionally, simulated maps Based on the land cover maps from the three years (2009, 2012, and 2016), projections for the year 2022 were created using the MOLUSCE plugin in open-source GIS (QGIS).
